title: Appearance Epidemiology: A Provocation

detail.title: Appearance Epidemiology: A Provocation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder of the Appearance Positive Institute (APi) and The Appearance Positive (TAP), the institutions discussed in this paper. No external funding was received for this work. No other personal or financial conflicts of interest are declared.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This is a conceptual and theoretical working paper. It does not involve human participants, patient data, clinical trials, or empirical data collection. Ethics approval is therefore not applicable.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The work was conducted independently by the author as part of the Appearance Positive Institute's ongoing field-building activities.

publicationDetails.detailsText: Maduewesi, O. (2026). Appearance Epidemiology: A Provocation. APi Working Paper No. 1, Version 2.0. Appearance Positive Institute (APi). https://institute.tapmovement.org

detail.abstract: Appearance-based inequality shapes who gets hired, who gets treated, who gets loved, and who gets erased. It is a primary stratification system whose consequences have been systematically underestimated-comparable in structure and consequence to race, class, and gender, yet almost entirely absent from the frameworks built to study them. That absence is not accidental. It reflects structural patterns in how inequality is defined, measured, and prioritised, patterns that have kept appearance off the research agenda, out of the funding conversation, and invisible in policy. This paper names those patterns directly. It examines the three fields that have come closest to this territory-psychology, social epidemiology, and disability studies-and shows precisely where and why each has stopped short. It provides a concrete, cost blueprint for the Global Appearance Inequality Index (GAIIx): the measurement programme the field does not yet have. And it closes with direct demands to researchers, funders, policymakers, the AI industry, and people living with visible difference. This is not an invitation to further study. It is a demand for reckoning.

AI.tldr: 本文系统揭示了外貌不平等作为与种族、阶级、性别并列的 stratification 体系，其后果被系统性低估。作者批判了心理学、社会流行病学和残疾研究三大学科如何未能深入该领域，并提出构建全球外貌不平等指数（GAIIx）的蓝图，最终向研究者、资助者、政策制定者、AI行业及外貌差异群体发出行动呼唤。
AI.research_question: 外貌不平等如何成为一种被系统性忽视的初级分层体系？为何现有学科框架未能充分研究这一现象？如何建立衡量外貌不平等的系统化工具？
AI.motivation: 外貌不平等在雇佣、社会对待、情感关系乃至社会存在感方面产生深远影响，其后果堪与种族、阶级和性别不平等相提并论，但学术界、资助体系和政策制定中却几乎完全缺失这一议题。这种缺失并非偶然，而是结构性忽视的结果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 外貌不平等作为 stratification 系统（与种族、阶级、性别并列）；2) 结构性忽视理论（不平等定义、测量和优先级设定的结构性模式）；3) 跨学科整合框架（心理学、社会流行病学、残疾研究的批判性对话）。
AI.method: 1) 对心理学、社会流行病学和残疾研究三个领域的批判性文献分析，揭示其局限；2) 提出全球外貌不平等指数（GAIIx）的具体构建蓝图（含成本估算）；3) 针对不同利益相关者的直接行动呼吁。
AI.findings: 1) 三个既有学科（心理学、社会流行病学、残疾研究）各自在接近外貌不平等议题时均存在结构性盲区；2) 外貌不平等的忽视源于制度性模式，而非偶然；3) 可以通过GAIIx实现系统化测量；4) 需要多主体（研究者、资助者、政策制定者、AI行业、外貌差异群体）协同行动。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 首次将外貌不平等明确定位为与种族、阶级、性别并列的初级分层系统；2) 提出"结构性忽视"概念解释为何外貌不平等未被纳入主流研究框架；3) 整合心理学、社会流行病学和残疾研究的批判性视角，揭示各自学科局限。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提供全球外貌不平等指数（GAIIx）的具体构建蓝图与成本预算；2) 向不同利益相关者提出可操作的具体要求（如资助者需将外貌纳入资助优先级，AI行业需解决外貌偏见，政策制定者需将外貌不平等纳入政策框架）。

title: Implementation of the Sibling Game ‘Broodles’: A Mixed-Methods Study on Barriers and Facilitators
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, VU University Amsterdam and VU Amsterdam

detail.title: Implementation of the Sibling Game ‘Broodles’: A Mixed-Methods Study on Barriers and Facilitators
detail.abstract: Objective Siblings of children with disabilities constitute an often-overlooked target group within care. The serious game ‘Broodles’ has been developed to support them. This study focuses on the motivation and experiences of users, and factors that influence the implementation of the game within special education, health‑care, and welfare organisations.Methods A mixed‑method design was applied. Data were collected through usage data retrieved from the game and an initial and evaluation questionnaire among those interested in the game. Additionally, interviews were conducted with professionals from seven organisations to investigate facilitators and barriers for implementation guided by the Consolidated Framework for Implementation Research. Two adult siblings reflected on these findings.Results In the first year after the release of the game, 349 individuals created an account. The initial questionnaire was completed by 298 respondents (70 children, 81 parents, and 143 professionals, 4 others) and the evaluation questionnaire by 48 respondents (10 parents, 34 professionals and 4 others). Interviews revealed facilitators, such as the game’s low‑threshold accessibility and having ambassadors, and barriers, such as lacking time to explore and offer ‘Broodles’ to siblings and uncertainty about who is responsible for supporting siblings.ConclusionThis study identified facilitators and barriers of the implementation of ‘Broodles’. The findings provide future directions for improving the implementation of support resources for siblings.InnovationThe findings from the implementation of ‘Broodles’ provide a basis for implementing support tools for brothers and sisters.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了支持残疾儿童兄弟姐妹的严肃游戏"Broodles"，通过混合方法（使用数据、问卷、访谈）识别了实施的促进因素（低门槛、有倡导者）和障碍因素（缺乏时间、责任不清），为改善该群体的支持资源实施提供了方向。
AI.research_question: 严肃游戏"Broodles"在特殊教育、医疗和福利组织中实施的影响因素是什么？用户的使用动机和体验如何？
AI.motivation: 残疾儿童的兄弟姐妹在护理体系中常被忽视，缺乏专门的支持资源。严肃游戏"Broodles"旨在为他们提供支持，但需要系统评估其实施效果和影响因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 实施研究整合框架（Consolidated Framework for Implementation Research, CFIR）
AI.method: 混合方法设计：收集游戏使用数据、初始和评估问卷调查（共346名参与者），以及对7个组织专业人员的访谈，另邀请2位成年兄弟姐妹对发现进行反思。
AI.findings: 游戏发布首年349人创建账户；初始问卷298人（70名儿童、81名家长、143名专业人员、4名其他），评估问卷48人（10名家长、34名专业人员、4名其他）。促进因素包括低门槛可及性、有倡导者；障碍因素包括缺乏时间探索和提供游戏、责任归属不清。
AI.theory_contributions: 将CFIR框架应用于严肃游戏在残疾儿童兄弟姐妹支持领域的实施研究，识别了该特定情境下的实施促进与障碍因素，丰富了实施科学在游戏干预领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为"Broodles"游戏的改进提供了具体方向（如减少时间障碍、明确责任分工）；为未来开发针对兄弟姐妹群体的支持工具提供了实施策略参考。

title: The Addictive Revenue Trap: State Fiscal Dependency, Corporate Profit, and the Political Economy of Social Harm

detail.title: The Addictive Revenue Trap: State Fiscal Dependency, Corporate Profit, and the Political Economy of Social Harm
detail.abstract: This paper introduces and develops the Addictive Revenue Trap (ART) as a concept drawing on fiscal sociology, institutional economics and political economy, exploring the structural conditions under which states become fiscally dependent upon revenues derived from harmful, habit-forming commodities. The ART observes a self-reinforcing cycle wherein state reliance on sin tax revenues generates regulatory capture, which expands corporate political power, which in turn drives increased consumption of addictive products, whose health and social costs create further fiscal pressure, deepening dependence on the very revenues that perpetuate the harm. The trap’s distinctiveness lies in the addictive property of the commodity generating the revenue, addiction that operates at biological, psychological, and economic levels simultaneously, creating feedback loops that distinguish this trap from ordinary regulatory capture. In formalizing these feedback mechanisms, the paper introduces a continuous-time macroeconomic model of the state’s Net Fiscal Position, mathematically demonstrating how public social expenses are structurally bound to the physical volume of the addiction. Through illustrative case studies of tobacco taxation in the United States, alcohol excise dependence in post-Soviet Russia, and gambling lottery taxation in United States and United Kingdom jurisdictions, the paper demonstrates how the ART operates across diverse institutional contexts. The analysis reveals the moral distortion at the trap’s core, in that the state’s “helping” functions (funding cancer treatment, addiction rehabilitation, and public health initiatives) become justification for perpetuating the very harms the interventions address. The paper concludes by articulating a heterodox policy agenda designed to break the ART’s feedback loops through: decoupling public finance from addictive commodities via functional finance; implementing disinterested management systems for production; democratic corporate charter redesignation; sovereign wealth fund mechanisms with phase-out schedules; civic assemblies to break regulatory capture; and international coordination to prevent regulatory arbitrage.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"成瘾性收入陷阱"（ART）概念，揭示国家财政如何因依赖成瘾性商品（烟草、酒精、赌博）税收而陷入自我强化的恶性循环，并通过数学模型和跨国案例论证了这一机制，最后提出打破陷阱的异端政策议程。
AI.research_question: 国家在何种结构条件下会陷入对有害成瘾性商品税收的财政依赖，以及这一依赖如何形成自我强化的循环？
AI.motivation: 现有文献对"罪恶税"的讨论多停留在公共卫生或财政角度，缺乏从政治经济学和财政社会学视角系统分析国家财政与成瘾性商品之间结构性依赖关系的理论框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财政社会学、制度经济学、政治经济学；成瘾性收入陷阱（ART）概念；连续时间宏观经济学模型（国家净财政头寸）。
AI.method: 理论概念构建 + 连续时间宏观经济学数学模型（国家净财政头寸动态方程） + 多案例比较研究（美国烟草税、后苏联俄罗斯酒精消费税、英美博彩彩票税）。
AI.findings: 成瘾性商品收入形成自我强化循环：国家依赖罪恶税收入→监管俘获→企业政治权力扩大→成瘾品消费增加→健康与社会成本上升→财政压力加大→进一步依赖罪恶税；公共社会支出在结构上与成瘾品的物理消费量绑定；该陷阱的核心存在"道德扭曲"：国家"帮助"功能（如癌症治疗、成瘾康复）反而成为延续危害的正当化理由。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统提出"成瘾性收入陷阱"（ART）概念，将其与普通监管俘获区分开来，揭示了成瘾性商品在生物、心理和经济三个层面同时运作的反馈机制；通过数学模型形式化了这一陷阱的动态机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出六项异端政策建议：功能性财政脱钩、生产去利益化管理、民主企业章程重新设计、主权财富基金机制与退出时间表、公民大会打破监管俘获、国际协调防止监管套利。

title: The Theoretical Boundaries of Mortality Economics: Ultimate Convergence, Embodied Cooperation, and the Formation of Expansion Force

detail.title: The Theoretical Boundaries of Mortality Economics: Ultimate Convergence, Embodied Cooperation, and the Formation of Expansion Force

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal, financial, institutional, or other relationships that could be perceived as having influenced the research, analysis, or conclusions of this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper is a theoretical research paper. It does not involve human participants, patient data, interviews, surveys, experiments, or personally identifiable information. Ethics approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
This paper defines the theoretical boundaries of Mortality Economics. It argues that death should not be treated only as a demographic event, a biological termination, or an actuarial risk, but as a structural boundary condition for cooperation, valuation, and long-run expansion. Existing economic literatures have examined mortality through population aging, life-cycle behavior, inheritance, insurance, human capital, and institutional continuity. This paper asks a narrower theoretical question: what happens to cooperation capacity when the natural person who carries memory, judgment, credit, tacit knowledge, authority, or liability permanently exits the system?

The paper develops a distinction between embodied cooperation, Cemb, and externalized cooperation, Cext. Cemb refers to cooperation capacity carried by natural persons and is therefore exposed to mortality vulnerability. Cext refers to cooperation structures that can survive the exit of natural persons through records, contracts, property rights, legal personhood, offices, inheritance arrangements, courts, and organizational procedures. The paper further distinguishes effective externalized cooperation from pseudo-Cext, where formal continuity preserves rigidity, monopoly, privilege, or liability evasion rather than productive cooperation.

Building on the Expansion Force formulation, the paper argues that long-run expansion depends not merely on material capacity, but on whether cooperation can be preserved, transferred, enforced, updated, and reconnected after finite actors exit. Mortality therefore reveals a theoretical boundary that ordinary growth, institutional, and organizational-capital models do not fully isolate: economic systems differ not only in how they coordinate living actors, but also in how they prevent cooperation from dying with them.

The paper contributes a formal conceptual distinction, a reduced-form theoretical representation, and falsifiable propositions for subsequent empirical and institutional analysis. It establishes the theoretical foundation for later work on mortality pressure, externalized cooperation, institutional continuity, and the formation of Expansion Force.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"死亡经济学"的理论边界，核心论证是：经济系统不仅依赖活着的个体的合作能力（具身合作），更依赖那些能够在个体死亡后继续存在的合作结构（外化合作）。长期经济扩张的关键在于合作能力能否在行动者退场后被保存、转移和执行。
AI.research_question: 当承载记忆、判断、信用、隐性知识、权威或责任的自然人永久退出系统时，合作能力会发生什么变化？
AI.motivation: 现有经济学文献将死亡视为人口事件、生物终止或精算风险，但未将其作为合作、估值和长期扩张的结构性边界条件来对待。
AI.theoretical_framework: 具身合作（Cemb）与外化合作（Cext）的区分；有效外化合作与伪外化合作的区分；基于扩张力（Expansion Force）的理论框架。
AI.method: 理论推导与概念分析，提出可证伪的命题以供后续实证和制度分析。
AI.findings: 长期扩张不仅依赖物质能力，更依赖合作能力在有限行动者退出后能否被保存、转移、执行、更新和重新连接。死亡揭示了增长模型、制度模型和组织资本模型未能完全隔离的理论边界。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了具身合作与外化合作的形式化概念区分；提供了简约的理论表征；建立了可用于后续实证和制度分析的可证伪命题；奠定了死亡压力、外化合作、制度连续性与扩张力形成研究的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解制度设计、组织持续性、继承机制、法人制度等如何使合作超越个体生命延续提供了理论工具；提示了伪外化合作（形式连续但导致僵化、垄断、特权或责任逃避）的风险。

title: Artificial Intelligence and Predictive Analytics in Optimizing Food Redistribution Networks for Low-Income Populations

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence and Predictive Analytics in Optimizing Food Redistribution Networks for Low-Income Populations
detail.abstract: This paper explores the application of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Predictive Analytics in optimizing logistics and mitigation strategies for food waste and food insecurity among lowincome populations. While traditional humanitarian management and social solidarity networks operate on a manual, reactive basis, this study proposes a digital transformation powered by machine learning algorithms to forecast supply chain inefficiencies and dynamically align surplus food with the specific needs of vulnerable communities. By analyzing current operational boundaries and outlining a predictive redistribution ecosystem, the research highlights how advanced technology can minimize organic waste and maximize social impact in non-profit settings.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨如何利用人工智能和预测分析技术，通过数字化供应链优化，将剩余食品动态匹配给低收入脆弱群体，以减少食物浪费并缓解食物不安全问题。
AI.research_question: 人工智能和预测分析如何优化物流和缓解策略，以解决低收入人群的食物浪费和食物不安全问题？
AI.motivation: 传统人道主义管理和社会互助网络依赖人工、被动的方式运作，效率低下，无法有效应对食物浪费与食物不安全并存的矛盾。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字化转型理论、机器学习预测分析、供应链优化理论、社会影响最大化框架。
AI.method: 分析当前运营边界，提出一个基于机器学习的预测性再分配生态系统模型。
AI.findings: 先进技术（AI与预测分析）能够最小化有机浪费，最大化非营利环境中的社会影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AI和预测分析引入人道主义物流与食物再分配领域，拓展了数字化转型在非营利供应链管理中的理论应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为低收入人群的食物援助提供了可操作的数字化解决方案，帮助非营利组织动态匹配供需、减少浪费。

title: Beyond Manager Access: A Fama-French Decomposition of How Endowments Respond to Economic Policy Uncertainty

detail.title: Beyond Manager Access: A Fama-French Decomposition of How Endowments Respond to Economic Policy Uncertainty
detail.abstract: Lerner, Schoar, and Wang (2008) established that large university endowments consistently outperform smaller peers, attributing the performance gap primarily to superior access to alternative investment managers. Their study identifies which endowments outperform but leaves open a critical behavioral question: what do large endowments actually do differently at the decision-making level when navigating macroeconomic uncertainty? To provide an empirically grounded answer I created a panel of 43,239 institution-year observations from 3,596 U.S. universities over fiscal years 2003 to 2023. I applied a logistic regression with institution-clustered standard errors to estimate how economic policy uncertainty (Baker, Bloom, & Davis, 2016) affects endowment strategy changes across the size distribution. I then adapted the Fama and French (2001) decomposition methodology, originally developed to explain the disappearance of corporate dividends, to separate the behavioral gap into characteristics effects, propensity effects, and an intercept difference. The results reveal a consistent, size-dependent gradient in uncertainty responsiveness that I term the Freeze versus Flex framework: small endowments (Q1) show an odds ratio of 1.349 while mega endowments (Q4) show 1.979, a 46.7% differential. The decomposition separates the gap into three components, a characteristics effect (-0.52 pp), a propensity effect (+0.87 pp), and an intercept difference (-1.06 pp), and shows that the propensity effect more than offsets the characteristics effect, indicating that large endowments make fundamentally different decisions given identical economic conditions. A structural break analysis reveals this adaptive capacity collapses during extreme uncertainty (COVID: OR = 0.502 versus pre-COVID: OR = 1.447). These findings provide the behavioral mechanism that Lerner et al. implied but never tested: the same institutions that outperform are those most actively repositioning under uncertainty, and this responsiveness is rooted in organizational decision-making capacity, not portfolio composition.

AI.tldr: 本文发现大型大学捐赠基金在宏观经济不确定性下比小型基金更积极地调整资产配置策略（"Flex"而非"Freeze"），这种决策层面的行为差异解释了其长期业绩优势，但在极端不确定性（如COVID）下这种自适应能力会崩溃。
AI.research_question: 大型捐赠基金在宏观经济不确定性下的决策行为与小型基金有何不同？这种差异如何解释其业绩差距？
AI.motivation: Lerner, Schoar, and Wang (2008) 证明了大型捐赠基金业绩优于小型基金，但未能揭示大型基金在决策层面究竟做了什么不同的事情。本研究旨在填补这一行为层面的空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: "Freeze versus Flex"框架——将不确定性下的捐赠基金行为分为"冻结"（不调整策略）与"灵活调整"两类；借鉴Fama and French (2001) 的分解方法，将行为差距分解为特征效应、倾向效应和截距差异。
AI.method: 使用2003-2023年43,239个机构-年份观测值（来自3,596所美国大学），采用逻辑回归（机构聚类标准误）估计经济政策不确定性对捐赠基金策略变化的影响，并使用Fama-French分解方法分离行为差距的组成成分，辅以结构性断点分析。
AI.findings: 存在"规模依赖性不确定性响应梯度"：小型基金（Q1）优势比为1.349，巨型基金（Q4）为1.979，差距达46.7%。分解显示倾向效应（+0.87 pp）超过了特征效应（-0.52 pp），表明同等条件下大型基金做出根本不同的决策。但在COVID极端不确定性下，这种自适应能力崩溃（OR从1.447降至0.502）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"Freeze versus Flex"框架，为机构投资者的规模-业绩关系提供了行为层面的微观机制解释；证明了大型基金的主动调整能力根植于组织决策能力而非投资组合结构。
AI.practical_contributions: 为小型捐赠基金的管理者提供了改进方向——需要发展不确定性下的战略调整能力；揭示了极端风险下所有机构都可能丧失灵活性的警示；为捐赠基金治理和投资委员会决策流程设计提供依据。

title: Engineering Project Governance Intelligence: An Integrated Early-Warning and Decision Model for Pre-Failure Intervention in Engineering Projects

detail.title: Engineering Project Governance Intelligence: An Integrated Early-Warning and Decision Model for Pre-Failure Intervention in Engineering Projects

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial, professional, or personal interests that could have influenced the research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: No human participants, patient data, animal studies, or institutional review requirements were involved in this research. Ethics approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: The EPGI model addresses a critical limitation in engineering project governance: weak project signals often remain unnoticed until they evolve into measurable delays, risks or organizational disruptions. The framework integrates evidence legitimacy assessment, Bayesian updating, risk propagation analysis and decision-latency monitoring to transform weak signals into evidence-weighted executive action. Rather than relying solely on traditional project reporting, EPGI establishes a structured pathway linking signal detection, evidence validation, propagation awareness and governance response. The contribution provides a reproducible governance mechanism for early warning, adaptive project control and decision support in complex engineering environments.

AI.tldr: EPGI模型通过整合证据合法性评估、贝叶斯更新、风险传播分析和决策延迟监控，将工程项目中容易被忽视的弱信号转化为可操作的治理行动，为复杂工程环境提供早期预警和适应性控制机制。
AI.research_question: 如何系统性地识别、验证并响应工程项目中的弱信号，防止其演变为可测量的延误、风险或组织混乱？
AI.motivation: 传统工程项目治理中，弱信号往往被忽视，直到问题恶化成可测量的延误或风险才被发现，缺乏从信号检测到治理响应的结构化机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 证据合法性评估、贝叶斯更新、风险传播分析、决策延迟监控
AI.method: 提出了EPGI（Evidence-weighted Project Governance Integration）整合框架，将信号检测、证据验证、传播感知和治理响应四个环节结构化连接。
AI.findings: EPGI模型能够将弱信号转化为证据加权的执行行动，实现早期预警、适应性项目控制和决策支持。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个可复制的治理机制，将弱信号管理从被动应对转变为主动的结构化路径，丰富了工程项目治理的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为复杂工程环境中的项目经理和决策者提供了早期预警、适应性控制和证据驱动决策的实用工具。

title: Interstate Solar PV Price Transmission in Australia: A Dynamic Network Perspective
affiliations: , University of Auckland Business School and University of Auckland

detail.title: Interstate Solar PV Price Transmission in Australia: A Dynamic Network Perspective
detail.abstract: Despite rapid cost declines and widespread deployment, the domestic transmission of solar photovoltaic system prices across regions within a country remains largely unexplored. This study analyses the dynamic connectedness of PV system prices across Australian states using monthly data from August 2012 to May 2026. We use the Diebold-Yilmaz spillover index to characterize the baseline interstate price spillover network. To isolate interstate transmission from common external cost drivers, we introduce a two-stage purification procedure that purges international upstream material costs, shipping frictions, currency fluctuations, and macrogeopolitical risks, and reconstruct the purified spillover network. The results reveal substantial time variation in interstate price connectedness. Dynamic connectedness substantially exceeds the static connectedness measure (20.49%), remaining above 40% for more than 95% of the sample period and exhibiting pronounced peaks during system-wide events such as the COVID-19 pandemic. Directional spillover analysis shows substantial heterogeneity in state-level roles. The three largest markets (New South Wales, Victoria, and Queensland) tend to alternate between transmitting and absorbing price disturbances at relatively short intervals, whereas the four smaller jurisdictions (South Australia, Western Australia, Tasmania, and the Australian Capital Territory) sustain a given directional role over more extended phases. This structural differentiation remains robust after controlling international cost and currency factors.

AI.tldr: 本文利用Diebold-Yilmaz溢出指数和两阶段净化程序，分析了2012年8月至2026年5月澳大利亚各州光伏系统价格的动态关联性，发现价格关联度具有显著时变性，且大型市场与小型市场在价格冲击传递中扮演不同角色。
AI.research_question: 在一个国家内部，太阳能光伏系统价格在各地区之间的动态传导机制是怎样的？不同规模的市场在价格溢出网络中扮演何种角色？
AI.motivation: 尽管太阳能光伏成本快速下降且部署广泛，但国内跨区域的光伏系统价格传导机制仍未被充分研究。理解这种传导机制对于政策制定和市场效率具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: Diebold-Yilmaz溢出指数理论；价格传导/溢出效应理论；市场结构分化理论。
AI.method: 采用Diebold-Yilmaz溢出指数构建州际价格溢出网络基线；引入两阶段净化程序，剔除国际上游材料成本、航运摩擦、货币波动和宏观地缘政治风险等外部共同成本驱动因素，重建净化后的溢出网络。
AI.findings: 1. 动态关联度显著超过静态关联度（20.49%），在95%以上的样本期间内维持在40%以上，并在COVID-19等系统事件期间出现明显峰值；2. 三大最大市场（新南威尔士、维多利亚、昆士兰）在价格冲击的发送与接收角色之间频繁切换；3. 四个较小司法管辖区（南澳、西澳、塔斯马尼亚、首都领地）则在较长时间内保持单一方向角色；4. 这一结构分化在控制国际成本与货币因素后依然稳健。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将Diebold-Yilmaz溢出指数应用于国内光伏价格传导研究；提出两阶段净化方法以隔离外部成本驱动因素；揭示了市场规模的异质性角色及其在时变溢出网络中的稳定性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解光伏价格在国内的传导机制提供实证依据；有助于识别价格冲击的传播路径和系统脆弱性，支持更精准的区域性能源政策设计。

title: Out-of-Pocket Expenditure and Access to Maternal Healthcare in India: Evidence on Financial Barriers and District-Level Disparities

detail.title: Out-of-Pocket Expenditure and Access to Maternal Healthcare in India: Evidence on Financial Barriers and District-Level Disparities

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is based entirely on secondary data obtained from publicly available sources, including government reports and published literature. No human participants were directly involved, and no primary data were collected; therefore, ethical approval and informed consent were not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Access to maternal healthcare remains uneven across India despite significant improvements in national health indicators over the past two decades. Out-of-pocket expenditure (OOPE) payments made directly by households at the point of care has been widely identified as a key financial barrier that deters women, particularly those from low-income and rural households, from seeking antenatal care, institutional delivery, and postnatal care services. This paper examines how OOPE on maternal healthcare is associated with access to these services and assesses the extent of district-level variation in both expenditure and access. Drawing on secondary data from the National Family Health Survey-5 (NFHS-5, 2019-21), the National Sample Survey 75th Round on Social Consumption: Health (2017-18), and the Health Management Information System (HMIS), the paper synthesises existing evidence to explore patterns of financial burden, disparities across districts, and the socioeconomic and health-system factors associated with these variations. The paper further evaluates the effectiveness of three major government schemes the Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY), the Janani Shishu Suraksha Karyakram (JSSK), and the Pradhan Mantri Surakshit Matritva Abhiyan (PMSMA) in reducing OOPE and improving access. Findings from existing literature indicate that while institutional delivery rates have increased, OOPE persists in both public and private facilities and exhibits substantial spatial variation across districts, with poorer districts bearing a disproportionate burden. The paper concludes with policy recommendations focused on strengthening financial protection mechanisms and addressing supply-side gaps in underserved districts.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了印度孕产妇医疗服务的自付费用（OOPE）与可及性之间的关系，发现尽管机构分娩率有所提高，但OOPE在公立和私立医疗机构中仍然存在，且贫困地区负担更重。文章评估了JSY、JSSK和PMSMA三项政府计划的效果，并提出了加强财务保护和弥补服务供给缺口的政策建议。
AI.research_question: 孕产妇医疗服务的自付费用如何影响服务可及性？地区间在费用和可及性方面存在多大差异？
AI.motivation: 尽管印度国家健康指标在过去二十年显著改善，但孕产妇医疗服务的可及性仍不均衡，自付费用是低收入和农村家庭寻求服务的关键财务障碍，亟需系统研究其影响机制和地区差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于财务障碍与医疗服务利用关系的理论，结合社会经济因素和卫生系统因素分析自付费用对孕产妇医疗服务可及性的影响。
AI.method: 利用NFHS-5（2019-21）、NSS第75轮（2017-18）和HMIS等二手数据，综合现有证据分析自付费用的模式、地区差异及相关因素。
AI.findings: 机构分娩率有所上升，但自付费用在公立和私立机构中持续存在，且呈现显著的空间差异，贫困地区承受了不成比例的负担。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统揭示了印度孕产妇医疗自付费用与可及性之间的关联机制，确认了地区间差异的存在及其社会经济和卫生系统决定因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 评估了JSY、JSSK和PMSMA三项政府计划的效果，提出了加强财务保护机制和弥补服务供给缺口的政策建议，为改善印度孕产妇健康公平性提供了实证依据。

title: An Operational Methodology for Cybernetic Monetary Theory

detail.title: An Operational Methodology for Cybernetic Monetary Theory

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author reports there are no competing interests to declare.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This paper is a theoretical study based on publicly available macro-financial data and does not involve human subjects, patients, or ethical review processes.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Cybernetic monetary theory defines a monetary order by its repeatable payment-settlement capacity, L = S x V x C, where S denotes acceptance at par, V denotes temporal continuity, and C denotes settlement finality. It also defines a meta-regulatory authority, M, that reopens blocked payment-settlement circuits in a crisis. This working note provides the shared measurement protocol for that framework: the procedure that translates S, V, C, and M into observable indicators, standardized readings, a two-stage aggregation method that preserves non-substitutability across the three axes, a normal-boundary-exception state classification, and a meta-regulatory event-coding standard. The protocol is demonstrated in two domains: the foreign-exchange boundary state and the USDC/SVB 2023 stablecoin-banking interface, with the remaining domains provided as extensible templates. Its contribution is diagnostic rather than thermometric. Where existing financial stress indices measure how much stress is present, this protocol asks which operating condition of monetary repeatability is failing. It is offered as a citable backbone for the research program, not as a validated index or a test of the theory.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套基于网络货币理论的支付结算能力测量协议，通过S（面值接受度）、V（时间连续性）、C（结算终局性）和M（元监管权威）四个维度，对货币秩序的运行状态进行诊断性分类，并以外汇市场和USDC/SVB稳定币-银行接口为例进行演示。
AI.research_question: 如何将网络货币理论（L = S × V × C）中的核心概念可操作化，建立一套标准化的观测指标、聚合方法和状态分类体系，以诊断货币秩序中支付结算回路的具体故障模式？
AI.motivation: 现有金融压力指数仅衡量"压力有多大"，但无法回答"货币重复性的哪个运行条件正在失效"。本文旨在提供诊断性工具，区分故障类型，而非单纯测温。
AI.theoretical_framework: 网络货币理论（Cybernetic Monetary Theory），定义货币秩序为可重复的支付结算能力L = S × V × C，并引入元监管权威M作为危机中重启结算回路的机制。
AI.method: 提出共享测量协议，包括：（1）S、V、C、M的可观测指标与标准化读数；（2）两阶段聚合方法，保持三个轴的非可替代性；（3）正常-边界-异常的状态分类；（4）元监管事件编码标准。在两个领域（外汇市场边界状态、USDC/SVB稳定币-银行接口）进行演示，其余领域提供可扩展模板。
AI.findings: 该协议是诊断性而非测温性的，能够区分货币重复性中具体哪个运行条件（S、V或C）正在失效，而非仅报告压力水平。在外汇边界状态和USDC/SVB案例中成功演示了分类效果。
AI.theory_contributions: 为网络货币理论提供了可被引用的共享测量基础，建立了从理论概念到可观测指标的系统翻译流程，并提出了保持维度非可替代性的聚合方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供区分货币秩序故障类型的诊断工具，帮助识别支付结算回路中具体哪一环节（面值接受、时间连续性或结算终局性）出现问题，从而指导针对性干预；提供了可扩展的状态分类模板，适用于多种金融领域。

title: Cybernetic Monetary Theory: Settlement, Exception, and Authority in the International Monetary Order

detail.title: Cybernetic Monetary Theory: Settlement, Exception, and Authority in the International Monetary Order

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author reports there are no competing interests to declare.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This paper is a theoretical study based on publicly available macro-financial data and does not involve human subjects, patients, or ethical review processes.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: International political economy (IPE) has theorized money as hierarchy, sovereignty, credit, and infrastructure, but lacks an account of settlement repeatability and of the authority to restore it in a crisis. This paper develops cybernetic monetary theory as a mid-range IPE framework to fill that gap. Its central claim is that monetary power cannot be read from currency shares or price equilibria alone; it becomes decisive in meta-regulatory authority-the authority to reopen monetary circuits in boundary and exception states, distributed asymmetrically. The framework defines a monetary order not by its issued stock but by its repeatable payment-settlement capacity: the joint maintenance of acceptance at par, payment-refinancing continuity, and settlement finality. Because these conditions are non-substitutable, monetary power becomes visible when one fails-policy authority becomes decisive insofar as it can restore the blocked circuit. Across the gold standard, the dollar swap-line order, and programmable money, the paper shows that digital money re-renders rather than abolishes monetary hierarchy: stablecoins, deposit tokens, and CBDCs differ less in technical form than in where authority is placed across code layers. It thus reframes monetary order as a problem of repeatability and the allocation of authority.

AI.tldr: 本文提出网络控制论货币理论，认为货币权力不在于货币份额或价格均衡，而在于在边界和例外状态下重新开放货币流通的元监管权威。数字货币并未消除货币层级，而是在代码层中重新分配权威位置。
AI.research_question: 如何理解货币权力的本质？数字货币如何重塑货币层级与权威分配？
AI.motivation: 国际政治经济学（IPE）现有理论将货币定义为层级、主权、信用和基础设施，但缺乏对结算可重复性以及危机中恢复这种可重复性的权威的解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 网络控制论货币理论（cybernetic monetary theory）——关注支付-结算的重复性、可重复性条件，以及恢复受阻货币流通的元监管权威。
AI.method: 理论构建与历史比较分析：金本位、美元互换体系、可编程货币三个案例。
AI.findings: 货币秩序由可重复的支付-结算能力定义（按面值接受、支付-再融资连续性、结算终局性）；货币权力在某一条件失效时显现；数字货币只是重新分配而非消除层级权威。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补IPE中关于结算可重复性和危机恢复权威的理论空白；将货币秩序重新定义为可重复性问题与权威分配问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解稳定币、存款代币和CBDC的治理差异提供分析框架；指导数字货币时代的货币政策与金融稳定设计。

detail.title: The Per Capita Distribution Disconnect: A Blueprint For Reforming The Law Of Life Insurance

publicationDetails.detailsText: Geo. Wash. Bus. & Fin. L. Rev., Volume 10, Spring 2027

detail.abstract: This Article exposes a problem that undermines the critical concept of donative intent in the context of life insurance contracts and recommends reforming the law as a solution. An emerging issue in the business of insurance is beneficiary designations. Legal scholars last identified defects in the beneficiary designation process over a decade ago. Since that time, no meaningful corrective measures have been taken by business or government. Our research revisits the phenomenon of unintended beneficiary designations through a new study of industry resources and forms used to guide and select beneficiaries. The investigation reveals, for the first time, that the terminology of intergenerational wealth transfers is incomplete and internally inconsistent. Building on this finding, the analysis advances an original perspective on the longstanding and deeply flawed practice of designating beneficiaries-a practice that can result in mistaken payments of death benefits. It further develops a blueprint for reforming the law of life insurance to fulfill policyowner objectives. Drawing on legal and political-economy theories of regulation and financial disclosure, the appraisal offers a deeper account of insurance’s distinctive legal architecture and the federal-state balance of power.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了人寿保险受益人指定过程中“捐赠意图”概念的缺陷，指出受益人指定术语不完整且内部不一致，可能导致身故保险金错误支付，并提出了改革法律以解决该问题的蓝图。
AI.research_question: 人寿保险受益人指定过程中存在的“捐赠意图”概念缺陷是什么？如何通过法律改革来解决这一问题？
AI.motivation: 十多年前学者已指出受益人指定流程的缺陷，但至今未采取有效措施；同时，最新研究发现代际财富转移术语不完整且内部不一致，可能导致身故保险金错误支付。
AI.theoretical_framework: 法律与政治经济学视角下的规制理论、金融披露理论，以及保险独特法律架构与联邦-州权力平衡的理论。
AI.method: 对行业资源与表格进行新的实证研究，分析受益人指定流程的术语与实际操作。
AI.findings: 受益人指定所用的代际财富转移术语不完整且内部不一致；现有受益人指定做法存在深层次缺陷，可能导致死亡保险金错误支付。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次揭示受益人指定术语的不完整性与内部不一致性；提出关于长期存在缺陷的受益人指定实践的新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了改革人寿保险法的具体蓝图，以更好地实现保单持有人的目标；为保险行业和监管机构提供改进受益人指定流程的建议。

title: The Value of a Statistical Life by Race and Ethnicity
affiliations: Vanderbilt University - Law School and Vanderbilt University - Law School

detail.title: The Value of a Statistical Life by Race and Ethnicity

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of Economics, Race, and Policy, Forthcoming

publicationDetails.journalName: Vanderbilt University Law School Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: There is substantial heterogeneity in the rate of compensation that workers receive for fatality risks. The wage-risk tradeoff rate given by the value of a statistical life (VSL) is about $14 million (2022 USD) for workers generally, but it could be higher or lower than the average amount depending on worker preferences and job opportunities. This article finds that Black workers have a VSL below the national average based on several different specifications. The extent of the estimated difference depends on the degree of refinement of the fatality risk measure. Furthermore, the results suggest that Black workers do not face the same wage offer curve as do White workers; instead, Black workers appear to face an offer curve that is both shifted lower and flatter than the offer curve for White workers. In contrast, Hispanic workers consistently have a VSL that is above the national average, and there is no evidence in the full sample to suggest that Hispanics face a different wage offer curve than non-Hispanics. The results are borne out using two different fatality risk measures and based on either the general labor market or restricting the analysis to blue-collar workers only.

AI.tldr: 本文发现美国劳动力市场中，黑人劳动者的统计生命价值（VSL）低于全国平均水平，且面临更低、更平缓的工资-风险报价曲线；而西班牙裔劳动者的VSL高于全国平均水平，且其报价曲线与非西班牙裔无显著差异。这些结果在使用不同致命风险测量指标和不同样本时均稳健。
AI.research_question: 不同种族/族裔劳动者在补偿工资差异（即统计生命价值VSL）方面是否存在系统性差异？这些差异的机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 劳动者因承担致命风险而获得的工资补偿存在显著异质性，但现有研究对种族/族裔维度的系统性差异及其背后的劳动力市场机制（如不同的工资报价曲线）探讨不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 补偿性工资差异理论（hedonic wage theory）、统计生命价值（VSL）框架、劳动力市场歧视理论（工资报价曲线差异）。
AI.method: 基于美国劳动力市场数据的计量经济分析，使用多种致命风险测量指标（不同精细程度的死亡风险数据），比较不同种族/族裔群体的工资-风险权衡率，估计并比较各群体的工资报价曲线。
AI.findings: (1) 黑人劳动者VSL低于全国平均水平，且估计差异大小取决于致命风险测量的精细程度；(2) 黑人劳动者面临比白人劳动者更低且更平缓的工资报价曲线；(3) 西班牙裔劳动者VSL高于全国平均水平，其工资报价曲线与非西班牙裔无显著差异；(4) 上述结果在两种不同致命风险测量指标及不同样本（一般劳动力市场或仅蓝领工人）中均稳健。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了补偿性工资差异理论中种族异质性的具体模式，特别是指出黑人劳动者面临不同的工资报价曲线（既低且平缓），为理解劳动力市场种族歧视的经济后果提供了新的理论证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者评估不同种族群体的健康安全政策收益（VSL差异）提供依据；提示劳动力市场监管和政策干预需考虑种族间工资-风险权衡的结构性差异。

detail.abstract: This paper develops Civilizational Foundations of Adaptive Engineering Project Governance as a standalone research article within the AEGIS / Civilization Engineering Series. The research problem is that modern project management is frequently presented as a professional administrative discipline, while the deeper governance conditions that make large built value possible are older, recurrent, and civilizational. The paper does not argue that ancient or religious material contains modern standards; rather, it asks whether recurring civilizational governance conditions-mandate, authority, covenant, sequencing, evidence, stewardship, trust, maintenance, and public value-can be translated into bounded project-governance variables without historical decoration or theological overclaiming. The contribution is a theory-building and methodological architecture that defines a controlled ontology, measurable variables, diagnostic equations, evidence-mapping rules, falsifiable propositions, scoring discipline, and a staged validation pathway. Mathematically, the paper strengthens the origin layer of adaptive engineering project governance through a normalized built-value conversion index, a civilizational governance state vector, a hidden disorder equation, an evidence-conditioned trust update, and a lifecycle value function. These constructs are presented as calibration-dependent diagnostic models, not as universal empirical laws. The manuscript therefore converts a professional governance problem into an inspectable, testable, and progressively calibratable research object that can support future empirical pilots, digital implementation, and journal-developed extensions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于文明基础的适应性工程项目治理理论架构，将历史文明中的治理条件（如授权、权威、契约等）转化为可测量的项目治理变量，并构建了包含数学模型的诊断体系。
AI.research_question: 现代项目管理中那些使大型工程价值成为可能的深层治理条件，是否可以从文明历史中提取并转化为有限的、可检验的项目治理变量？
AI.motivation: 现代项目管理常被视为一门专业行政学科，但其背后的深层治理条件实际源于更古老、更反复出现的文明基础。现有研究缺乏将这些文明治理条件系统化、可操作化的理论框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 文明治理条件（授权、权威、契约、排序、证据、管理、信任、维护、公共价值）转化为项目治理变量的理论架构；控制本体论；可测量变量与诊断方程体系。
AI.method: 理论构建与方法论架构设计：定义控制本体论、可测量变量、诊断方程、证据映射规则、可证伪命题、评分规则及分阶段验证路径。数学建模包括归一化价值转换指数、文明治理状态向量、隐藏无序方程、证据条件信任更新函数及生命周期价值函数。
AI.findings: 建立了将文明治理条件转化为可检验项目治理变量的理论架构，并构建了五个数学诊断模型（归一化价值转换指数、文明治理状态向量、隐藏无序方程、证据条件信任更新、生命周期价值函数）。这些模型被定位为依赖校准的诊断工具，而非普适经验定律。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将文明层面的治理条件系统性地转化为有限、可测量的项目治理变量；构建了理论构建与方法论架构，将专业治理问题转变为可检查、可检验、可逐步校准的研究对象；为适应性工程项目治理提供了文明基础的起源层理论支撑。
AI.practical_contributions: 为未来实证试点、数字实施及期刊扩展开发提供了可操作的理论工具和诊断模型；为大型工程项目治理提供了基于历史文明经验的系统化评估框架。

detail.abstract: The following paper establishes the understanding of the issue of food waste and the importance it holds in our society. All research was completed combining and checking the validity of multiple sources, in pursuit of a realistic approach to the matter. The solutions found comprise of real products in use that actively combat food waste and assist in the reduction of it, while using cutting-edge technology and innovation that is in line with the modern world and its needs.

AI.tldr: 本文通过综合多个来源的研究，探讨了食物浪费问题及其社会重要性，并提出了利用前沿技术和创新产品来积极减少食物浪费的解决方案。

title: Public-Private Partnerships and Post-Conflict Reconstruction: A Public Finance Perspective
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Public-Private Partnerships and Post-Conflict Reconstruction: A Public Finance Perspective
detail.abstract: This paper examines the use of public-private partnerships (PPPs) in post-conflict reconstruction, considering them from the perspectives of public finance and public management. It draws on lessons from the experiences of the Western Balkans after 1995. The analysis shows that PPPs are not automatically beneficial or harmful in fragile contexts. Their impact depends on how they are designed, sequenced and governed. While PPPs can support reconstruction by mobilising private expertise and capital, this is only possible when public authorities have a clear understanding of the fiscal risks involved and possess the institutional capacity to manage them. It is essential to treat PPPs as instruments of fiscal policy rather than accounting devices in order to preserve debt sustainability and public accountability. The challenge for policymakers and public managers is not to maximise private participation per se, but to ensure that PPPs contribute to sustainable, transparent and inclusive post-conflict recovery. However, post-conflict states exhibit characteristics that undermine the performance of PPPs and, in some cases, make more traditional funding structures more appealing.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了公私合作伙伴关系（PPPs）在冲突后重建中的运用，认为其效果取决于设计、顺序安排和治理方式，而非自动有利或有害。
AI.research_question: 公私合作伙伴关系在冲突后重建中应如何设计、排序和治理，以实现可持续、透明和包容性的恢复？
AI.motivation: 冲突后重建面临资金短缺和公共部门能力不足的挑战，PPP被广泛提倡但缺乏对其在脆弱环境下适用性的系统分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公共财政理论、公共管理理论、财政政策工具视角
AI.method: 基于1995年后西巴尔干地区的经验教训进行案例分析
AI.findings: PPP在冲突后环境中并非自动有益或有害，其效果取决于设计、排序和治理；PPP须作为财政政策工具而非会计手段；冲突后国家的特征会削弱PPP绩效，有时传统融资方式更具吸引力。
AI.theory_contributions: 将PPP分析从"是否使用"推进到"如何设计、排序和治理"的精细化框架，并强调财政政策工具视角对债务可持续性和公共问责的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为冲突后国家的政策制定者和公共管理者提供了PPP运用的风险评估和治理建议，指出应避免盲目最大化私人参与，而应确保PPP服务于可持续、透明和包容性的恢复目标。

detail.abstract: This paper develops Adaptive Engineering Project Governance Beyond Project Management as a standalone research article within the AEGIS / Civilization Engineering Series. The research problem is that traditional project management can maintain schedules, reports, risk registers, dashboards and contractual routines while the verified project governance state drifts away from documented status. The central gap is the divergence between reported project state, evidence state, decision state, pricing assumptions, interface condition and organizational learning state. The paper advances a bounded theory-building and design-science contribution by defining a controlled ontology, transition constructs, normalized variables, diagnostic equations, falsifiable propositions, visual governance topologies, measurement rules, data schema and validation pathway. It introduces asynchronous state divergence, evidence reliability decay, decision-latency absorption, adaptive absorption capacity and learning density as measurable transition constructs that explain why classical project-control artifacts may remain apparently compliant while the underlying governance system deteriorates. The manuscript does not claim universal predictive validity or fixed cross-sector constants. Instead, it establishes a disciplined research architecture that can be tested through timestamped project events, evidence packages, reconstructed cases, platform logs, decision records and longitudinal multi-project datasets. Its contribution is scientific rather than promotional: it converts the professional question of moving beyond document-centered project management into inspectable constructs that can be challenged, measured, calibrated and progressively validated. The result is a peer-reviewable foundation for future empirical research, digital implementation and applied engineering project governance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"自适应工程项目治理"框架，弥补了传统项目管理中实际治理状态与文档报告状态之间的偏差。通过定义可测量的过渡构念（如异步状态偏差、证据可靠性衰减等），构建了一个可检验、可校准的科学研究架构，为超越"以文档为中心"的项目管理提供了理论基础和实证路径。
AI.research_question: 如何解释和度量工程项目中"报告状态"与"实际治理状态"之间的系统性偏离？如何将这种偏离转化为可检验、可测量的科学构念？
AI.motivation: 传统项目管理工具（进度表、报告、风险登记册、仪表盘等）在形式上保持合规，但实际治理状态已悄然恶化。这种"文档合规但治理失效"的鸿沟缺乏系统的理论解释和测量工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 有界理论构建（Bounded Theory-Building）与设计科学（Design Science）；异步状态偏差、证据可靠性衰减、决策延迟吸收、自适应吸收能力、学习密度等过渡构念。
AI.method: 规范化的本体定义、过渡构念、标准化变量、诊断方程、可证伪命题、可视化治理拓扑、测量规则、数据模式及验证路径。通过时间戳项目事件、证据包、重构案例、平台日志、决策记录及纵向多项目数据集进行检验。
AI.findings: 经典项目管理工件在形式上合规时，底层治理系统可能已经恶化；文章提出了五个可测量的过渡构念来解释这一现象，并建立了可检验的研究架构。
AI.theory_contributions: 将"超越文档中心的项目管理"这一专业问题转化为可质疑、可测量、可校准、可渐进验证的科学构念体系；为工程项目治理领域建立了可同行评审的实证研究基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为未来实证研究、数字化实施和应用型工程项目治理提供了可操作的框架、数据模式和验证路径，有助于识别和预防治理漂移。

detail.abstract: Ten years on from the Brexit referendum, we revisit the town of Great Yarmouth to see the extent to which the lives of both EU and UK nationals have changed. Great Yarmouth, a deprived town on the Norfolk coast, experienced high levels of migration in the period leading up to the referendum: the EU migrant population increased by over 200% between 2000 and 2016. It had the fifth highest 'leave' vote in the UK referendum, in part as a protest vote regarding levels of migration to the town. This article considers the impact that Brexit has had on the day-to-day life of EU citizens and British nationals living in Great Yarmouth, their views on the promises made about Brexit and (relatedly) its outcomes. For EU citizens, we examine the application of the Withdrawal Agreement (WA) and, in particular, the EU Settlement Scheme, the scheme to which all EU citizens living in the UK before 2020 had to apply to regularise their continued residence in the UK. We also explore their long-term plans in a post-Brexit world. The research also offers reflections from local residents on the ten years since the Brexit referendum and how they have experienced changes to the town in that time. Focusing on in-depth qualitative data about belonging, this paper offers an important insight into the complex, topical and (still) highly divisive issue, migration. It argues that despite considerable resource being given to the town, widespread dissatisfaction and unhappiness remains. This has manifested itself in part in the election of a Restore MP, Rupert Lowe, with strong anti-migration views.

AI.tldr: 本文通过深度定性数据，回顾了英国脱欧公投十年来，大雅茅斯镇欧盟公民与英国国民的生活变化、对脱欧承诺的看法，以及欧盟定居计划的实际运作情况，发现尽管投入了大量资源，当地居民普遍的不满情绪依然存在。
AI.research_question: 脱欧公投十年后，大雅茅斯镇欧盟公民与英国国民的生活发生了怎样的变化？他们对脱欧承诺及其结果有何看法？欧盟定居计划的实际执行情况如何？
AI.motivation: 大雅茅斯是英国脱欧公投中脱欧票比例第五高的地区，且此前经历了欧盟移民人口超200%的增长。十年后回顾这一代表性地区的实际变化，有助于理解脱欧对基层社区的真实影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 归属感理论；移民与身份认同；脱欧政策执行分析
AI.method: 深度定性研究，通过对大雅茅斯镇欧盟公民和英国国民的访谈获取关于归属感、生活变化和政策体验的一手数据。
AI.findings: 尽管大量资源投入大雅茅斯，广泛的不满与不快乐情绪依然存在，部分体现为反移民立场的改革党议员鲁珀特·洛的成功当选。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过深度定性数据揭示了脱欧后基层社区中归属感与不满情绪的复杂交织，为移民与身份认同研究提供了微观层面的实证。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了脱欧政策（尤其是欧盟定居计划）在执行层面的现实问题，以及资源投入未能消解社区不满的政策启示。
