detail.title: Korea's Evolving FDI Toward the U.S.: A Market—Technology Shift and Policy Priorities

publicationDetails.detailsText: KIEP Research Paper, KIEP Opinions No. 333
publicationDetails.journalName: Korea Institute for International Economic Policy (KIEP) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
The structure of global foreign direct investment (FDI) is shifting. In recent years, the United States has expanded its role within global FDI networks, and investment flows into the U.S. have grown faster than in the past. 

In Korea’s case, the structural change is especially pronounced: outward FDI is moving away from cost-saving, efficiency-seeking investment in developing economies and toward market and technology seeking investment in advanced economies—most notably the United States. This shift reflects firms’ growing emphasis on securing access to large consumer markets, advanced innovation ecosystems, and strategic technologies, rather than primarily leveraging low production costs abroad. (The rest omitted.)

AI.tldr: 全球FDI结构正发生转变，美国在全球FDI网络中的角色扩大，对美投资增长加快。以韩国为例，对外直接投资正从追求成本节约的发展中国家转向追求市场与技术的发达国家（尤其是美国），反映了企业从低成本导向转向市场、创新生态和战略技术获取的战略变化。
AI.research_question: 全球外国直接投资（FDI）结构发生了怎样的变化？韩国对外直接投资的动因如何从效率寻求转向市场与技术寻求？
AI.motivation: 全球FDI格局正在重塑，美国作为投资目的地的吸引力显著增强，而韩国对外投资的结构性转变尤为突出，需要深入理解这一转变背后的战略驱动力。
AI.theoretical_framework: FDI动因理论（效率寻求型投资 vs. 市场寻求型与技术寻求型投资）；全球价值链与创新生态系统理论。
AI.method: 基于宏观FDI数据的结构分析，结合韩国对外投资流向的案例研究。
AI.findings: 韩国对外直接投资正从发展中国家的成本节约型、效率寻求型投资，转向发达经济体（尤其是美国）的市场与技术寻求型投资，反映出企业战略重心从低成本生产转向获取大消费市场、先进创新生态和战略技术。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了FDI动因理论在新兴经济体对外投资结构转型中的应用，揭示了企业投资动机从成本导向向技术与市场导向的演变机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者（尤其是韩国）理解本国企业海外投资趋势变化提供依据；为发达经济体吸引高质量外资的战略定位提供参考。

title: Flexibility Versus Security in Agency Contracts with Moral Hazard
affiliations: University of Toulouse Capitole - Toulouse School of Economics and University of Rome Tor Vergata

detail.title: Flexibility Versus Security in Agency Contracts with Moral Hazard

publicationDetails.journalName: CEIS: Centre for Economic & International Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We study agency contracts where a project owner (principal) privately learns her opportunity cost of continuing the relationship after the agent's effort is sunk. The principal controls the design of termination rights and faces a trade-off between preserving incentives and retaining exit flexibility. Even without legal constraints, fully flexible (at-will), fully rigid (lock-in), and intermediate contracts offering partial security and compensation can all arise at equilibrium. While some contracts may appear to protect the agent, they are always socially inefficient, justifying targeted legal constraints on termination rights. In particular, at-will contracts always under-secure the agent and under-enforce the project and can be banned on efficiency grounds. Inefficiencies also include excessive termination payments and over-securing, suggesting both too much and too little flexibility distort outcomes. Finally, we characterize a minimal mandatory termination fee, as commonly seen in employment protection laws, that partially restores efficiency.

AI.tldr: 研究了委托人在代理人投入沉没成本后私下了解机会成本时的代理合同设计问题，发现完全灵活（随意雇佣）、完全刚性（锁定）及中间合同均可出现在均衡中，但它们都导致社会无效率，并提出了最低解雇费等补救措施。
AI.research_question: 当项目所有者（委托人）在代理人的努力已经沉没后私下获知继续关系的机合成本时，最优终止权合同如何设计？
AI.motivation: 现实中广泛存在的终止权安排（如随意雇佣、固定期限合同、解雇补偿）在信息不对称下如何影响激励与效率，以及法律干预的合理性何在。
AI.theoretical_framework: 不完全合同理论、激励理论、机制设计
AI.method: 理论建模（博弈论与合同理论分析）
AI.findings: （1）随意雇佣合同总是使代理人保障不足且项目执行不足；（2）各种合同（随意、锁定、中间型）均存在社会无效率；（3）无效率表现包括解雇补偿过高和过度保障；（4）设定最低法定解雇费（如劳动保护法常见规定）可部分恢复效率。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了在委托人拥有事后私人信息情况下终止权合同的效率特征，证明了即使没有法律约束，均衡中的合同也必然无效率，为法律干预终止权提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为终止权法律规制（如禁止随意雇佣、设定最低解雇费）提供了效率层面的正当性论证；指出了既有实践（如高额解雇补偿）同样可能产生无效率。

title: Forward-backward Finite-differencing for XVA in Small Netting Sets
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Forward-backward Finite-differencing for XVA in Small Netting Sets
detail.abstract: We give details of a framework for the computation of Expected Positive Exposure profiles and Credit Value Adjustments based on finite-differencing methods. The methodology combines the backward and the forward Kolmogorov equation to generate future exposure distributions from which the various risk measures can be inferred. The framework bypasses the usual difficulties associated with Monte Carlo simulation based approaches and, for small to moderate portfolios, is fast and efficient.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于有限差分法计算预期正敞口和信用估值调整的框架，通过结合后向和前向Kolmogorov方程生成未来敞口分布，避免了蒙特卡洛模拟的常见问题，对小到中等规模的组合高效快速。
AI.research_question: 如何基于有限差分方法而非蒙特卡洛模拟，高效计算预期正敞口（EPE）和信用估值调整（CVA）？
AI.motivation: 蒙特卡洛模拟方法在计算EPE和CVA时存在计算量大、效率低、收敛慢等问题，需要一种更高效且精确的替代方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 前向Kolmogorov方程、后向Kolmogorov方程、有限差分方法（Finite-differencing methods）
AI.method: 结合前向和后向Kolmogorov方程的有限差分法框架，通过偏微分方程求解未来敞口分布，进而计算EPE和CVA。
AI.findings: 该框架能够有效绕过蒙特卡洛模拟的常见困难（如计算负担重、收敛慢等），对于小到中等规模的资产组合，计算速度快且效率高。
AI.theory_contributions: 将有限差分法系统性地应用于EPE和CVA的计算领域，提供了基于偏微分方程框架的替代性理论路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融机构提供了一种高效、精确的信用风险管理工具，特别适用于需要快速计算中等规模组合信用风险敞口的场景。

title: The Contested Era: Backlash, Pragmatism, and Gridlock (1980-Present), Chapter 5, IN Lessons for a Warming Planet: A Vital History of U.S. Environmental Law, by Alejandro E. Camacho and Brigham Daniels, New York: New York University Press, 2026
affiliations: and University of Utah

detail.title: The Contested Era: Backlash, Pragmatism, and Gridlock (1980-Present), Chapter 5, IN Lessons for a Warming Planet: A Vital History of U.S. Environmental Law, by Alejandro E. Camacho and Brigham Daniels, New York: New York University Press, 2026

publicationDetails.detailsText: New York University Press, 2026; UCLA School of Law, Public Law Research Paper 26-25
publicationDetails.journalName: University of California, Los Angeles School of Law, Public Law & Legal Theory Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Every previous era in American environmental legal history featured a dominant current — exploitation or protection — with undercurrents pulling the other way. The Contested Era is different. Since Reagan's inauguration, environmental law has been defined not by a prevailing direction but by turbulence: rapid actions in one direction immediately challenged, reversed, and re-reversed across administrations, courts, and legislatures. There is no dominant wave. There is only churn.
This chapter traces the era from Reagan's theatrical opening appointments — an EPA administrator who slashed the agency's budget and withheld Superfund records from Congress, an Interior Secretary who sought to transfer public lands to private industry — through the Clinton, Bush, Obama, and Biden years, to the second Trump administration's assault on the bedrock of environmental governance itself. The chapter argues that the Trump administrations represent a qualitative escalation: where earlier backlash challenged specific environmental rules, the current moment attacks the institutional infrastructure — the agencies, the expertise, the rule-making authority — that makes environmental law possible at all.

Yet even in an era of gridlock, legal imagination has not been extinguished. Emissions trading programs, negotiated rulemaking, collaborative governance, and the state-level climate innovations pioneered by California demonstrate that the undercurrents are still flowing. "Blue" states and "red" states have each developed legal experiments that may prove to be the next era's dominant models.

The chapter is candid about what remains unresolved: climate change has received woefully inadequate federal policy attention; environmental justice remains the most persistent failure of the American environmental legal system. But the historical record also teaches that the undercurrents of one era become the next era's waves. The open question — urgent, unresolved — is whether the country has the collective will to build them.

AI.tldr: 本文回顾了里根时代至今的美国环境法历史，认为"争议时代"的特征不是某一主导潮流，而是持续的政策震荡与逆流。特朗普时代更从"挑战具体规则"升级为"攻击环境治理的制度基础"。尽管如此，排放交易、协商立法、州级气候创新等"逆流"仍在涌动，未来可能成为主导模式。气候政策不足与环境正义失败仍是未解难题。
AI.research_question: 自里根时代以来，美国环境法经历了怎样的历史演变？"争议时代"的本质特征是什么？特朗普政府的环境政策是否构成质的升级？
AI.motivation: 回应美国环境法史上"争议时代"缺乏系统性理论概括的问题，揭示当前环境治理面临的制度性危机，并探索政策逆流中蕴含的变革可能。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境法史的阶段理论（潮流与逆流模型）；制度变迁理论（从规则层面的政策争夺到制度基础设施的攻击）。
AI.method: 历史文献分析与法律政策叙事，通过对里根至特朗普各届政府环境政策的纵向梳理，揭示政策反复震荡的模式及质的升级。
AI.findings: （1）"争议时代"没有主导潮流，只有持续的政策"翻腾"（churn）；（2）特朗普政府从挑战具体规则升级为攻击EPA、科学权威和规则制定权等制度基础设施；（3）尽管联邦层面僵局，各州（红蓝两州）均涌现出排放交易、协商立法、合作治理等创新实验；（4）气候变化政策严重不足与环境正义的系统性失败仍是两大未解难题。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"争议时代"作为美国环境法史的新分析框架，突破"开发vs保护"二元范式；识别出"制度基础设施攻击"作为环境治理危机的质变标志。
AI.practical_contributions: 为环境法学者和政策制定者提供历史全景图；指出州级创新实验可能成为未来联邦政策的基础；警示当前环境治理面临的制度性存续危机。

title: Gatekeepers Beyond the DMA
affiliations: Max Planck Institute for Innovation and Competition

detail.title: Gatekeepers Beyond the DMA

publicationDetails.detailsText: Max Planck Institute for Innovation & Competition Research Paper No. 26-07
publicationDetails.journalName: Max Planck Institute for Innovation & Competition Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: The article argues that recent EU digital rulemaking has transformed the Digital Markets Act's (DMA) gatekeeper designation into a general-purpose legal trigger beyond its original competition-policy rationale, without systematic conceptualization or constitutional scrutiny. It theorizes this pattern as 'cross-regime status spillover': a formal administrative status created under one regulation migrates into distinct instruments and automatically produces exclusionary or disadvantageous legal consequences that those destination regimes have neither independently justified nor proportionately delimited. Using the Data Act (DA), the Financial Data Access Regulation (FiDA) and the Digital Omnibus Proposal regarding public sector data as case studies, the article reconstructs the DMA's asymmetric architecture and develops a three-step methodology of autonomous regime analysis, DMA rationale portability assessment, and normative gap-filling. It identifies a graduated justification deficit across the three regimes, together with four structural deficiencies. On this basis, the article proposes a cross-regime consistency obligation, a downstream effects assessment for DMA designation decisions, and a standardized rebuttable presumption mechanism, and distils a topical nexus requirement as the doctrinal limit for constitutionally sustainable cross-regime status spillover in EU economic law.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了欧盟数字立法中出现的"跨制度身份溢出"现象：DMA的门槛认定在没有充分宪法审查的情况下，自动扩散至DA、FiDA等数字法规，产生排他性或不利法律后果。文章提出了三步分析方法和四项制度缺陷，并设计了跨制度一致性义务、下游效应评估等矫正机制。
AI.research_question: DMA的"守门人"认定如何跨越其原初竞争政策目的，向其他数字法规溢出并产生自动的法律后果？这种跨制度身份溢出的宪法正当性边界在哪里？
AI.motivation: 欧盟数字立法快速扩张，DMA的守门人认定被移植到DA、FiDA等不同制度中，但这一"溢出"缺乏系统的概念化审查和宪法性审视，可能破坏立法正当性与比例原则。
AI.theoretical_framework: 跨制度身份溢出理论（cross-regime status spillover）；自治制度分析；DMA合理性可移植性评估；规范性缺口填补。
AI.method: 以《数据法》（DA）、《金融数据获取条例》（FiDA）和数字综合提案（公共部门数据）为案例，运用三步法：自治制度分析→DMA合理性可移植性评估→规范性缺口填补。
AI.findings: 识别出三个制度中存在渐变式的正当性缺失，以及四项结构性缺陷。提出跨制度一致性义务、DMA认定决策的下游效果评估、标准化可反驳推定机制，以及"主题关联要件"（topical nexus requirement）作为宪法上可持续的跨制度身份溢出的教义学边界。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统概念化"跨制度身份溢出"现象，构建了识别和评估该现象的规范分析框架，并为欧盟经济法中跨制度法律后果的宪法边界提供了教义学限界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟立法者提供了跨制度一致性义务、下游效应评估、可反驳推定机制等具体制度设计建议，有助于防止数字监管中的不当溢出和正当性缺失。

title: Socio-Economic awareness as Educational Policy in Development Contexts: From Concept to Policy in Morocco
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Socio-Economic awareness as Educational Policy in Development Contexts: From Concept to Policy in Morocco
detail.abstract:
Socioeconomic challenges require individuals and societies to understand economic and institutional processes. This study examines socioeconomic awareness as an educational policy resource in Morocco's development context. It aims to identify its potential effects, including improved resilience, greater formalization, and stronger reform legitimacy, as well as to analyze key constraints such as educational inequality, informality, and low institutional trust. 

The paper adopts a conceptual and policy-oriented approach supported by a comparative review of selected international models (Nordic countries, Germany, Canada, and South Korea) and illustrative descriptive evidence derived from secondary data. Based on this analysis, it proposes a five-pillar educational policy strategy covering curriculum integration, vocational education and training, digital learning platforms, territorial targeting, and institutional monitoring. 

The study suggests that socioeconomic awareness may function as a complementary institutional resource supporting governance and reform implementation. Policy implications include integrating economic competencies into school curricula, expanding dual vocational training, developing digital learning tools for adults, and introducing a monitoring mechanism through the proposed SocioEconomic Awareness Index (SEAI). 

The study is limited by its reliance on secondary data and calls for future empirical validation of the proposed strategy.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了社会经济意识作为摩洛哥发展背景下教育政策资源的潜力，提出了一个包含课程整合、职业教育、数字学习、区域瞄准和制度监测五大支柱的教育政策战略，并建议引入社会经济意识指数（SEAI）作为监测工具。
AI.research_question: 社会经济意识如何作为教育政策资源在摩洛哥的发展背景下发挥作用？
AI.motivation: 社会经济挑战需要个人和社会理解经济与制度过程，本文旨在识别社会经济意识的潜在效果（如提升韧性、促进正规化、增强改革合法性）并分析其关键制约因素（如教育不平等、非正规经济、低制度信任）。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会经济意识作为互补性制度资源，支持治理与改革实施。
AI.method: 概念性与政策导向方法，辅以对国际模型（北欧国家、德国、加拿大、韩国）的比较回顾，以及基于二手数据的描述性证据。
AI.findings: 社会经济意识可能作为互补性制度资源支持治理与改革实施；提出五大支柱教育政策策略（课程整合、职业教育与培训、数字学习平台、区域瞄准、制度监测）及社会经济意识指数（SEAI）。
AI.theory_contributions: 将社会经济意识概念化为一种可培养的制度资源，为理解教育政策如何支持经济发展和治理改革提供新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为摩洛哥及类似发展中国家提出可操作的教育政策战略，包括课程改革、双元制职业教育、成人数字学习工具及SEAI监测机制。

title: The Environmental Era: From Protest to Protection (1960-1980), Chapter 4, IN Lessons for a Warming Planet: A Vital History of U.S. Environmental Law, by Alejandro E. Camacho and Brigham Daniels, New York: New York University Press, 2026

detail.title: The Environmental Era: From Protest to Protection (1960-1980), Chapter 4, IN Lessons for a Warming Planet: A Vital History of U.S. Environmental Law, by Alejandro E. Camacho and Brigham Daniels, New York: New York University Press, 2026

publicationDetails.detailsText: New York University Press, 2026; UCLA School of Law, Public Law Research Paper No. 26-24
publicationDetails.journalName: University of California, Los Angeles School of Law, Public Law & Legal Theory Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
No two decades produced more environmental law than the 1960s and 1970s. This chapter examines the most concentrated burst of environmental legislation in American — and arguably world — history, and asks what made it possible.

The answer lies in a convergence that is difficult to engineer but important to understand. Rachel Carson's Silent Spring provided the scientific foundation. A cascade of visceral disasters — the Santa Barbara oil spill, the Cuyahoga River catching fire, smog alerts blanketing American cities — provided the emotional fuel. The Civil Rights and anti-war movements provided the organizational infrastructure that flowed into the first Earth Day in 1970, when roughly one in ten Americans took to the streets. And an unlikely political dynamic — Senator Ed Muskie and President Nixon competing to claim environmental leadership — provided the legislative opening. Nixon created the EPA and signed the Clean Air Act not out of environmental conviction, but because he refused to let Muskie outflank him. Political self-interest, channeled by a mobilized public, produced transformative law.

The chapter argues that this era demonstrates a recurring pattern in American legal history: disasters plus science plus social movements plus political opportunity can produce "avulsive" change — sudden, flood-like legal transformation, in contrast to the slow accretion of ordinary reform. The legal innovations of this era were genuinely novel in governance terms: citizen suit provisions, environmental impact assessment requirements, strict liability for polluters. These were not just new rules; they were new theories about who could use the law and how.

But the era's high-water mark also accumulated critical failures. Energy policy remained inadequate. Environmental justice was almost entirely ignored. And the gap between legislation on paper and enforcement on the ground would define the next era's struggles.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了20世纪60-70年代美国环境法集中爆发的原因：科学基础（《寂静的春天》）、灾难事件、社会运动与政治机会的罕见汇合，产生了"突发性"法律变革。但同时也积累了能源政策、环境正义和执行差距等关键失败。
AI.research_question: 20世纪60-70年代美国史上最集中的环境立法浪潮为什么能够发生？其背后的驱动因素和运作机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 理解这一罕见但重要的历史汇合点，揭示突发性法律变革的发生条件，为理解法律转型的本质提供理论框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: "突发性变革"（avulsive change）理论：灾难+科学+社会运动+政治机会的汇合可产生洪水般的法律转型，区别于渐进式改革。
AI.method: 历史分析法，考察1960-70年代美国环境立法案例，识别关键驱动因素及其交互作用。
AI.findings: 1. 科学基础（《寂静的春天》）、灾难事件（圣巴巴拉漏油、凯霍加河火灾等）、社会运动（民权运动、反战运动、首个地球日）和政治竞争（马斯基与尼克松的竞争）四重因素汇合。2. 政治自利在动员公众推动下产生了变革性法律。3. 该时期产生了公民诉讼条款、环境影响评估、污染者严格责任等制度创新。4. 同时暴露出能源政策不足、环境正义被忽视、立法与执行脱节等问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并论证了"突发性变革"（avulsive change）这一法律转型模式，即突发、洪水式的法律变革与渐进式改革的对比框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示政治竞争（尤其选举对手间的竞争）可以作为环境立法的意外推动力；指出突发性法律变革虽能产生制度创新，但可能遗留能源政策、环境正义和执行层面的系统性缺陷。

title: Tax Differentials and Team Performance under the NHL Salary Cap
affiliations: and University of Alberta

detail.title: Tax Differentials and Team Performance under the NHL Salary Cap

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors have no financial arrangements that might give rise to conflicts of interest with respect to the research reported in this paper.

detail.abstract: This paper examines how salary-cap constraints may alter the relationship between income taxation and team performance in the National Hockey League following the introduction of the 2005 salary cap. While tax differences exhibit limited explanatory power in the pre-cap era, the relationship becomes stronger following the introduction of payroll constraints. The relationship also appears more pronounced when excluding franchises that consistently operated well below the salary cap ceiling. Consistent with the proposed mechanism, teams located in relatively lower-tax jurisdictions appear to exhibit stronger post-cap performance under salary-cap constraints. These findings suggest that salary caps may increase the competitive importance of after-tax income by limiting teams’ ability to offset local tax disadvantages through higher nominal compensation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了2005年NHL引入工资帽后，薪资上限约束如何改变所得税与球队表现之间的关系。发现工资帽限制了球队通过提高名义薪资来抵消税收劣势的能力，从而增强了税收对球队表现的影响。
AI.research_question: 薪资上限约束如何影响所得税率与职业冰球队表现之间的关系？
AI.motivation: 在2005年NHL引入工资帽之前，税收差异对球队表现的解释力有限；引入工资帽后，球队无法再通过提高名义薪资来弥补税收劣势，因此税收因素可能变得更加重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于税收竞争理论和劳动力市场约束理论，提出工资帽通过限制名义薪资调整空间，增强了税后收入对球队竞争力的影响。
AI.method: 对比分析工资帽引入前后税收差异对球队表现的回归分析，并排除长期低于工资帽上限的球队进行稳健性检验。
AI.findings: 1）工资帽引入后税收差异对球队表现的解释力显著增强；2）排除长期低于工资帽上限的球队后，该关系更加明显；3）低税收地区的球队在工资帽下表现更好。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了工资帽制度作为调节变量如何改变税收政策对组织绩效的影响机制，丰富了税收竞争与劳动力市场规制交叉领域的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为职业体育联盟的政策制定者提供了工资帽对竞争平衡影响的实证依据；为球队管理者在薪资约束下的区位选择（如选址低税收地区）提供参考。

title: Working Through It: Reference-Dependent Effort
affiliations: , University of Michigan, Stephen M. Ross School of Business and

detail.title: Working Through It: Reference-Dependent Effort

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None of the authors have any financial relationship that may have or could be perceived to have influenced this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: NA
declarations.funderStatement: Juin Kuan Chong acknowledges funding from the Social Science Research Council of Singapore (Grant MOE2016-SSRTG-059).

detail.abstract: We examine how unanticipated income shocks shape taxi drivers' labor supply within a shift, focusing jointly on break-taking and shift-ending decisions. Using high-frequency GPS data from 3.4 million shifts and more than 21,000 drivers in Singapore, we distinguish active work from non-work spells while drivers remain on shift, providing a direct measure of within-shift effort adjustment. Consistent with a dynamic model of reference-dependent labor supply, income shocks generate substantial responses along both margins, but the operative margin depends systematically on a driver's position in the shift. Shocks primarily affect break-taking over a broad middle stretch of the shift and affect quitting only as drivers approach their typical end-of-shift time. Break adjustments account for a considerable portion of the total change in labor-supply. Focusing on stopping behavior alone, therefore, understates the magnitude of reference-dependent labor supply responses and makes them appear more concentrated near the end of the shift than they are. The findings show that workers partially absorb income shocks through within-shift effort adjustments well before quitting becomes the relevant margin, with implications for measuring labor supply and designing incentives in goal-directed work settings.

AI.tldr: 本文利用新加坡出租车司机的高频GPS数据（340万班次，2.1万名司机），区分了班次内的主动工作与休息，发现未预期的收入冲击会通过影响司机的休息和提前下班两种方式改变劳动供给。收入冲击对劳动供给的影响取决于司机在班次中的位置：在班次中期主要通过调整休息时间，在接近班次结束时主要通过决定是否提前下班。仅关注提前下班行为会低估参照点依赖型劳动供给的真实调整幅度。
AI.research_question: 未预期的收入冲击如何影响出租车司机在班次内的劳动供给，尤其是同时考虑休息决策和提前下班决策两种调整路径？
AI.motivation: 传统劳动供给研究多关注是否停止工作（extensive margin），而忽略了工作者在班次内通过调整休息强度（intensive margin）对收入冲击的即时反应。利用出租车司机的高频GPS数据，可更准确地测量班次内的实际努力调整。
AI.theoretical_framework: 参照点依赖的劳动供给理论（参考依赖模型），即司机在每日收入目标附近对收入冲击产生非对称的行为反应。
AI.method: 基于新加坡出租车司机超过340万班次、2.1万名司机的高频GPS数据，区分主动工作与休息时段，利用动态模型分析未预期收入冲击对休息决策和提前下班决策的影响，并考察决策在班次不同阶段的差异。
AI.findings: （1）收入冲击显著影响劳动供给，但作用路径取决于班次位置：班次中期主要通过调整休息时间，班次末尾主要通过决定是否提前下班；（2）休息调整贡献了劳动供给总调整的相当大一部分；（3）仅关注提前下班行为会低估参照点依赖型劳动供给的真实幅度，并使调整看起来更集中在班次末段。
AI.theory_contributions: 将参照点依赖的劳动供给研究从"是否停止工作"的单一维度拓展到同时考虑"休息调整"与"下班决策"的双重维度，揭示了工作者在班次中通过调整努力强度来部分吸收收入冲击的微观机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 对目标导向型工作环境（如共享出行司机、零工经济工作者）的劳动供给测量和激励机制设计具有重要启示，提示管理者和平台在设计激励方案时需考虑工作者会在班次内进行即时努力调整。

title: Quantum Field Dynamics of the Petrodollar System under Geopolitical Oil Shocks: Modeling Interest Rate Fluctuations, Global Banking Contagion, and Socioeconomic Phase Transitions
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Quantum Field Dynamics of the Petrodollar System under Geopolitical Oil Shocks: Modeling Interest Rate Fluctuations, Global Banking Contagion, and Socioeconomic Phase Transitions
detail.abstract: We present a quantum field-theoretic framework for modeling the petrodollar recycling mechanism and its response to geopolitical oil supply shocks. The forward interest rate curve is represented as a quantum scalar field on a (1 + 1)-dimensional manifold, coupled to stochastic oil revenue flows. Geopolitical disruptions are modeled as strong external perturbations that can drive the system through a phase transition from a stable "coherent recycling phase" to a high-volatility regime. The model naturally incorporates collective excitations, long-range correlations across maturities, and nonlinear amplification effects. Numerical simulations using Hybrid Monte Carlo methods on a discretized lattice demonstrate that the framework successfully reproduces several key stylized facts of Treasury yield dynamics, including volatility clustering, yield curve steepening, and asymmetric responses to oil price shocks. By coupling the interest rate field to a banking liquidity field, the model also provides a mechanistic explanation for financial contagion during prolonged conflicts. This work bridges quantum physics and financial economics, offering new insights into the interplay between energy geopolitics, monetary stability, and socioeconomic outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个量子场论框架来模拟石油美元回收机制及其对地缘政治石油供应冲击的响应，将远期利率曲线建模为量子标量场，并与随机石油收入流耦合。数值模拟成功再现了国债收益率曲线的若干典型特征，并为金融传染提供了机制性解释。
AI.research_question: 如何用量子场论框架建模石油美元回收机制，以及地缘政治石油供应冲击如何影响国债收益率曲线动态？
AI.motivation: 传统金融经济学模型难以捕捉石油美元回收过程中跨期限的长期相关性、非线性放大效应以及地缘政治冲击引发的相变行为，需要新的理论工具来理解能源地缘政治与货币稳定之间的复杂互动。
AI.theoretical_framework: 量子场论（将远期利率曲线建模为(1+1)维流形上的量子标量场）、随机过程（耦合随机石油收入流）、相变理论（地缘政治扰动驱动系统从"相干回收相"到高波动相的相变）
AI.method: 理论建模：构建量子场论框架；数值模拟：使用混合蒙特卡洛方法在离散化格点上进行模拟
AI.findings: 模型成功复现了国债收益率曲线的多个典型事实：波动率聚集、收益率曲线陡峭化、对油价冲击的非对称响应；通过将利率场与银行流动性场耦合，为长期冲突期间的金融传染提供了机制性解释。
AI.theory_contributions: 将量子场论引入金融经济学，为石油美元回收和国债收益率动态提供了新的理论视角；建立了地缘政治冲击、石油价格波动与利率期限结构之间的数学联系；提出了"相干回收相"到高波动相的相变概念。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解能源地缘政治对货币稳定和金融传染的影响提供了量化分析工具；有助于政策制定者和投资者评估石油供给冲击对国债市场的潜在影响；为风险管理提供了新的建模思路。

title: Converging Echoes: Inter-Model Convergence in Investment Recommendations by LLMs

detail.title: Converging Echoes: Inter-Model Convergence in Investment Recommendations by LLMs
detail.abstract: We examine whether major large language models (LLMs) converge systematically on the same investment recommendations. Eliciting portfolio recommendations from five major LLMs under a fully crossed factorial design varying investor age, risk tolerance, and collection period, we find statistically robust inter-model convergence far exceeding size-matched random baselines (J = 0.243), with intermodel agreement approaching each model's own internal consistency. Capital concentration is extreme: a single fund issuer absorbs 42.2% of all AI-recommended capital allocations, and 50% of recommended capital flows to just 11 tickers representing 4.1% of the universe. The findings provide an empirical basis for regulatory discussions on AI-induced herding risk in retail finance.

AI.tldr: 本文研究五大主流大语言模型在投资建议上是否存在系统性趋同，发现模型间推荐高度一致，资本配置极度集中，存在AI引发羊群效应的风险。
AI.research_question: 主流大语言模型在投资组合推荐上是否存在系统性趋同？
AI.motivation: LLM越来越多被散户用于投资建议，但若模型推荐趋同，可能引发AI驱动的羊群效应，威胁市场稳定性，监管亟需实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: AI羊群效应、模型趋同理论、投资组合集中度分析
AI.method: 全因子实验设计，控制投资者年龄、风险承受能力和投资期限三个变量，从五大主流LLM获取投资组合推荐，计算模型间一致性（Jaccard系数）并与随机基线比较。
AI.findings: 1. 模型间一致性显著高于随机基线（J=0.243）；2. 模型间一致性接近模型自身内部一致性；3. 资本配置极度集中：单只基金吸收42.2%的AI推荐资本，50%资本流向仅占标的4.1%的11只股票。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次实证量化了LLM在投资推荐领域的趋同现象，揭示了AI羊群效应的微观机制，为算法合谋与市场集中度理论提供了新的实证维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构讨论AI引发的零售金融羊群风险提供了直接实证依据，提示需关注LLM在金融推荐中的系统性偏差和资本集中风险。

title: When does AI Increase Labor Demand?

detail.title: When does AI Increase Labor Demand?
detail.abstract: This paper develops a sectoral diagnostic framework for the human task-hour consequences of artificial intelligence. I show that AI's effect on aggregate human task-hours in a sector depends on a transparent accounting threshold: task-hours expand if and only if output growth exceeds the labor saving per unit. Formally, if AI reduces human task-hours per unit by fraction α, total task-hours rise only when Q₁/Q₀ > 1/(1-α). I distinguish two mechanisms through which output can expand enough to cross this threshold. In the price channel, AI lowers task-execution costs, which pass through to consumers as lower prices, expanding demand. The consumer price reduction is bounded by β = τ • s_L • α, where τ ≤ 1 is competitive pass-through and s_L ≤ 1 is labor's cost share; this ensures β ≤ α always. In the latent-demand channel, AI removes access barriers other than price-waiting time, geographic scarcity, capacity constraints-activating demand suppressed by structural rather than price factors. The two channels apply to different sectors. Routine services (customer support, data entry) primarily use the price channel; their required demand elasticities are high and market elasticities are low, predicting displacement. Access-constrained sectors (healthcare, legal aid, education, scientific research) primarily use the latent-demand channel; their latent demand ratios are large, predicting expansion. An illustrative calibration with corrected arithmetic supports these predictions. Beyond expansion within existing sectors, a dynamic accounting condition treats AI-created new sectors, which add human taskhours only when their production remains sufficiently human-intensive-making their birth-time labor intensity θ_L the decisive long-run parameter. The framework is positioned as a diagnostic screening tool, not a welfare model. Policy implications are qualified accordingly.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个行业诊断框架，分析AI对人类任务工时的影响。核心结论是：AI在一个行业中是否增加总任务工时，取决于产出增长是否超过单位任务工时节约的阈值。区分了两种机制——价格渠道和潜在需求渠道，分别适用于不同行业，并预测了哪些行业会被AI扩张、哪些会被替代。
AI.research_question: AI对各行各业人类任务工时的影响机制是什么？何时会扩张、何时会缩减？
AI.motivation: 关于AI对就业的影响存在广泛争论，但缺乏一个系统性的行业诊断框架来区分不同行业受AI影响的差异化结果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 任务工时会计恒等式（产出增长 vs 单位劳动节约）、价格渠道（成本下降→价格下降→需求扩张）与潜在需求渠道（消除非价格壁垒→激活被抑制的需求）的双机制框架、动态条件（新行业诞生时的劳动密集度决定长期影响）。
AI.method: 理论建模（阈值公式推导）、机制区分与行业分类、校准示例验证。
AI.findings: 1) AI降低单位任务工时比例α时，总任务工时扩张的条件是Q₁/Q₀ > 1/(1-α)；2) 价格渠道中，消费者价格降幅β = τ·s_L·α ≤ α，意味着常规服务业（如客服、数据录入）需要极高的需求弹性才能扩张，大概率面临岗位缩减；3) 潜在需求渠道适用于受准入约束的行业（医疗、法律、教育、科研），这些行业存在大量被非价格壁垒抑制的需求，AI释放后任务工时趋于扩张；4) 新行业的长期任务工时取决于其出生时的劳动密集度θ_L。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个简洁的会计阈值条件作为诊断工具，并区分了两种截然不同的需求扩张机制，为理解AI对不同行业的异质性就业影响提供了统一的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和行业分析师提供了一个可操作的筛查工具，用以预判哪些行业可能因AI而扩张就业（如医疗、教育），哪些行业可能面临就业萎缩（如常规服务外包行业），从而更好地引导再培训和产业政策。

title: An Enhanced Composite Green Logistics Performance Index for MENA: Methodology, Drivers and Hybrid Forecasting to 2030
affiliations: and

detail.title: An Enhanced Composite Green Logistics Performance Index for MENA: Methodology, Drivers and Hybrid Forecasting to 2030
detail.abstract: Background: Amid rising trade, urbanization, and carbon emissions in MENA countries, sustainable logistics faces major constraints. This study develops an enhanced Green Logistics Performance Index (GLPI) using min-max normalization and Principal Component Analysis (PCA) to integrate the World Bank's Logistics Performance Index (LPI) and Yale's Environmental Performance Index (EPI). The study uses fixed-effects panel regression on data from 20 MENA countries (2018-2024), identifies key drivers, and applies ARIMA and LSTM models for 2030 projections. The prior ratio-based GLPI suffered from scale sensitivity and volatility; this refined version provides improved stability and predictive utility for Green Supply Chain Management (GSCM). Methods: Panel data from 20 MENA countries (2018-2024) were analyzed. The enhanced GLPI normalizes and weights LPI and EPI scores via PCA. Fixed-effects regression identifies drivers, while ARIMA and LSTM enable scenario-based forecasting (baseline, optimistic, and pessimistic). Results: Renewable energy share positively influences GLPI, while trade openness has a negative effect. Projections indicate the regional GLPI will reach about 0.65 by 2030, with Saudi Arabia potentially achieving 25% higher under optimistic conditions. Conclusions: The refined GLPI advances GSCM theory by operationalizing triple bottom line trade-offs through a robust, predictive metric. It bridges descriptive limitations in prior literature, enabling forward-looking insights into sustainable logistics in emerging economies, with potential applicability beyond MENA.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过改进绿色物流绩效指数（GLPI），运用PCA和固定效应面板回归分析20个MENA国家（2018-2024）数据，发现可再生能源份额对GLPI有正向影响，贸易开放度有负向影响；ARIMA和LSTM预测显示区域GLPI到2030年将达到约0.65。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个更稳健的绿色物流绩效指数（GLPI）来衡量MENA国家的可持续物流绩效，并预测其2030年发展趋势？
AI.motivation: MENA国家贸易、城市化和碳排放上升，可持续物流面临重大制约；先前的比率型GLPI存在尺度敏感性和波动性问题，需要开发改进版本以提供更好的稳定性和预测效用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三重底线理论（Triple Bottom Line）；绿色供应链管理（GSCM）理论；指数构建方法（min-max归一化、主成分分析PCA）
AI.method: 采用min-max归一化和PCA整合世界银行LPI和耶鲁大学EPI构建改进GLPI；运用固定效应面板回归（20个MENA国家，2018-2024）；使用ARIMA和LSTM模型进行2030年情景预测（基线、乐观、悲观）。
AI.findings: 可再生能源份额对GLPI有显著正向影响；贸易开放度对GLPI有负向影响；区域GLPI预计2030年达到约0.65；沙特阿拉伯在乐观情景下GLPI可能提高25%。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过稳健的预测性指标将三重底线权衡操作化，推进了GSCM理论；弥合了以往文献中仅具描述性的局限，提供了前瞻性洞察。
AI.practical_contributions: 为MENA国家及新兴经济体可持续物流的政策制定提供量化工具和预测参考；改进的GLPI具有超越MENA地区的潜在适用性。

title: An Analysis Of How India Stayed Resilient Despite The Mounting Us Tariffs

detail.title: An Analysis Of How India Stayed Resilient Despite The Mounting Us Tariffs

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known financial interests, personal relationships, or conflicts of interest that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.

detail.abstract: The imposition of tariffs by The United States in 2025 , created concerns regarding potential disruptions in the global trade sphere and their impact on developing nations. India, being a significant participant in international trade , faced challenges in sectors exposed to The US market. However , Statistics according to the Economic Survey 2025-2026 , Indian Economy showed a 4.3% year-on-year growth between April-December 2024 and April-December 2025. This report examines the key factors that enabled India to withstand the effects of the imposed tariffs. It highlights the adaptability of the Indian exporters to the tariff shock through a two-path strategy: strengthening trade with existing partners and expanding into new markets. Whi certain sectors like pearls , precious stones , and textiles experienced a decline in exports to the US , other sectors including the marine products and readymade garments successfully compensated by increasing shipments to Alternative destinations. In addition, non-tariffed products such as telecom instruments, particularly smartphones, recorded a significant growth. This demonstrates India’s ability to mitigate external trade shocks and maintain a good deal of stability in an increasingly protectionist global trade environment.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了2025年美国加征关税背景下，印度通过双轨贸易策略（巩固现有伙伴+开拓新市场）有效抵御外部冲击，实现经济持续增长（2024-2025年度同比增长4.3%），展现了新兴经济体在保护主义环境中的韧性。
AI.research_question: 印度如何在美国2025年加征关税的冲击下维持经济稳定与出口增长？
AI.motivation: 2025年美国单边加征关税引发全球贸易扰动担忧，印度作为发展中大国面临出口压力，但其经济数据仍表现强劲，有必要探究其应对机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贸易冲击应对理论、出口市场多元化战略、关税传导与规避机制
AI.method: 基于印度2025-2026年经济调查数据的实证分析，对比不同行业对美出口变化及替代市场表现。
AI.findings: 1）印度通过双轨策略（巩固传统伙伴+开拓新市场）有效对冲关税冲击；2）珍珠、宝石、纺织品对美出口下滑，但海产品和成衣通过转向替代市场实现补偿；3）非关税产品（如智能手机）实现显著增长。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了贸易保护主义背景下发展中国家应对外部冲击的适应性策略理论，提出了"双轨出口缓冲"机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为新兴经济体应对贸易保护主义提供了可操作的策略参考（市场多元化+产品结构优化），验证了灵活贸易政策对经济韧性的支撑作用。

detail.title: Financial stability considerations for monetary policy at the European Central Bank: conceptual framework and quantitative tools

publicationDetails.journalName: ECB: Working Paper Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: The paper documents models used to analyse the interactions and trade-offs between price and financial stability at the European Central Bank. The paper describes a simple conceptual framework to think about the short- and medium-term trade-offs between price and financial stability. Short-term trade-offs arise whenever current inflationary pressure is high, but the financial system is experiencing stress. Medium-term trade-offs arise whenever current inflationary pressure is low, but risk is building up in the financial system. We document four main sets of models used to quantify trade-offs: time series models, balance sheet models, credit risk models and DSGE models with banking and financial frictions.

AI.tldr: 本文记录了欧洲央行用于分析物价稳定与金融稳定之间相互作用和权衡的模型体系，包括一个概念框架和四类量化模型。
AI.research_question: 欧洲央行如何分析和量化物价稳定与金融稳定之间的短期和中期权衡关系？
AI.motivation: 央行同时肩负物价稳定和金融稳定的双重使命，但二者之间可能存在冲突，需要系统性的分析框架和量化工具来指导政策决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 短期权衡（高通胀+金融压力）与中期权衡（低通胀+金融风险积累）的概念框架。
AI.method: 四类模型：时间序列模型、资产负债表模型、信用风险模型、包含银行和金融摩擦的DSGE模型。
AI.findings: 系统梳理了欧洲央行用于量化物价与金融稳定之间权衡关系的模型工具集。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了区分短期与中期价格-金融稳定权衡的概念框架，为理解双重使命冲突提供了理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行政策制定者提供了可操作的量化分析工具集，有助于在双重使命冲突时做出更科学的政策决策。

title: Potential Growth in a Resource-Rich Low-Income Economy: The Mauritanian Case
affiliations: Economist at the Central Banque of Mauritania

detail.title: Potential Growth in a Resource-Rich Low-Income Economy: The Mauritanian Case
detail.abstract: This study offers an updated and contextualized estimation of Mauritania's potential GDP for the period 2014-2024, using four complementary approaches : linear trend, band-pass filter, and production function. The findings indicate a steady increase in potential output, with annual growth rates ranging from 3.2% to 3.7%, which is comparatively lower than the averages observed in Sub-Saharan Africa (4%-6%) or other low-income countries (5%-7%). This moderate potential growth reflects several structural limitations, including a strong dependence on the extractive sector, gaps in human capital, infrastructure deficits, and institutional fragilities. These findings carry significant implications for economic policy : the need to incorporate output gap analysis into monetary policy, prioritize investment in human capital and productive infrastructure, and accelerate economic diversification. Future research could enrich these results by integrating institutional variables, conducting a sectoral breakdown of potential output, and analyzing the effects of energy transition and regional integration on Mauritania's long-term growth prospects.

AI.tldr: 本研究采用线性趋势、带通滤波和生产函数三种互补方法，估算了毛里塔尼亚2014-2024年的潜在GDP，发现其潜在增长率（3.2%-3.7%）低于撒哈拉以南非洲（4%-6%）和其他低收入国家（5%-7%），反映了结构性制约因素。
AI.research_question: 毛里塔尼亚2014-2024年期间潜在GDP的估计值及其增长特征是什么？
AI.motivation: 提供关于毛里塔尼亚潜在产出的最新且符合国情的估算，以弥补相关研究的不足，并揭示该国经济增长的结构性制约因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 潜在产出理论、增长核算框架、产出缺口分析
AI.method: 采用三种互补方法：线性趋势法、带通滤波法（BP滤波）和生产函数法。
AI.findings: 毛里塔尼亚潜在产出稳步增长，年增长率在3.2%-3.7%之间，显著低于撒哈拉以南非洲（4%-6%）和其他低收入国家（5%-7%）的平均水平；潜在增长受限的原因包括依赖采掘业、人力资本不足、基础设施落后和制度脆弱性。
AI.theory_contributions: 为低收入资源型国家的潜在产出估计提供了方法上的比较和案例证据，丰富了发展经济学中关于"资源诅咒"与增长潜力的理论讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议将产出缺口分析纳入货币政策决策，优先投资于人力资本和生产性基础设施，以及加速经济多元化。

title: Multi-dimensional Assessment of Eating behaviour in the Hungarian Adult Population: Motivations, Health–taste Attitudes, and Eating Styles using TEMS, HTAS, and TFEQ-R21
affiliations: University of Debrecen, Szechenyi Istvan University, Szechenyi Istvan University and Szechenyi Istvan University

detail.title: Multi-dimensional Assessment of Eating behaviour in the Hungarian Adult Population: Motivations, Health–taste Attitudes, and Eating Styles using TEMS, HTAS, and TFEQ-R21
detail.abstract:
Background and aims: Eating behaviour patterns are fundamental determinants of chronic disease risk and public health. Hungary faces among the highest rates of obesity, cardiovascular disease, and diet-related mortality in Europe. Despite this, population-level consumer profiling based on validated multi-scale instruments remains limited. This study aimed to conduct a simultaneous, nationally representative assessment of eating motivations, health and taste attitudes, and eating styles among Hungarian adults, and to derive actionable consumer segments for each dimension.

Methods: Two independent nationally representative cross-sectional surveys were conducted: (1) eating attitudes (TFEQ-R21) and health/taste attitude scales (HTAS) were assessed in 2021 (n =1000); (2) eating motivations (TEMS) were assessed in 2020 (n = 1000). Exploratory factor analysis (EFA) and confirmatory factor analysis (CFA) were applied to each instrument. Consumer segmentation was performed using hierarchical and K-means cluster analysis. Sociodemographic differences across segments were explored via chi-square tests and one-way ANOVA. The perceived palatability and healthiness of functional food categories were examined across TFEQ- R21 segments.

Results: The TEMS yielded eight eating motivation factors and five consumer segments: Traditional Simplifiers (17.9%), Frugal Social and Emotional Eaters (19.9%), Balanced Self- Rewarders (27.5%), Health-Conscious (18.3%), and Indifferent (16.4%). The HTAS health subscale produced four clusters, with Health-Conscious Metropolitans (19.8%) as the primary
functional food target. The HTAS taste subscale identified Taste-Oriented consumers (26.9%) alongside three further groups. The TFEQ-R21 confirmed a three-factor eating attitude structure (Emotional Eating, Uncontrolled Eating, Cognitive Restriction; explained variance 57.2%) and yielded five behavioural clusters. Controlled Dieters represented only 20.6% of the adult

population; approximately 75–80% exhibited indifferent, uncontrolled, or emotionally driven eating patterns. Perceived palatability and healthiness of functional foods were significantly higher among Controlled Dieters than other segments (p < 0.05).

Conclusions: The parallel application of three validated eating behaviour scales provides a comprehensive consumer landscape for Hungarian adults. The dominant eating patterns — habitual, taste-driven, and indifferent — along with the limited reach of health-conscious behaviour, underline the urgent need for differentiated public health and food marketing strategies tailored to each segment's psychological profile.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过对匈牙利成年人群进行全国代表性调查，同时使用了三种经过验证的饮食行为量表（TEMS、HTAS、TFEQ-R21），识别出多种饮食动机、健康/口味态度和饮食风格维度下的消费者细分群体，并发现约75-80%的成年人表现出无所谓、失控或情绪驱动的饮食模式，仅有20.6%属于控制型节食者。
AI.research_question: 匈牙利成年人饮食动机、健康与口味态度、饮食风格的多维度消费者特征是什么？能否基于这些维度进行可操作的消费者细分？
AI.motivation: 匈牙利在欧洲面临最高的肥胖率、心血管疾病和饮食相关死亡率，但缺乏基于经过验证的多量表工具进行全国性消费者特征分析的研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 饮食动机理论（TEMS）、健康与口味态度理论（HTAS）、三因素饮食态度结构（TFEQ-R21：情绪化饮食、失控饮食、认知限制）。
AI.method: 两项独立的全国代表性横截面调查（2020年n=1000，2021年n=1000），采用EFA和CFA进行因子分析，使用层次聚类和K-means聚类进行消费者细分，通过卡方检验和单因素方差分析探索社会人口学差异。
AI.findings: TEMS识别出8个饮食动机因子和5个消费者细分群体（传统简化者17.9%、节俭社交情绪化饮食者19.9%、平衡自我奖励者27.5%、健康意识者18.3%、冷漠者16.4%）；HTAS健康子量表识别出4个群体（健康意识都市者19.8%为主要功能食品目标）；TFEQ-R21确认了三因子结构并识别出5个行为群体，控制型节食者仅占20.6%，约75-80%的成年人表现出冷漠、失控或情绪驱动的饮食模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在匈牙利全国范围内同时应用三种经过验证的饮食行为量表进行综合评估，验证了TFEQ-R21的三因子结构在匈牙利人群中的适用性，为饮食行为心理学研究提供了跨文化证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公共卫生政策和食品营销策略提供了基于心理特征的消费者细分依据，明确了功能食品的主要目标群体为健康意识都市者和控制型节食者，建议针对不同细分群体制定差异化的干预策略。

title: Compression Chains and Source-Access Failure: A Conditional Framework for Error-Correction Under Finite Cognition

detail.title: Compression Chains and Source-Access Failure: A Conditional Framework for Error-Correction Under Finite Cognition
detail.abstract: This paper gives a regime-neutral account of a specific failure mode in public cognition: source-starved compression chains can preserve coordination while losing the capacity to correct their own distortions. The argument starts from finite cognitive capacity, a task-relative source-complexity scope condition, non-neutral compression objectives, and the data-processing inequality. Its central distinction is between source-injecting errorcorrection, denoted M5 s , and coherence-only error-correction, denoted M5 c. Coherence checks can improve consistency, decoding, and usability below an information ceiling; only source access can lift that ceiling. Mutual information and task-relative fidelity are kept distinct: the former bounds what a downstream layer can recover, while the latter describes which retained information survives selection. The empirical layer is separated into five numbered premises: P1, fidelity-decoupled or fidelity-adverse selection; P2, counterfeitable provenance cues; P3, channel-specific calibration lag; P4, maintenance-cost asymmetry; and P5, effective chain collapse. The paper does not rank regime types, does not claim that contemporary publics are always chains, and does not offer a predictive model of collapse. It identifies the conditions under which public inputs become source-starved enough for the chain model to apply, and it specifies where the framework can be empirically broken.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种"体制中立"的公共认知失灵模型，聚焦于"源匮乏压缩链"如何维持协调性但丧失纠偏能力，核心区分了基于信源的纠错（M5_s）与仅依赖连贯性的纠错（M5_c），并给出了五个经验前提（P1-P5）来界定该模型何时适用、何时可被证伪。
AI.research_question: 在公共认知中，当信息链条缺乏源头访问时，系统如何在维持协调性的同时积累并固化失真？其失效的边界条件是什么？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多聚焦于特定体制（如民主、威权）下的信息失灵，但缺乏一个体制中立的通用框架来解释"源匮乏压缩链"这一特定失效模式，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 有限认知容量、任务相关源复杂性范围条件、非中性压缩目标、数据处理不等式（Data-Processing Inequality）；信源注入纠错（M5_s）与仅连贯性纠错（M5_c）的区分；互信息与任务相关保真度的分离。
AI.method: 理论分析型论文。通过概念区分（M5_s vs M5_c）、信息论推导（互信息与保真度）、以及五个经验前提（P1-P5）的体系化构建，提供可验证的理论框架。
AI.findings: (1) 仅靠连贯性检查（M5_c）可以在信息上限之下提升一致性和可用性，但无法突破这一上限；(2) 只有信源接入（M5_s）才能抬升信息上限；(3) 提出五种导致源匮乏的条件：保真度脱耦/逆向选择（P1）、可伪造的来源线索（P2）、通道特定校准滞后（P3）、维护成本不对称（P4）、有效链条坍塌（P5）。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 提出了体制中立的"源匮乏压缩链"理论，区别于聚焦特定政治体制的信息失灵研究；(2) 严格区分了"互信息"与"任务相对保真度"，澄清了信息论在公共认知分析中的应用边界；(3) 建立了M5_s与M5_c的二元纠错类型学，为理解信息失真累积提供了分析工具。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 为识别公共讨论何时进入"源匮乏"状态提供了可操作的五条判断标准（P1-P5）；(2) 明确了该框架的可证伪条件，引导实证研究在何处可以挑战或验证该理论；(3) 不推定当代公众总是处于链条状态，避免了过度诊断，为政策干预提供了精确的适用条件。

title: The Floor Is Fuel: Opposition, Victory, and the Metabolism of Ideological Collapse

detail.title: The Floor Is Fuel: Opposition, Victory, and the Metabolism of Ideological Collapse
detail.abstract: Ideologies usually describe themselves as affirmative projects: visions of justice, order, dignity, nation, equality, freedom, or salvation. This essay argues that affirmation often supplies ideological content, but opposition supplies ideological form. A political disposition can exist before it has a name, programme, or stable boundary. It becomes definite when it encounters an object it cannot tolerate. Opposition is therefore not merely one theme among others inside ideology; it is the nucleating event through which latent inclination becomes public shape. The initial image of crystallization must then be corrected. A crystal, once formed, no longer needs the seed that started it. Ideological form is different. It persists only while some potential difference continues to run through it. Ideology is better understood as a dissipative structure: a pattern maintained under throughput, like a flame, whirlpool, or convection cell. This model distinguishes the boundary of identity from the conditions of its persistence. It also explains why victory is dangerous. When an ideology wins, it does not end opposition; it becomes the largest available object of opposition. The gradient relocates onto the victor. Not every victory vanishes into the next cycle. Some defeated prohibitions precipitate into a floor: norms, taboos, and institutional constraints that later actors inherit rather than contest. But floors are metastable, not guaranteed. They can re-dissolve under pressure and become fuel again. The essay treats this recurrence across three scales as a formal homology rather than an empirical identity: individual crystallization, movement mobilization, and regime succession share a structure, but their observable variables differ. It then applies the model to material delivery, identity delivery, party-system change, civic and ethnic nationalism, and totalitarian collapse. Its central diagnostic is not moral preference but metabolic dependence: a nourishing identity can sustain itself without continuously destroying constraints; a steroid identity must keep producing enemies and consuming the floor in order to feel strong.

AI.tldr: 本文提出意识形态的形式由"反对"而非"肯定"塑造，主张将意识形态理解为一种耗散结构（如火焰、漩涡），其持续存在依赖于与对立面的持续张力。胜利对意识形态反而是危险的，因为它会将自身变成最大的反对目标。
AI.research_question: 意识形态的形式结构是什么？"反对"在意识形态形成、维持和更替中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 传统观点将意识形态视为肯定的愿景（正义、自由等），但未能解释意识形态如何从潜在倾向转变为公开形态，以及为什么胜利后的意识形态往往面临危机。
AI.theoretical_framework: 耗散结构理论（Dissipative Structure）、结晶隐喻的修正、形式同源性（Formal Homology）、代谢依赖（Metabolic Dependence）
AI.method: 理论论证与形式推理，跨三个尺度（个体结晶、运动动员、政权更替）进行形式同源性分析，并应用于多个案例领域。
AI.findings: （1）反对是意识形态成形的"成核事件"，而非只是内容之一；（2）意识形态是耗散结构，需持续"吞吐"对立面才能维持；（3）胜利使意识形态成为最大的反对对象，梯度转移；（4）部分被击败的禁令沉淀为"地板"（规范、禁忌），但可重新溶解；（5）区分"滋养性认同"与"类固醇认同"：后者需不断制造敌人、消耗地板才能感到强大。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）将意识形态的形式从"肯定"转向"反对"，提出反对构成意识形态的形式而非仅内容；（2）引入耗散结构模型替代静态的结晶隐喻；（3）提出"代谢依赖"作为诊断意识形态健康程度的工具。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）解释了为何胜利后的意识形态容易走向极化或解体；（2）为分析民粹主义、民族主义、极权崩溃等现实政治现象提供新的形式分析框架；（3）提供区分健康认同与病态认同的诊断标准。

title: A Multi-Ship-Type Case Study : Fuel Efficiency, LNG Adoption, and Carbon Intensity in Maritime Shipping
affiliations: ,  and Tongmyong University

detail.title: A Multi-Ship-Type Case Study : Fuel Efficiency, LNG Adoption, and Carbon Intensity in Maritime Shipping

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Authors declare that there is no known competing financial interest. personal relationships, or affiliations that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is based on secondary data, published literature, reports, and publicly available sources. No human participants, patients, or personal data were directly involved in the research. Therefore, ethical approval was not required for this study.
declarations.funderStatement: Nil- Self-funded

detail.abstract:
Purpose

The maritime industry is increasingly under pressure to cut greenhouse gas emissions while preserving the efficiency of global trade operations. This paper analyzes the effects of alternative energy use and operational efficiency on the carbon intensity of different ship classes. The research uses the International Maritime Organization’s (IMO) 2023 Ship Fuel Oil Consumption Database to examine how far low-carbon fuels, especially liquefied natural gas (LNG), can take the maritime transport sector toward clean and efficient energy use. The study also explores whether fuel transition patterns vary considerably by vessel type and operating architecture.

Design/Methodology/Approach

A multi-ship-type case study focusing on fuel efficiency was adopted. A quantitative case study technique was used, utilizing aggregated operational and fuel-consumption data from reports submitted by 28,620 ships through the IMO Data Collection System (IMO, 2024). In this study, the relationships between fuel composition, carbon emissions, fleet size, and operational efficiency indicators such as the Annual Efficiency Ratio (AER) were examined using descriptive statistics, correlation analysis, and one-way ANOVA.

Findings

The results show that containerships, bulk carriers, and tankers account for the largest shares of global maritime fuel consumption and carbon emissions. LNG carriers showed the highest level of alternative fuel adoption, with LNG representing a substantial portion of their fuel mix. Statistical analysis revealed a negative correlation between LNG use and carbon intensity, indicating that shifting toward cleaner fuels can significantly reduce emissions. The study also identified clear differences in energy efficiency among ship categories, with cargo fleets generally being more efficient than passenger and specialist vessels in terms of both fuel economy and operational carbon intensity.

Practical Implications

The study highlights the need for targeted decarbonization policies in the maritime industry. Instead of adopting a one-size-fits-all approach to sustainability, policymakers and industry stakeholders should implement ship-type-specific strategies that promote fuel switching, technical modernization, and operational optimization. Investments in LNG infrastructure, low-carbon fuel systems, and cleaner propulsion technologies can significantly enhance the environmental performance of global shipping.

Originality/Value

This paper contributes to the growing body of literature on maritime sustainability by providing an empirical, data-driven assessment of fuel transition trends based on recent IMO operational records. Unlike purely conceptual discussions on maritime decarbonization, this research offers statistical evidence on the relationship between alternative fuel adoption and the operational carbon performance of different ship categories. The findings provide practical insights for policymakers, maritime operators, and sustainability experts working toward the transition to low-carbon shipping.

AI.tldr: 本文基于IMO 2023年船舶燃油消耗数据库，分析替代能源使用和运营效率对不同类型船舶碳强度的影响，发现LNG使用与碳强度呈负相关，且不同船型在能源效率上存在显著差异。
AI.research_question: 替代能源使用和运营效率如何影响不同船型的碳强度？燃料转型模式是否因船舶类型和运营架构而异？
AI.motivation: 海事行业面临减少温室气体排放的压力，需要实证数据支撑针对性脱碳政策，而非一刀切方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 清洁能源转型理论、运营效率与碳排放关系理论、船舶分类效率差异理论。
AI.method: 多船型定量案例研究，利用IMO数据收集系统中28,620艘船舶的汇总运行和燃料消耗数据，采用描述性统计、相关分析和单因素方差分析。
AI.findings: （1）集装箱船、散货船和油轮占全球海运燃料消耗和碳排放的最大份额；（2）LNG船替代燃料采用率最高；（3）LNG使用与碳强度呈负相关；（4）不同船型能效差异显著，货船比客船和特种船更高效。
AI.theory_contributions: 基于IMO最新运营记录的实证数据驱动评估，为替代燃料采用与运营碳绩效关系提供统计证据，填补了概念性讨论之外的实证空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和行业从业者提供按船型制定脱碳策略的依据，建议投资LNG基础设施、低碳燃料系统和清洁推进技术。

title: De-localizing the Local Impacts of Trade through Migration: Evidence from Vietnam

detail.title: De-localizing the Local Impacts of Trade through Migration: Evidence from Vietnam
detail.abstract: This paper uncovers a novel channel of the gains from trade that are spatially propagated across the local labor markets through the pre-existing internal migration network. Using the 2001 U.S-Vietnam Bilateral Trade Agreement (BTA), I provide a theory and devise an empirical counterpart to argue for an important contribution of the migration-induced spillover effect from the BTA shock in (i) facilitating the structural transformation away from agriculture and toward industrialization, (ii) improving earnings among the low-educated workers, and (iii) narrowing the skill premium. Importantly, the direct effect of trade on labor reallocation nearly doubles when controlling for the spillover exposure. Further analysis on household spending and regional poverty shows that both direct and spillover exposures improve per capita expenditure for households with low-educated head and effectively reduce poverty incidence, albeit with some differential timing over the short and mediumrun. In particular, while the direct effect reduces regional poverty immediately after the BTA implementation and quickly subsides in the subsequent years, the spillover effect gradually builds up over time and only turns significant by 2008.

AI.tldr: 本文发现贸易收益会通过国内迁移网络在地方劳动力市场间空间扩散。以2001年美越双边贸易协定为例，研究表明迁移引致的溢出效应显著促进了农业向工业的结构转型、提高了低教育工人收入并缩小了技能溢价。直接贸易效应在控制溢出后近乎翻倍。溢出效应在减贫方面具有延迟但持久的特征。
AI.research_question: 贸易自由化的收益如何通过既有国内迁移网络在地方劳动力市场之间进行空间传播？
AI.motivation: 已有文献主要关注贸易对直接受冲击地区的效应，但贸易冲击可能通过人口迁移等渠道溢出至其他地区。理解这种空间溢出机制对于全面评估贸易自由化的福利效应至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贸易与劳动力迁移的空间均衡理论；结构转型理论；技能溢价与人力资本理论
AI.method: 以2001年美越双边贸易协定为准自然实验，构建理论模型并设计实证策略，利用越南国内迁移网络识别贸易冲击的溢出效应。
AI.findings: (1) 迁移引致的溢出效应显著促进农业向工业的结构转型；(2) 提高低教育工人收入并缩小技能溢价；(3) 直接贸易效应在控制溢出后近乎翻倍；(4) 直接效应在短期内立即降低贫困但很快消退，溢出效应则随时间逐渐增强，至2008年才显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出并验证了贸易收益通过国内迁移网络进行空间传播的新渠道，拓展了贸易与劳动力市场空间均衡的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为贸易自由化政策的区域分配效应评估提供了新视角，提示政策制定者需关注贸易冲击通过人口流动产生的间接空间溢出影响，尤其是在贫困缓解和技能差距改善方面的长期效果。

title: Hidden in Plain Sight: Compound Disadvantage of Dwelling Types Within Cape Town Suburbs

detail.title: Hidden in Plain Sight: Compound Disadvantage of Dwelling Types Within Cape Town Suburbs
detail.abstract: The persistence of spatial inequality in South African cities is a direct legacy of the country's colonial and Apartheid past. Approaches to analyse such within-city inequalities have conventionally focussed on contrasting historically advantaged neighbourhoods to erstwhile segregated township areas, which were, by design, kept poorer in terms of access to economic opportunities as well as social goods and amenities. This paper uses the city of Cape Town, and the recently released Cape Town Household Survey 2024, as an illustration of how one can add to extant literature by looking within suburbs, and offer a more nuanced understanding of spatial inequality across the city, from its advantaged suburbs (e.g., Southern Suburbs, Atlantic Seaboard) to the disadvantaged township areas in the Cape Flats (e.g., Mitchell's Plain, Khayelitsha). The survey's stratified design separately samples formal dwellings, additional dwellings informal (ADI, commonly known as backyard dwellings), and informal settlement households within the same suburb. Using this within-suburb variation, the paper presents a Compound Spatial Disadvantage (CSD) index combining three dimensions (basic service deprivation, exposure to negative shocks, and spatial confinement) and decomposes inequality in this index within and between Cape Town's 163 surveyed suburbs. The spatial confinement dimension refines conventional amenity-gap measures by using the absolute level of city-wide facility use as a proxy for effective spatial citizenship, which is the capacity to engage with the city as a whole rather than one's immediate neighbourhood. Estimates suggest that this capacity is uniformly low across Cape Town, and that measured differences in compound disadvantage are driven primarily by service deprivation. The paper finds that 61.7 per cent of total CSD variance lies within suburbs rather than between them, and that informal settlement households exhibit a mean CSD of 0.54 against 0.32 for formal households citywide. ADI and informal settlement households in ostensibly well-serviced suburbs face disadvantage levels comparable to those in the poorest townships. These findings indicate that suburb-level averages mask a city-wide (informal) housing crisis that reproduces spatial disadvantage independently of location, with direct implications for targeted service delivery and housing policy.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2024年开普敦家庭调查数据，构建了复合空间劣势指数（CSD），发现在开普敦163个调查郊区内，61.7%的CSD方差存在于郊区内而非郊区之间，说明郊区层面平均值掩盖了全市范围内的非正规住房危机，空间劣势的再生产独立于具体区位。
AI.research_question: 南非城市中的空间不平等在多大程度上存在于郊区内部，而非仅仅存在于郊区之间？如何通过郊区内部的异质性来更细致地理解城市空间不平等？
AI.motivation: 已有研究主要关注历史上处于优势地位的郊区与被隔离的乡镇地区之间的对比，但忽视了一个关键问题：同一郊区内部（正式住宅、后院附属住宅、非正规定居点）存在显著异质性，郊区层面的平均值会掩盖这种内部差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 空间不平等理论、复合空间劣势（CSD）概念（涵盖基本服务剥夺、负面冲击暴露、空间限制三个维度）、空间公民权概念（以全市范围内设施使用的绝对水平衡量有效空间公民权）。
AI.method: 利用2024年开普敦家庭调查的分层抽样设计（在同一郊区分别抽样正式住宅、附属住宅和非正规定居点），构建复合空间劣势指数，并对其总方差进行郊区内部与郊区之间的分解分析。
AI.findings: （1）61.7%的总CSD方差存在于郊区内部，而非郊区之间；（2）非正规定居点住户的CSD均值（0.54）远高于全市正式住户的均值（0.32）；（3）在表面上有良好服务的郊区中，附属住宅和非正规定居点住户的劣势水平与最贫困乡镇地区相当；（4）空间公民权在开普敦全市范围内普遍较低，CSD差异主要由服务剥夺驱动。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了郊区内部差异的分析视角，弥补了以往仅关注郊区之间不平等的理论不足；引入了"空间公民权"概念，用全市范围内设施使用绝对水平作为衡量指标，改进了传统设施差距的测量方法；构建了复合空间劣势指数，整合了多个维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了郊区层面平均值可能严重误导政策制定，指出服务提供和住房政策应关注非正规住房群体在全市范围内的普遍劣势，而非仅聚焦于传统贫困区域；为定向服务提供和住房政策提供了基于数据的具体依据。

title: Orientational Residue: How Unrepaired Injuries Become Portable Political Grievance

detail.title: Orientational Residue: How Unrepaired Injuries Become Portable Political Grievance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: None
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: This paper asks how a specific social injury becomes portable political grievance. The central claim is that some unrepaired injuries leave behind a low-information, target-specific negative orientation-orientational residue-that can persist after detailed memory of the originating event has thinned. The framework distinguishes three objects often conflated: event-memory (what is remembered), orientational residue (the stance transmitted), and activated narrative (the story later generated under stress). Its load-bearing claim is asymmetric decay: factual content of an injury narrative is costly to maintain and tends to erode, while a target-specific interpretive prior is cheaper to transmit and may persist. Persistence depends on social carriers-language, family transmission, institutions, place, and reinforcing contact-and on carrier density rather than geographic concentration. The framework's strong portability claim is intergenerational: orientation can travel across people who did not directly experience the original injury and attach to later grievances against the same kind of authority. Cross-domain travel across structurally different target types is presented as a related hypothesis, not as demonstrated. Two origination paths are distinguished: injury-derived residue, which skeletonizes through erosion, and mythic or constructed injury narratives, which are assembled for transmission. The article distinguishes acute political entrepreneurship, which converts fresh grievance into rapid political consequence, from latent entrepreneurship, which operates on residue decades later. The framework specifies scope conditions, observable indicators, evidentiary tiers, and falsifiers. Empirical anchors illustrate components of the mechanism with differing evidentiary status, ranging from fullmechanism cases to exploratory applications. The contribution is to specify how political contagion can occur without uniform exposure: a transmissible orientation that makes later stresses feel newly predictive of old expectations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种社会伤害转化为可传播政治 grievances 的机制框架，核心概念是"定向残留"——一种低信息、目标特定的负面取向，它能在事件记忆消退后持续存在并通过社会载体代际传播。
AI.research_question: 特定的社会伤害如何成为可传播的政治性 grievances（怨愤）？
AI.motivation: 解释为什么某些历史创伤能在缺乏详细记忆的情况下持续影响政治态度，以及这种影响如何在不均匀暴露的条件下实现政治"传染"。
AI.theoretical_framework: 提出三个被混淆的对象：事件记忆（记什么）、定向残留（传播的立场）、激活叙事（压力下产生的故事）。核心是不对称衰减理论：事实内容维护成本高易消退，目标特定解释性先验传播成本低可持久。区分了伤害衍生的残留与神话/建构的伤害叙事两种起源路径，以及急性政治创业与潜伏政治创业两种动员模式。
AI.method: 理论建构与框架说明，辅以不同证据层级（完整机制案例到探索性应用）的经验锚定。
AI.findings: 定向残留可以跨代传播（从没有直接经历原始伤害的人身上传递并附着于同类权威的新 grievance），其持久性取决于语言、家庭传承、制度、场所和强化接触等社会载体的密度（而非地理集中度）。
AI.theory_contributions: 在理论上区分了事件记忆、定向残留与激活叙事三个概念，提出了不对称衰减机制，解释了政治传染如何在缺乏统一暴露的条件下发生：可传播的取向使后来的压力感觉像是旧预期的新验证。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解历史创伤的长期政治后果、代际 grievance 传播、以及政治动员的时间窗口（急性 vs 潜伏）提供了分析框架。

title: Perpetual War as an Institutional Configuration: Threat Maintenance, Proxy Selection, and Anchor-Indexed Time

detail.title: Perpetual War as an Institutional Configuration: Threat Maintenance, Proxy Selection, and Anchor-Indexed Time
detail.abstract: Perpetual war is often described as a strategy, an economic arrangement, a security discourse, a juridical exception, or a psychological attachment to conflict. Each description can possibly capture part of the phenomenon, but none by itself specifies the configuration by which non-resolution becomes institutionally selectable. This working paper treats perpetual war as a self-reproducing institutional arrangement in which threat-processing is retained more reliably than threat-resolution. The configuration can emerge without design. Once established, it is sustained by proxy metrics-budgets, operational activity, career advancement, doctrinal fit, political blame-avoidance, industrial lock-in, and security-guarantor legitimacy-that are satisfied by managed threat and threatened by arrival. We then link this selection mechanism to anchor-indexed time. Finite agents do not merely persist; they must inhabit the present as legitimate, meaning structurally admissible as a basis for continued agency. Legitimacy span names the temporal bandwidth by which an identity-constituting anchor can carry displacement before restoration, substitution, or collapse becomes compulsory. Because agents carry layered anchors, legitimacy span is vectorial rather than scalar. Perpetual war becomes durable when a threat is routed to a deep shared anchor and security is re-anchored to an unreachable standard such as invulnerability or "never again." The result is a dual temporal geometry: the threat anchor becomes narrow-span, triggering rapid restoration against ambiguous danger, while principle anchors become wide-span, permitting prolonged drift from law, proportionality, constitutional restraint, and declared political ideals. The paper specifies the mechanism, observable implications, exit conditions, and falsification conditions for this configuration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"永久战争"是一种自我再生产的制度安排，其中威胁处理（threat-processing）比威胁解决（threat-resolution）更可靠地被保留。通过代理指标和锚定时间机制，这一配置得以持续，并形成了双重时间几何：威胁锚窄跨度，原则锚宽跨度。
AI.research_question: 为什么"永久战争"这种非解决冲突的制度配置能够持续存在并自我再生产？其背后的选择机制和时间结构是什么？
AI.motivation: 现有文献将永久战争描述为策略、经济安排、安全话语、法律例外或心理依附，但每种描述只捕捉了现象的一部分，未能说明"不解决"如何成为制度上可选择的配置。本文试图提供一个统一的理论机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度自我再生产理论、锚定时间理论（anchor-indexed time）、合法性跨度（legitimacy span）概念、代理指标（proxy metrics）选择机制。
AI.method: 理论性工作论文，通过概念建构和机制设计提出分析框架，并指定可观测含义、退出条件和证伪条件。
AI.findings: 永久战争通过代理指标（预算、操作活动、职业晋升、教义契合、政治避责、产业锁定、安全保障者合法性）得以维持，这些指标由管理中的威胁满足，由真正解决威胁。威胁锚定到深层共享锚点，安全重新锚定到不可达到的标准（如无懈可击或"永不再发生"），形成双重时间几何。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"合法性跨度"这一时间分析概念，将制度选择机制与时间锚定理论连接，揭示了永久战争的双重时间几何结构。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解战争持续、安全政策僵化、宪法约束漂移等现象提供了分析工具，并明确了退出条件和证伪条件，有助于政策设计和制度批判。

title: The Price of Delay: Prescription Drug Spending Increases Associated with Delayed Generic Entry
affiliations: , IQVIA and IQVIA

detail.title: The Price of Delay: Prescription Drug Spending Increases Associated with Delayed Generic Entry

declarations.ethicsApproval: Institutional Review Board Statement: This study used de-identified secondary data and did not involve direct interaction with human subjects. Under applicable federal regulations, the study did not constitute human subjects research and did not require institutional review board approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported by the Coalition Against Pharma Patent Abuse (no grant number). The authors have no other conflicts of interest.

detail.abstract: Importance: Prescription drug spending remains one of the fastest-growing components of U.S. healthcare expenditures. Although the Inflation Reduction Act aims to reduce prices for brand-name drugs, the financial benefits of generic entry remain critical for ensuring affordability and sustainable pharmaceutical market competition. Objective: To quantify healthcare cost savings associated with the loss of market exclusivity (LoE) for high-volume small-molecule drugs and to estimate the impact of delayed generic entry on prescription drug spending by payer type. Design: A modeling study using historical data to forecast drug volume, price, and payer distribution before and after generic entry. Scenarios modeled 12-, 24-, and 36-month delays in LoE to estimate foregone cost savings.

AI.tldr: 本文量化了小分子药物失去市场独占权（LoE）后的医疗成本节约，并评估了仿制药延迟上市对不同支付方处方药支出的影响。研究发现，仿制药的及时进入可显著降低药物支出，而延迟上市则导致大量可避免的医疗成本增加。
AI.research_question: 小分子药物失去市场独占权（LoE）后能为医疗系统带来多少成本节约？仿制药延迟上市（12、24、36个月）对不同支付方（如政府、商业保险、患者）的处方药支出有何影响？
AI.motivation: 处方药支出是美国医疗支出增长最快的部分之一。虽然《通胀削减法案》旨在降低品牌药价格，但仿制药进入市场的财务效益对于确保可负担性和可持续的药品市场竞争仍然至关重要。量化这些节约并评估延迟仿制药进入的成本，有助于为政策制定提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场独占权与仿制药竞争理论：品牌药在失去市场独占权后，仿制药进入将导致价格大幅下降，从而产生成本节约。延迟进入则意味着消费者和支付方在此期间继续支付高价。
AI.method: 模型研究：使用历史数据预测仿制药进入前后的药物用量、价格及支付方分布。模拟了12个月、24个月和36个月的LoE延迟情景，以估算被放弃的成本节约。
AI.findings: 仿制药及时进入可显著降低药物支出；延迟上市（尤其36个月）会导致大量可避免的成本增加，不同支付方（政府、商业保险、患者）受影响的金额不同。
AI.theory_contributions: 为市场独占权与仿制药竞争的经济学理论提供了量化证据，展示了延迟仿制药进入对医疗系统的具体财务影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者（如FDA、CMS）优化仿制药审批和上市流程提供数据支持，帮助评估缩短仿制药延迟上市的经济价值，从而促进药品可负担性和市场竞争。

title: Central Bank Digital Currencies and Algorithmic Governance: Institutional Convergence and Regulatory Autonomy in Kazakhstan and Uzbekistan

detail.title: Central Bank Digital Currencies and Algorithmic Governance: Institutional Convergence and Regulatory Autonomy in Kazakhstan and Uzbekistan

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced the work reported in this paper. This study was conducted independently and reflects the academic research interests of the author in the fields of institutional economics and digital monetary governance.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study involved the analysis of publicly available legislative documents, central bank policy roadmaps, and official technical reports. As the research did not involve human participants, clinical trials, or private data collection, formal ethics committee approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This paper analyzes the institutional implications of central bank digital currency (CBDC) adoption in Central Asia through a detailed comparative study of Kazakhstan's digital tenge pilots and Uzbekistan's digital sum roadmap. Employing the conceptual framework of "algorithmic institutionalism," the study investigates whether CBDC implementation functions primarily as a domestic policy instrument or as a driver of convergence toward supranational digital monetary standards promoted by the Bank for International Settlements (BIS) and the International Monetary Fund (IMF). Based on policy documents, central bank reports, pilot data, technical standards, and empirical indicators from 2025-2026, the analysis reveals the emergence of algorithmic governance, where programmable monetary features and algorithmdriven compliance mechanisms increasingly shape regulatory practice and potentially constrain discretionary flexibility. The findings indicate that while CBDCs offer notable benefits in transparency, reduced corruption, and improved public expenditure management, this process may simultaneously involve trade-offs, such as architectural alignment with global technical protocols (ISO 20022, BIS unified ledger protocols). This alignment tends to result in a partial erosion of regulatory autonomy and drives a reprioritization of human capital competencies toward operational and technical roles. The paper contributes to debates on monetary sovereignty and digital governance by developing algorithmic institutionalism as an analytical framework for understanding the interplay between technological infrastructure and state authority in emerging economies.

AI.tldr: 本文通过比较哈萨克斯坦数字坚戈试点与乌兹别克斯坦数字苏姆路线图，运用"算法制度主义"分析框架，研究央行数字货币（CBDC）在中亚地区的制度影响，发现CBDC在提升透明度、减少腐败的同时，也因与国际技术标准对齐而导致监管自主权部分丧失和人力资本结构转型。
AI.research_question: CBDC在中亚地区的实施究竟是作为国内政策工具，还是推动向国际清算银行和国际货币基金组织所倡导的超国家数字货币标准趋同的驱动力？
AI.motivation: 中亚国家正处于CBDC探索前沿，但其制度影响尚未得到充分研究，特别是涉及技术基础设施与国家主权之间张力的理论分析不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 算法制度主义（Algorithmic Institutionalism）——分析技术基础设施与国家权威之间相互作用的概念框架。
AI.method: 基于2025-2026年的政策文件、央行报告、试点数据、技术标准和实证指标的详细比较案例研究。
AI.findings: 1) 算法治理正在兴起，可编程货币特性和算法驱动的合规机制日益塑造监管实践并限制自由裁量权；2) CBDC带来透明度提升、腐败减少和公共支出管理改善等益处；3) 与国际技术协议（ISO 20022、BIS统一账本协议）对齐导致监管自主权部分丧失；4) 人力资本能力向操作和技术角色重新优先排序。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并发展了"算法制度主义"这一分析框架，用于理解新兴经济体中技术基础设施与国家权威之间的复杂互动，丰富了货币主权和数字治理的理论对话。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中亚及其他新兴经济体在采纳CBDC时权衡效率提升与监管自主权保护提供了政策参考，提示决策者关注技术标准化对制度自主性的潜在侵蚀效应。

title: How Bitter Is the Pill?State-Dependent Sacrifice Ratios in a Small Open Economy: Evidence from Türkiye
affiliations: Sabanci University

detail.title: How Bitter Is the Pill?State-Dependent Sacrifice Ratios in a Small Open Economy: Evidence from Türkiye
detail.abstract: The cost of disinflation is not a fixed number: it depends on the inflation regime, the credibility of policy, and the open-economy channels through which monetary tightening affects prices. Using monthly Turkish data from 2006 to 2026, this paper studies this state dependence through a state-dependent Phillipscurve framework. I show that the Phillips curve is statistically flat in low-inflation periods, making the implied sacrifice ratio effectively uninformative. In high-inflation periods, however, the inflation-slack relationship becomes much steeper, implying an unemployment sacrifice ratio of about 0.4-0.7 percentage points of the unemployment-rate gap per percentage point of disinflation. Residualized Phillips curves and expectations-augmented specifications show that this steepening is not simply driven by inflation persistence, expectations, or imported costs. The results suggest a conditional view of disinflation: the early phase may be relatively cheap when credibility stabilizes the exchange rate and lowers inflation expectations, but the cost can rise if services inflation, dollarization, indexation, and FX balance-sheet risks keep inflation persistent even as activity slows.

AI.tldr: 本文利用土耳其2006-2026年月度数据，通过状态依赖菲利普斯曲线框架发现：低通胀时期曲线平坦，牺牲率无参考价值；高通胀时期曲线陡峭，失业牺牲率约为0.4-0.7个百分点。早期通胀治理成本较低（汇率稳定+预期下降），但若服务业通胀、美元化、指数化及外汇资产负债表风险持续存在，后期成本将上升。
AI.research_question: 反通胀的成本是否因通胀制度、政策可信度和开放经济渠道的不同而呈现状态依赖性？具体而言，土耳其在低通胀与高通胀时期，菲利普斯曲线的斜率（即通胀与产出缺口/失业缺口的关系）如何变化？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为反通胀的牺牲率是固定不变的，但土耳其通胀波动剧烈、政策可信度变化大且开放经济特征显著，为检验反通胀成本的状态依赖性提供了理想场景。此外，现有文献对新兴市场高通胀环境下菲利普斯曲线形状的研究不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 状态依赖菲利普斯曲线（State-dependent Phillips curve）；预期增广菲利普斯曲线；牺牲率概念；开放经济宏观经济学（汇率传递、美元化、外汇风险）。
AI.method: 使用土耳其2006-2026年月度数据，采用状态依赖菲利普斯曲线框架进行回归分析，区分低通胀和高通胀两个体制。通过残差化菲利普斯曲线和预期增广模型进行稳健性检验，排除通胀持续性、预期和进口成本等替代解释。
AI.findings: （1）低通胀时期菲利普斯曲线统计上平坦，牺牲率无信息价值；（2）高通胀时期曲线显著陡峭，失业牺牲率约为0.4-0.7个百分点（失业率缺口每降低1个百分点可降低约1.4-2.5个百分点的通胀）；（3）陡峭化并非由通胀持续性、预期或进口成本驱动；（4）反通胀成本具有条件性：早期（汇率稳定+预期下降）成本较低，后期（服务业通胀、美元化、指数化、外汇风险持续）成本上升。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了反通胀成本的条件性观点，挑战了牺牲率为固定常数的传统假设；将状态依赖菲利普斯曲线应用于新兴市场高通胀环境，拓展了宏观经济学理论在异质性通胀体制下的适用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为新兴市场央行提供了反通胀政策时机与成本的实用指导：早期治理应利用汇率稳定与预期管理降低短期成本，同时需警惕服务业通胀、美元化、指数化和外汇风险等结构性因素导致后期成本攀升。

title: The Topology of Economic Fragmentation: Semantic Anti-Agglomeration and Structural Lock-ins in the South African Labour Market
affiliations: and

detail.title: The Topology of Economic Fragmentation: Semantic Anti-Agglomeration and Structural Lock-ins in the South African Labour Market
detail.abstract: Structural transformation, defined as the continuous relocation of labour and capital across economic sectors, remains the primary driver of long-run development and regional prosperity. In contemporary settings, multiple rapid technological transitions occur simultaneously, rendering broad macro-statistics increasingly insufficient for capturing the granular shifts in industrial evolution. To address this gap, recent literature in economic complexity characterises economies as networks where the proximity of industries captures shared productive capabilities, skills, and technologies. This paper operationalises a "genotypic" variant of this perspective by using Sentence-BERT transformers to compute pairwise semantic similarity directly from official industrial classification descriptions, creating a high-resolution "Semantic Space". Projecting sectoral employment data onto this semantic space allows us to view the labour market as networks at different levels of sectoral and spatial aggregation. While theory suggests that growth should propagate along semantically proximate edges through localised knowledge spillovers, cities of the global South face a structural transformation paradox: the sectors that grow do not appear to draw their nearest industrial neighbours along with them, even when those neighbours share deep operational and cognitive similarities. This paper examines that paradox empirically in the South African context, testing whether the near-zero semantic autocorrelation of labour market transitions observed at the national level is, as theory would predict, an artefact of spatial aggregation that dissolves when the analysis is disaggregated to the municipal and intra-city scales. We find that spatial disaggregation fails to surface the predicted positive autocorrelation, with the semantic Moran's I shifting toward more negative values-from +0.004 nationally to-0.035 at the intra-city scale. These results reveal a structural feature we term "semantic anti-agglomeration," where semantically proximate sectors systematically diverge in employment growth due to competitive substitution, structural lock-in, and extreme spatial fragmentation. Such findings demonstrate that in highly unequal urban systems, physical and semantic proximity are doubly decoupled: conceptually adjacent industries fail to co-locate, and even when they do, institutional barriers prevent them from translating that proximity into shared dynamics. Ultimately, this research implies that standard cluster-based industrial policies are unlikely to function without first addressing the underlying urban substrates-such as transport and housing-that allow economic geography to become economic opportunity.

AI.tldr: 本文利用Sentence-BERT计算南非行业分类描述的语义相似性，构建高分辨率"语义空间"分析劳动市场网络。研究发现，在南非城市系统中，语义相近的行业并未出现预期的共同增长，反而表现出"语义反集聚"现象——语义邻近的部门因竞争替代、结构锁定和空间碎片化而系统性分化。这表明标准集群产业政策在不解决交通和住房等城市基础设施问题的情况下难以奏效。
AI.research_question: 南非劳动市场中，行业间语义邻近性是否与就业增长的共同变化相关？这种关联在从国家尺度分解到城市内部尺度时是否会显现？
AI.motivation: 全球南方城市面临"结构转型悖论"：理论上增长应沿语义邻近的行业边界通过知识溢出传播，但实际上增长部门并未带动其近邻行业共同增长。作者旨在实证检验这一悖论，并探究空间聚合尺度对结果的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济复杂性理论（行业邻近性网络）、语义空间与知识溢出理论、结构转型理论、空间集聚与反集聚理论
AI.method: 使用Sentence-BERT变换器计算南非官方工业分类描述的语义相似性，构建"语义空间"；将部门就业数据投射到该语义空间；在不同空间尺度（国家、城市、城市内部）计算语义Moran's I以测度语义自相关性。
AI.findings: 空间分解并未产生预期的正自相关，语义Moran's I从国家层面的+0.004降至城市内部尺度的-0.035；发现了"语义反集聚"现象，即语义邻近的部门在就业增长上系统性分化，原因包括竞争替代、结构锁定和极端空间碎片化。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"语义反集聚"（semantic anti-agglomeration）这一新概念，揭示了高度不平等城市系统中物理邻近性与语义邻近性的双重脱耦机制，丰富了经济复杂性与结构转型理论在发展中国家语境下的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 对政策制定者的启示：传统的产业集群政策在不解决交通、住房等城市基础设施问题的情况下无法有效发挥作用；需要先构建"基础城市基底"才能使经济地理转化为经济机会。

title: Priced in or Passed Through? Carbon Intensity and the Cost of Debt in European Electric Utilities, 2015-2024
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Priced in or Passed Through? Carbon Intensity and the Cost of Debt in European Electric Utilities, 2015-2024
detail.abstract: I examine whether carbon intensity is priced into the implied cost of debt of European electric utilities over 2015-2024. Using a hand-matched panel of 30 listed firms (174 firm-year observations) and a two-way fixed-effects design that absorbs all time-invariant firm characteristics and aggregate macro-financial shocks, I find that lagged log Scope 1 carbon intensity is associated with a statistically insignificant and imprecisely estimated change in the implied cost of debt (β = 0.0096, cluster-robust SE = 0.018, 𝑝 = 0.59). The result is robust to seven alternative specifications, including a forwardintensity placebo. The point estimate is similar in magnitude to the 26 bp per-standard-deviation carbon premium documented in euro-area corporate bonds (de Jonge, Broeders, and Rijsbergen, 2025), but the cluster-robust standard error yields a 95% confidence interval that spans both zero and literature-sized effects. The most plausible reading is that sector-specific homogeneity in transition-risk exposure within an EU ETS-exposed sector compresses the within-sector variation that lenders would otherwise price; the design's modest statistical power nevertheless means this interpretation cannot be cleanly separated from a literature-sized within-sector premium that the sample is too small to detect.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了欧洲电力公司碳排放强度是否影响其隐含债务成本（2015-2024年）。基于30家上市公司的手工匹配面板数据（174个公司-年观测值），采用双向固定效应模型，发现Scope 1碳强度与隐含债务成本之间统计上不显著（β=0.0096, p=0.59）。结果稳健，但统计功效有限，无法区分"碳溢价为零"与"样本量过小无法检测"两种解释。
AI.research_question: 欧洲电力公用事业公司的碳强度是否被定价进其隐含债务成本中？
AI.motivation: 已有文献发现欧元区公司债存在碳溢价（碳强度越高，信用利差越大），但该效应是否存在于银行主导的欧洲电力行业债务融资中尚不明确。电力行业受EU ETS直接约束，行业内转型风险暴露具有同质性，可能压缩了贷款人本应定价的碳差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 碳风险定价理论（碳强度作为转型风险代理变量）；隐含债务成本（implied cost of debt）衡量企业融资成本；EU ETS制度约束下的行业同质性效应。
AI.method: 手工匹配面板数据（30家上市公司，174个观测值，2015-2024年）；双向固定效应模型（吸收所有时间不变的公司特征和宏观金融冲击）；因变量为隐含债务成本，核心自变量为滞后一期的对数Scope 1碳强度；报告聚类稳健标准误；进行7种替代规格检验（包括前瞻碳强度安慰剂检验）。
AI.findings: 滞后Scope 1碳强度与隐含债务成本之间统计不显著（β=0.0096, 聚类稳健SE=0.018, p=0.59）。点估计值与文献中26 bp/标准差碳溢价大小相近，但95%置信区间包含零和文献效应量。7种替代规格下结果稳健。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了碳风险定价在不同融资渠道（债券市场vs银行贷款）和不同行业结构下的异质性；提出"行业同质性压缩碳定价差异"的理论机制；强调统计功效不足时无法区分"零效应"与"低检测力"的理论推断困境。
AI.practical_contributions: 对监管者：EU ETS覆盖行业中碳定价可能不通过债务成本渠道传导；对投资者和银行：行业内部碳强度差异可能不足以驱动差异化贷款定价；对研究者：提供小型面板数据下碳定价检验的方法论借鉴（效应量、置信区间与统计功效的谨慎解读）。

title: Machines Against Workers? The Heterogeneous Impact of Robots on Union Strength
affiliations: and Duke University - Department of Political Science

detail.title: Machines Against Workers? The Heterogeneous Impact of Robots on Union Strength

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors have no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: No human subjects.

detail.abstract: Does the increasing automation of the workplace weaken labor unions? The dominant hypothesis in current political economy research is that automation weakens unions and, as a result, undermines worker voice in democratic politics. However, the standard economic theory of automation does not consider unions, and recent political science studies focus on estimating average effects. We argue that the relationship between automation and organized labor is heterogeneous. We integrate task-based automation into a model of strategic worker mobilization and collective bargaining. Our new model suggests that automation can disempower but also empower unions.
