Empirically, we use quantile instrumental variable regression and find that the impact of robotization on unionization significantly varies across regional labor markets in the US. Consistent with the theoretical perspective, this heterogeneity is mostly due to unobserved characteristics. Our results suggest that research on the political economy impacts of automation should pay more attention to strategic worker mobilization.

AI.tldr: 该论文挑战了"自动化必然削弱工会"的主流观点，提出自动化对工会的影响具有异质性——既可能削弱也可能增强工会力量，并通过美国区域劳动力市场的量化分析验证了这一理论。
AI.research_question: 自动化（机器人化）对工会组织力量的影响是同质的还是异质的？如果是异质的，这种异质性如何产生？
AI.motivation: 现有政治经济学研究的主流假设认为自动化削弱工会，但标准经济学理论未考虑工会角色，政治学实证研究也只关注平均效应。作者认为这是一种过度简化，忽略了自动化与工会关系的复杂性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 任务导向型自动化模型 + 战略性工人动员与集体谈判模型。整合二者提出：自动化通过改变工人的议价能力和集体行动的战略条件，既可能弱化也可能强化工会力量。
AI.method: 分位数工具变量回归（Quantile Instrumental Variable Regression），使用美国区域劳动力市场数据，分析机器人化对工会化率在分布不同位置的影响差异。
AI.findings: 机器人化对工会化率的影响在美国各区域劳动力市场之间存在显著差异（异质性显著）；这种异质性主要归因于不可观测的特征，符合理论预期（即取决于当地工人动员和谈判的具体情境）。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 挑战并修正了"自动化必然削弱工会"的主流假设，提出异质性影响的理论框架；2. 将战略性工人动员引入自动化政治经济学分析，丰富了相关理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提醒政策制定者和工会组织：自动化对工人的影响并非单一负面，需结合具体情境制定应对策略；2. 建议研究者关注工会的战略性动员能力，而非仅关注自动化的平均效应。

title: Climate Variability, Adaptation, and Mitigation in Semi-Arid Sudan: Meteorological Trends and Multi-Sector Strategies in Gadarif State
affiliations: Ahfad University for Women and University of Khartoum - Institute of Environmental Studies

detail.title: Climate Variability, Adaptation, and Mitigation in Semi-Arid Sudan: Meteorological Trends and Multi-Sector Strategies in Gadarif State

declarations.ethicsApproval: the research is about human perception of natural resources change due to environmental variables
declarations.funderStatement: no body

detail.abstract: This study was carried in Elgadarif state (central Sudan) with the objective to explore the effect of climate variability on adaptation and mitigation of the different sectors. A questionnaire was carried for key persons experienced in the different fields as agriculture, rangelands, livestock, water etc. Meteorological data for rainfall, temperature and relative humidity were obtained from a Meteorological station in the area. The results showed that despite positive ecological signals, field discussions identified persistent challenges in rangeland degradation, livestock management, water governance, agricultural productivity, and food security. Meteorological analysis showed a slight but statistically significant cooling trend (-0.087 °C per year, p < 0.05), a moderate increase in rainfall (+2.79 mm per year, p < 0.05), and a strong upward trend in relative humidity (+0.76 % per year, p < 0.001). Correlation analysis confirmed inverse relationships between temperature and humidity, and a positive association between rainfall and atmospheric moisture. Collectively, these trends suggest gradual climatic stabilization and improved environmental conditions across the region. Effective adaptation requires integrated land-use planning, institutional strengthening, community participation, and the application of climate-smart agricultural and water management practices. It is concluded that the synergy of remote-sensing indicators and meteorological data underscores the potential for sustainable resource management and enhanced adaptive capacity under changing climate conditions.

AI.tldr: 本研究调查了苏丹东部加达里夫州的气候变异对各个部门适应和减缓的影响。研究发现尽管有积极的生态信号（轻微降温、降雨增加、湿度上升），但实地讨论仍指出牧场退化、水资源管理、农业生产力和粮食安全等方面的持续挑战。有效适应需要综合土地利用规划、制度强化和气候智能型农业实践。
AI.research_question: 气候变异如何影响苏丹加达里夫州不同部门的适应与减缓策略？
AI.motivation: 苏丹东部地区面临气候变化带来的多重压力，但关于该地区气候变异对不同部门（农业、牧场、畜牧业、水资源等）适应和减缓能力的综合影响研究不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 气候变异与适应减缓理论；气候-生态关联分析框架
AI.method: 问卷调查（面向农业、牧场、畜牧业、水资源等领域专家）+ 气象站气象数据（降雨、温度、相对湿度）分析 + 相关性分析
AI.findings: 1) 轻微但显著的降温趋势（-0.087°C/年）；2) 降雨量适度增加（+2.79 mm/年）；3) 相对湿度显著上升（+0.76%/年）；4) 温湿度呈负相关，降雨与湿度呈正相关；5) 尽管气候趋于稳定，但牧场退化、水资源治理、农业生产力等问题仍然存在。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了半干旱地区（苏丹东部）气候变异与生态响应之间关系的实证证据，验证了遥感指标与气象数据协同分析在评估区域气候稳定化趋势中的有效性。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议采取综合土地利用规划、制度强化、社区参与及气候智能型农业和水资源管理实践，以提升区域适应气候变化的能力，促进可持续资源管理。

title: Against the Public Ownership Conception of Shared Property
affiliations: West Virginia University - College of Business & Economics

detail.title: Against the Public Ownership Conception of Shared Property
detail.abstract: The Public Ownership Thesis is a Kantian-Rousseavian model of shared property. Its advocates argue that it is a superior model to those that can be derived from Lockeanism insofar as private property and common property cannot realise the distinct values that publicly owned property can. Resources that are sites of shared activities must be owned by the public as a whole, on this view. I argue that the various values ascribed to public ownership can be realised by common property on the Lockean model, and that the Lockean model is also better at dealing with the challenges of scarcity and disagreement that are central to questions of property rights.

AI.tldr: 本文批判了“公有产权论”（Public Ownership Thesis），认为洛克式的共有财产模型（common property）同样能实现公有产权所主张的价值，且在应对稀缺性和分歧方面更具优势。
AI.research_question: 公有产权论所宣称的独特价值是否真的只能由公共所有来实现？洛克式的共有财产模型能否更好地解释产权问题？
AI.motivation: 挑战“公有产权论”的优越性主张，论证洛克式共有财产模型在理论上的竞争力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 康德-卢梭式公有产权模型 vs. 洛克式共有财产模型。
AI.method: 概念分析与哲学论证，比较两种产权模型的价值实现能力与缺陷应对能力。
AI.findings: 公有产权所倡导的价值（如共享活动的资源所有权）可通过洛克式共有财产实现；洛克模型在处理资源稀缺性和群体分歧方面更有效。
AI.theory_contributions: 否定了公有产权论对洛克式模型的传统批评，拓展了洛克式共有财产的理论适用范围。
AI.practical_contributions: 为产权制度设计（尤其是共享资源治理）提供了理论依据，提示在政策制定中应更重视共有财产模式。

title: Slow Learning
affiliations: Northwestern University, Northwestern University and Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: Slow Learning

publicationDetails.detailsText: Finance and Economics Discussion Series, issue 2026-039, 2026[10.17016/FEDS.2026.039]

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: This paper provides an analytic characterization of the speed of convergence under learning to a rational expectations equilibrium (REE) for a large class of multivariate models. We show that learning is slower when people's beliefs about model outcomes are more self-fulfilling. The paper also investigates which features of a model economy make beliefs more self-fulfilling, using variants of the simple new-Keynesian model and a medium-scale DSGE model. For empirically plausible specifications of these models, convergence of a learning equilibrium to the REE is so slow that analysis based on rational expectations can be misleading.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了多变量模型中学习收敛到理性预期均衡的速度，发现当人们的信念更具自我实现性时，学习速度更慢。对于经验上合理的模型设定，收敛速度极慢，基于理性预期的分析可能具有误导性。
AI.research_question: 在多变量经济模型中，学习过程收敛到理性预期均衡的速度如何？什么因素影响这一收敛速度？
AI.motivation: 理性预期假设虽然在宏观经济学中广泛使用，但现实中经济主体需要通过不断学习来形成预期。了解学习收敛到理性预期的速度及其决定因素，对于评估理性预期假设的适用性至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 学习收敛理论、理性预期均衡理论、信念自我实现性理论
AI.method: 采用解析方法刻画多变量模型学习收敛速度的特征；利用简单新凯恩斯模型的变体和中等规模DSGE模型进行数值模拟分析。
AI.findings: （1）当人们对模型结果的信念更具自我实现性时，学习收敛速度更慢；（2）在经验上合理的模型设定下，学习均衡收敛到理性预期均衡的速度极慢，以至于基于理性预期的分析可能产生误导。
AI.theory_contributions: 为多变量模型中学习收敛到理性预期均衡的速度提供了解析刻画，揭示了信念自我实现性与收敛速度之间的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒实证研究者和政策制定者，在经验上合理的经济模型设定下，理性预期假设可能并不合适，因为学习收敛到均衡的过程极其缓慢，基于理性预期的分析结论需谨慎对待。

title: Multi-Temporal Land Use/Land Cover Change and NDDI-Based Drought Assessment in Semi-Arid Gadaref State, Sudan (1985-2022)
affiliations: Ahfad University for Women and University of Khartoum - Institute of Environmental Studies

detail.title: Multi-Temporal Land Use/Land Cover Change and NDDI-Based Drought Assessment in Semi-Arid Gadaref State, Sudan (1985-2022)

declarations.ethicsApproval: the research deals with remote sensing for changes in natural resources through years

detail.abstract: This study investigates land use and land cover (LU/LC) dynamics in three semi-arid Sudanese localities-Elsefia, Al-Khayari, and Aliadedat-over the period 1985-2022, using multitemporal Landsat imagery processed in Google Earth Engine (GEE) and ArcGIS Pro. The Normalized Difference Drought Index (NDDI) was derived alongside NDVI and NDWI to assess concurrent drought severity across the study period. Results reveal a consistent decline in rangeland across all sites (-2.5% to-4.7%), accompanied by sharp increases in settlement and agricultural areas. Settlement expansion was most pronounced in Al-Khayari (+10,861%), while agriculture surged in Elsefia (+33,350%) and Aliadedat (+527%), reflecting intensified cultivation and urban encroachment. Flooded vegetation expanded significantly in Elsefia (+296%) and Al-Khayari (+173%), suggesting hydrological variability and ecological adaptation. Bare land trends were mixed, with slight declines in Elsefia and Al-Khayari but localized increases in Aliadedat. These findings highlight a regional transition from natural rangeland toward human-dominated landscapes, driven by demographic pressures, agricultural intensification, and climate variability. The study underscores the need for integrated land management strategies-including community-based rangeland restoration, water-efficient agriculture, and evidence-based urban planning-to balance human development with ecological sustainability in semi-arid Sudan.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用1985-2022年Landsat影像和GEE平台，分析了苏丹三个半干旱地区的土地利用/覆盖变化，发现牧场持续减少，定居点和农业用地急剧扩张，凸显了人类活动主导的景观转型。
AI.research_question: 苏丹半干旱地区（Elsefia、Al-Khayari、Aliadedat）在1985-2022年间土地利用/覆盖（LU/LC）如何动态变化？伴随的干旱严重程度如何？
AI.motivation: 苏丹半干旱地区面临人口压力、农业集约化和气候变化的叠加影响，但缺乏基于长时间序列遥感数据的系统性LU/LC变化评估，难以支撑可持续土地管理决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 土地利用/覆盖变化（LU/LC）理论；干旱监测指数（NDDI、NDVI、NDWI）；遥感与地理信息系统（GEE、ArcGIS Pro）结合的土地变化探测方法。
AI.method: 利用多时相Landsat卫星影像，在Google Earth Engine（GEE）和ArcGIS Pro平台上处理数据，提取归一化差值干旱指数（NDDI）、NDVI和NDWI，分析1985-2022年三个研究区的LU/LC变化及干旱程度。
AI.findings: （1）所有研究区牧场面积持续下降（-2.5%至-4.7%）；（2）定居点和农业用地急剧增加，Al-Khayari定居点增长+10,861%，Elsefia农业增长+33,350%，Aliadedat农业增长+527%；（3）泛滥植被在Elsefia（+296%）和Al-Khayari（+173%）显著扩大；（4）裸地趋势不一，Elsefia和Al-Khayari略有下降，Aliadedat局部增加。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了苏丹半干旱地区近40年土地利用/覆盖变化的定量证据，揭示了从自然牧场向人类主导景观转型的时空模式，丰富了干旱区LU/LC变化研究案例。
AI.practical_contributions: 为苏丹半干旱地区提出了综合土地管理策略建议，包括社区牧场恢复、节水型农业和基于证据的城市规划，以在人类发展与生态可持续性之间取得平衡。

title: Mexico in U.S. Supply Chains: Lessons from 2018-19 Tariffs
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System and Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: Mexico in U.S. Supply Chains: Lessons from 2018-19 Tariffs

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: In the wake of the 2018–19 U.S.-China tariff hikes, there has been a significant shift in U.S. supply chains, with Mexico emerging as the largest supplier of U.S. imports, surpassing China. This shift has been attributed in part to Mexico gaining a cost advantage over China following the U.S tariffs on China.

AI.tldr: 2018-2019年美中关税上调后，墨西哥取代中国成为美国最大进口来源国，部分原因是墨西哥相对于中国获得了成本优势。
AI.research_question: 美中关税上调如何影响美国供应链格局，以及墨西哥为何能取代中国成为美国最大进口来源国？
AI.motivation: 理解中美贸易摩擦对全球供应链重组的影响，特别是墨西哥作为"近岸外包"目的地崛起的经济机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 比较优势理论、贸易成本分析、供应链重组理论
AI.method: 基于实证数据的贸易流动分析，比较中美关税变化前后两国对美出口成本与份额变化。
AI.findings: 美国对华加征关税使中国商品在美国市场失去价格竞争力，而墨西哥凭借较低关税壁垒和地理邻近优势获得相对成本优势，从而取代中国成为美国最大进口来源国。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了关税政策如何通过改变相对成本优势重塑国际贸易格局，丰富了贸易政策对供应链重组影响的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业供应链多元化布局和"近岸外包"战略提供实证依据，为政策制定者评估关税政策的贸易转移效应提供参考。

title: Capital Controls and Credit Reallocation: Evidence from Informal Dollar Liquidity

detail.title: Capital Controls and Credit Reallocation: Evidence from Informal Dollar Liquidity
detail.abstract: We study how changes in Chinese households' effective capital outflow constraints may transmit to U.S. credit markets through bank funding and portfolio choice. Our empirical design uses time variation in an informal U.S.-dollar liquidity channel available to some Chinese households, proxied by national fentanyl seizure volumes. We compare the responses of Chinese-affiliated community banks, which disproportionately serve Chinese-American depositors, with those of other banks. We find that increases in the liquidity proxy are associated with larger deposit inflows at Chinese-affiliated banks. These inflows are accompanied by expansion in residential mortgage lending and a decline in commercial small business lending. Taken together, the results are consistent with a mechanism in which changes in access to offshore dollar liquidity are associated with shifts in the composition of bank credit in destination communities, shifting lending toward residential mortgages and away from small businesses.

AI.tldr: 本文研究中国家庭有效资本外流限制的变化如何通过银行融资和投资组合选择传导至美国信贷市场。研究发现，中国家庭获得离岸美元流动性的增加，会导致服务于华裔美国储户的社区银行获得更多存款，进而促使这些银行扩大住宅抵押贷款、减少商业小企业贷款。
AI.research_question: 中国家庭有效资本外流限制的变化如何影响美国信贷市场的银行信贷配置？
AI.motivation: 理解新兴经济体资本流动限制变化如何通过银行系统传导至发达经济体的信贷市场，特别是社区银行层面的信贷结构变化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资本流动限制、银行资产负债管理、信贷配置理论。中国家庭资本外流限制变化→离岸美元流动性变化→华人社区银行存款变化→银行贷款组合调整。
AI.method: 使用中国全国芬太尼缉获量作为中国家庭非正式美元流动性渠道的代理变量，比较服务于华裔美国储户的社区银行与其他银行在流动性冲击下的反应差异。
AI.findings: 流动性代理变量增加时，华裔关联社区银行获得更多存款流入；这些银行同时扩大了住宅抵押贷款，减少了商业小企业贷款。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了跨境资本流动限制变化通过移民社区银行渠道影响东道国信贷市场结构的微观机制，丰富了资本流动与银行信贷配置关系的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构理解资本管制政策的国际溢出效应提供证据；提示政策制定者关注移民社区银行在资本流动传导中的特殊角色及其对信贷结构（住宅贷款 vs 小企业贷款）的影响。

title: The Architecture of Par: Run, Redemption Gates, and the Backstop That Selects the Peg

detail.title: The Architecture of Par: Run, Redemption Gates, and the Backstop That Selects the Peg

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author reports there are no competing interests to declare.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This paper is a theoretical study based on publicly available macro-financial data and does not involve human subjects, patients, or ethical review processes.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Under the GENIUS Act and the OCC's proposed implementing framework, a payment stablecoin would hold one-to-one segregated high-quality reserves, redeem within two business days, and be bankruptcyremote. We ask whether such compliance makes par a unique equilibrium, and show that it does not. In a global-games model of redemption, a fully reserve-solvent issuer can suffer a run in which secondarymarket par collapses, and no finite private arbitrage selects par under aggregate stress, because arbitrage capital is state-contingent and withdraws with the run. Only a credible, legally precommitted reopening mechanism-paired with ex ante loss allocation and a risk-taking constraint-selects par. We then show that a redemption gate is not instrument-invariant: it can stabilize under simultaneous redemption but amplifies runs under continuously observable settlement, because it destroys the option value of waiting. Gates are therefore not substitutes for a reopening authority; under continuous settlement they increase the need for one. Reading the GENIUS Act and the OCC's 2026 proposed rule through this lens, we find a framework that materially improves reserve adequacy, redemption predictability, and operational continuity, yet leaves the equilibrium selection of secondary-market par only partially resolved.

AI.tldr: 本文研究合规支付稳定币（符合GENIUS法案和OCC框架）是否能使面值（par）成为唯一均衡。研究发现，即使发行方完全具备偿付能力，在聚合压力下仍可能发生挤兑，二级市场面值崩溃，且私人套利无法恢复面值。只有具备法律预承诺的重新开放机制（paired with 事前损失分配和风险承担约束）才能选择面值均衡。赎回闸门（redemption gate）在连续结算下反而会加剧挤兑。文章指出，GENIUS法案和OCC提案虽改善了准备金充足性等，但仅部分解决了二级市场面值的均衡选择问题。
AI.research_question: 合规支付稳定币（符合GENIUS法案和OCC框架）是否能使面值（par）成为唯一市场均衡？
AI.motivation: 监管机构（如OCC）正在推动稳定币的全面合规框架（如GENIUS Act），假设合规能保证稳定币锚定面值。但现实市场中稳定币可能面临二级市场面值崩溃，即使准备金完全充足。本文旨在揭示合规框架下是否仍存在挤兑风险，以及哪些机制能真正确保面值稳定。
AI.theoretical_framework: 全球博弈模型（global-games model）：用于分析赎回协调问题，研究在信息不完全下投资者如何形成挤兑预期。套利资本状态依存理论：套利资本在压力时期会撤回，无法有效执行面值恢复功能。期权价值理论：赎回闸门在连续结算下破坏等待的期权价值，从而放大挤兑。
AI.method: 全球博弈（global-games）理论建模，分析稳定币赎回协调博弈中的多重均衡和均衡选择问题。
AI.findings: （1）完全准备金偿付能力的发行方仍可能遭受挤兑，二级市场面值崩溃；（2）私人套利资本无法在聚合压力下选择面值均衡，因为套利资本是状态依存的，在挤兑发生时撤出；（3）只有法律预承诺的重新开放机制（paired with 事前损失分配和风险承担约束）才能选择面值均衡；（4）赎回闸门并非工具不变（instrument-invariant）：在同时赎回时能稳定市场，但在连续可观察结算下会放大挤兑，因为它破坏了等待的期权价值；（5）GENIUS法案和OCC提案显著改善了准备金充足性、赎回可预测性和运营连续性，但仅部分解决了二级市场面值的均衡选择问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了稳定币合规框架下均衡选择的局限性，证明了私人套利在聚合压力下的失效机制；提出了赎回闸门的非工具不变性（instrument-invariance），区分了不同结算环境下的稳定效果；将法律预承诺的重新开放机制引入均衡选择理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为稳定币监管设计提供关键建议：仅要求准备金合规不足以防止面值崩溃；需要建立法律预承诺的重新开放机制、事前损失分配规则和风险承担约束；提醒监管者赎回闸门不能替代重新开放权威，在连续结算环境下甚至可能增加对重新开放机制的需求；对GENIUS法案和OCC提案提出建设性评估，指出其不足之处。

title: Information Provision and Demand-Side Barriers to Healthcare Innovation: Experimental Evidence on Shared Medical Appointments in Menopause Care
affiliations: School of Economics, University of Edinburgh, University College London, University of Oxford, University of Virginia - Department of Economics and London Business School - Department of Management Science and Operations

detail.title: Information Provision and Demand-Side Barriers to Healthcare Innovation: Experimental Evidence on Shared Medical Appointments in Menopause Care
detail.abstract: Alternative care delivery models may offer benefits to patients and providers, but adoption often remains low. We study whether brief narrative testimonials shift willingness to attend virtual shared medical appointments (SMAs), a relatively little-used care format in which 5-15 patients with a shared non-urgent health condition meet simultaneously with a clinician. Using a pre-registered field experiment with over 4,000 women aged 45-60 in the UK, we randomly assigned participants to view only standard descriptive information about menopause appointment options (the control group) or to receive testimonials about SMAs from either previous patients or a clinician (treatment groups). Testimonials more than doubled the share of women choosing an SMA: when appointments were offered with a 6-8 week wait, 11% of the control group chose an SMA compared to 26% in the peer testimonials arm and 24% in the clinician testimonials arm. Shorter waiting times further increase uptake. When the SMA wait was reduced to one week, the share of women ever choosing an SMA rose by 14-19 percentage points across arms, reaching nearly 40% in the testimonial groups. Treatment effects are systematically larger among women with greater information-processing capacity: university education, higher baseline menopause knowledge, and broader information-seeking. Our findings suggest that women's reluctance to choose SMAs is driven primarily by demand-side barriers, including unfamiliarity and uncertainty about their benefits, rather than deep-seated aversion to group-based care. Testimonials appear sufficient to meaningfully reduce these barriers.

AI.tldr: 通过一项涉及4000多名英国女性的田野实验，研究发现简短的患者或医生推荐视频能使选择虚拟共享医疗门诊（SMA）的比例从11%提升至26%左右，缩短等待时间可进一步提高至近40%。效果在信息处理能力更强的女性中更为显著，表明需求侧的不熟悉和不确定性是主要障碍。
AI.research_question: 简短叙事推荐是否能够改变患者对虚拟共享医疗门诊（SMAs）的参与意愿？
AI.motivation: 替代性医疗服务模式（如虚拟共享医疗门诊）对患者和提供者均有潜在益处，但实际采用率往往很低。本研究旨在探究需求侧障碍（如对SMAs不熟悉和对其益处不确定）是否以及多大程度上可以通过推荐干预来克服。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息处理理论、行为经济学中的推荐效应、需求侧障碍理论
AI.method: 预先注册的田野实验，随机对照试验设计：将4000多名45-60岁英国女性随机分为三组——仅看标准信息（对照组）、看患者推荐（患者推荐组）、看医生推荐（临床医生推荐组），并通过调整等待时间（6-8周 vs. 1周）进行机制检验。
AI.findings: 1）推荐使SMA选择率从11%（对照组）提升至24-26%（推荐组）；2）缩短等待时间进一步提升选择率，推荐组可达近40%；3）推荐效应在具有大学学历、更高更年期知识和更广泛信息搜索行为的女性中更大；4）女性对SMAs的抵触主要源于需求侧的不熟悉和不确定性，而非对群体护理的固有厌恶。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）为需求侧障碍在医疗服务创新采纳中的关键作用提供了因果证据；2）揭示了信息处理能力调节推荐效应的机制；3）区分了不熟悉/不确定性与深层偏好的作用，深化了对医疗服务采用障碍的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为医疗机构推广虚拟共享门诊提供了低成本、高效果的干预工具（简短推荐视频）；2）建议结合缩短等待时间等供给侧措施以最大化采用率；3）提示针对不同信息处理能力的患者群体可能需要差异化的推广策略。

title: Rules, Not Rulers: Verification, Selection, and the Spatial Distribution of Public Goods in India

detail.title: Rules, Not Rulers: Verification, Selection, and the Spatial Distribution of Public Goods in India
detail.abstract: The distribution of public goods has traditionally been viewed as a function of political power, which concentrates facilities in large settlements and leaves peripheral villages underserved. In this paper, I argue that spatial distribution depends equally on bureaucratic allocation rules. Rules guaranteeing a facility to all qualifying settlements disperse provision, while rules rationing scarce facilities among competitors concentrate it. I test this using school provision in India, exploiting variation within the same elected councils: elementary schools are allocated via an inclusive verification rule, whereas middle schools face competitive selection. Holding governance and demand constant, I find that facility placement across 364,478 villages diverges by 27.1 percentage points depending on the rule applied. Private schools, facing identical demand but no bureaucratic rules, exhibit no such divergence. Expanding the analysis to all 11 public goods in the Indian village census confirms that goods allocated through verification are less concentrated at the center than those distributed via selection or the market. By extending elementary schools to 47,409 peripheral settlements and 54.7 million people, verification rules fundamentally reshape the geography of development. Access at the margins of the state depends less on who governs than on how its rules are written.

AI.tldr: 本文发现，公共品的空间分布不仅取决于政治权力（如精英俘获），更关键的是受官僚分配规则影响。通过对比印度村庄中小学（基于资格的验证规则）和初中（竞争性选拔规则）的分布差异，以及扩展至11种公共品，证明"验证制"分散公共服务，"选拔制"集中公共服务，规则设计从根本上改变了发展的地理格局。
AI.research_question: 公共品的空间分布是由政治权力主导，还是同样受官僚分配规则的系统性影响？不同类型的分配规则如何塑造设施的地理集中或分散？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为公共品分布主要由政治权力（如精英俘获、选区政治）驱动，导致设施集中于大定居点、边缘村庄被忽视。但本文提出了一种被忽视的机制——官僚分配规则本身的结构性影响，并通过印度大规模数据检验这一假说。
AI.theoretical_framework: 官僚分配规则理论：验证规则（verification）——对所有符合条件的定居点保证设施，导致分散分布；选拔规则（selection）——在稀缺资源中对竞争性申请者进行筛选，导致集中分布。这是对传统政治经济学视角的重要补充。
AI.method: 利用印度同一当选议会内小学（验证规则）与初中（选拔规则）的规则差异，控制治理和需求因素；分析364,478个村庄的设施布局；使用印度人口普查全部11种公共品数据扩展验证；并以私立学校作为无官僚规则下的对照组。
AI.findings: （1）同一治理结构下，小学与初中的分布差异达27.1个百分点；（2）私立学校（无官僚规则）无此差异；（3）11种公共品的扩展分析证实：验证制公共品比选拔制或市场分配品更不集中于中心；（4）验证规则使小学延伸至47,409个边缘聚落，覆盖5,470万人口。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了公共品分布仅由政治权力决定的传统观点，系统性地建立了"官僚分配规则"作为空间分布独立驱动力的理论框架，区分了验证规则与选拔规则的不同空间效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家公共品供给提供关键政策启示：改变分配规则（从选拔制转向验证制）可以在不改变治理结构的情况下显著改善边缘地区的服务覆盖，对实现普惠性发展具有直接指导意义。

title:
Signal Distortion, Adaptive Preferences, and Aggregate Productivity 
A General Equilibrium Theory of Gender-Based Misallocation

detail.title:
Signal Distortion, Adaptive Preferences, and Aggregate Productivity 
A General Equilibrium Theory of Gender-Based Misallocation
detail.abstract: I develop and estimate a general equilibrium model with sector-specific capital in which gender-specific signal distortion generates persistent misallocation, amplified by endogenous price feedback. Women observe returns filtered through a compound discount lambda = lambda_info * lambda_struct(phi), where the structural component -- capturing discrimination and network exclusion -- is endogenous to female participation phi. With sector-specific capital, the wage premium in the modern sector is itself endogenous: women's withdrawal reduces capital accumulation there while raising it in the traditional sector, compressing the premium and making the distorted signal even less likely to trigger entry. I prove that the steady-state preference gap is strictly larger in GE than PE through three distinct channels (signal distortion, wage compression, capital reallocation); unconditional transfers widen the gap by raising the traditional-sector capital stock; the tipping point for self-sustaining convergence is higher with endogenous prices; and the competitive equilibrium is constrained Pareto inefficient due to a triple externality. The preference persistence parameter rho, structurally estimated from Global Findex micro data covering 93,000 respondents across 97 economies, is rho-hat = 0.80 (SE = 0.046), implying an annual half-life of approximately three years for the aspiration gap and confirming the model's geometric preference-decay structure. At estimated parameters, calibrated TFP losses range from 5% to 25% across 58 countries, with a median of 10.8%; Bolivia loses 13.4% and India 19.2%, accounting for 32-48% of the total misallocation in Hsieh and Klenow (2009). A one-time intervention pushing female participation past the GE tipping point generates permanent TFP gains whose present value exceeds intervention cost by a factor of 8-15.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个包含部门特定资本的性别一般均衡模型，发现性别特定信号扭曲通过内生价格反馈产生持续的资源错配。结构估计显示偏好持续参数ρ̂=0.80，年半衰期约3年。校准结果显示58个国家的TFP损失中位数为10.8%，一次性干预的现值收益是成本的8-15倍。
AI.research_question: 性别特定信号扭曲如何通过内生价格反馈机制产生持续的资源错配？其福利损失和干预效果如何？
AI.motivation: 解释为什么性别差距在发展中国家持续存在，量化其造成的TFP损失，并评估政策干预的经济效益。
AI.theoretical_framework: 一般均衡模型：包含部门特定资本、性别特定信号复合折扣（λ = λ_info * λ_struct(φ)）、三重外部性（信号扭曲、工资压缩、资本再配置）、约束帕累托无效竞争均衡。
AI.method: 结构估计：利用Global Findex微观数据（93,000受访者，97个经济体）估计偏好持续参数ρ；模型校准至58个国家。
AI.findings: (1) GE稳态偏好差距严格大于PE； (2) 无条件转移支付扩大差距； (3) 内生价格下自维持收敛的临界点更高； (4) ρ̂=0.80，年半衰期约3年； (5) TFP损失中位数10.8%（印度19.2%，玻利维亚13.4%）； (6) 干预收益成本比8-15倍。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示一般均衡中性别歧视的放大机制（三重渠道）；证明竞争均衡在性别维度上的约束帕累托无效性；建立信号扭曲与资本积累的内生反馈理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 量化了性别差距造成的TFP损失（占HK 2009总错配的32-48%）；证明了一次性干预越过临界点即可产生永久性TFP增益，且收益远大于成本。

title: Mortgage Servicing Right Valuations Under Stress
affiliations: Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia, Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System and Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: Mortgage Servicing Right Valuations Under Stress

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: Mortgage servicing right (MSR) valuations decrease when mortgage default and prepayment rates increase, as is generally the case when the economy enters into recession. To estimate how large these MSR valuation declines could be for the banking sector in a severe economic downturn, we project the potential increase in default and prepayment rates under the supervisory stress test models and scenarios for mortgages serviced by large banks.

AI.tldr: 本文通过监管压力测试模型和情景，预测在经济严重衰退时期，大型银行服务的抵押贷款违约率和提前还款率上升对抵押贷款服务权（MSR）估值的影响。
AI.research_question: 在严重经济衰退下，大型银行持有的抵押贷款服务权（MSR）估值会因违约率和提前还款率上升而下降多少？
AI.motivation: 抵押贷款服务权（MSR）估值对经济周期高度敏感，衰退时违约和提前还款率上升会导致估值大幅下降，但银行业面临的潜在损失规模尚不明确，需通过压力测试量化评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 抵押贷款服务权估值模型、违约与提前还款风险理论、监管压力测试框架。
AI.method: 基于监管压力测试模型和情景，对大型银行服务的抵押贷款组合进行违约率和提前还款率的预测与MSR估值影响分析。
AI.findings: 经济严重衰退时，抵押贷款违约率和提前还款率显著上升，导致大型银行持有的MSR估值大幅下降。
AI.theory_contributions: 将监管压力测试模型应用于MSR估值风险量化，拓展了对银行体系在极端经济情景下MSR风险敞口的理论认识。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构和银行管理层评估极端经济情景下MSR估值下行风险提供量化依据，有助于完善银行压力测试框架和风险管理实践。

title: Classified Asymmetrical Risk and Planetary Actuarial Instability

detail.title: Classified Asymmetrical Risk and Planetary Actuarial Instability

declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics Approval Statement This study is a doctrinal and comparative legal analysis conducted exclusively through publicly available legal, regulatory, governmental, and academic sources. No human participants, clinical data, confidential information, classified materials, or private personal data were utilised. Accordingly, formal institutional ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: Funder Statement This research was independently conducted and self-funded by the author through the Space Governance Institute, a subsidiary of Prestiged Future Corp. No external governmental, institutional, commercial, or private funding was received in support of this study.

detail.abstract:
This dissertation examines whether commercial orbital insurance systems can operate 
legitimately, sustainably, and within the rule of law where governments — particularly those of 
the Five Eyes intelligence alliance (the United Kingdom, the United States, Canada, Australia, 
and New Zealand) — allegedly possess materially relevant classified aerospace information 
unavailable to private risk institutions. The thesis advances four original doctrinal constructs: (i) 
Classified Asymmetrical Risk, the condition in which sovereign actors hold actuarially material 
information withheld from regulated insurance markets; (ii) Planetary Actuarial Instability, the 
resulting incapacity of orbital insurance and reinsurance systems to price catastrophic exposure; 
(iii) Disclosure-Dependent Risk Governance, the proposition that certain forms of systemic risk 
regulation require minimum disclosure thresholds to retain legitimacy; and (iv) Extraterrestrial 
Force Majeure, a doctrinal framework for unidentified, non-state, and non-human aerospace 
phenomena under English contract law and the international space law regime.

The study proceeds doctrinally. It situates these constructs within the Outer Space Treaty 1967, 
the Liability Convention 1972, the Registration Convention 1975, the United Kingdom's Outer 
Space Act 1986 and Space Industry Act 2018, the Solvency II regime as retained in UK law, and 
the comparative regulatory architecture of the remaining Five Eyes jurisdictions. It concludes 
that current orbital insurance arrangements operate on assumptions of informational symmetry 
that are no longer defensible, and proposes a calibrated statutory disclosure obligation, a Five 
Eyes coordination mechanism, and a residual reinsurance backstop as the minimum institutional 
response.
Keywords: space law; insurance regulation; Outer Space Treaty; Solvency II; Five Eyes; 
aerospace disclosure; actuarial governance; force majeure; systemic risk.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了商业轨道保险系统在五眼联盟政府拥有机密航空航天信息的情况下，能否合法、可持续地在法治框架内运作。论文提出了四个原创性理论构建：机密不对称风险、行星精算不稳定性、依赖披露的风险治理和地外不可抗力，并建议建立法定披露义务、五眼协调机制和再保险支持。
AI.research_question: 当五眼联盟政府持有私人风险机构无法获取的机密航空航天信息时，商业轨道保险系统能否合法、可持续地在法治框架内运作？
AI.motivation: 现有轨道保险安排基于信息对称的假设，但五眼联盟政府掌握的精算相关信息不向市场披露，使得保险定价和风险治理面临根本性挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 四项原创学说：机密不对称风险(Classified Asymmetrical Risk)、行星精算不稳定(Planetary Actuarial Instability)、依赖披露的风险治理(Disclosure-Dependent Risk Governance)、地外不可抗力(Extraterrestrial Force Majeure)。
AI.method: doctrinal method（教义分析方法），对《外层空间条约1967》《责任公约1972》《登记公约1975》、英国《外层空间法1986》和《航天工业法2018》、Solvency II制度以及五眼联盟其他司法辖区的比较监管架构进行法律分析。
AI.findings: 当前轨道保险安排基于信息对称的假设已不再成立；需要最低限度的制度回应：法定披露义务、五眼协调机制和再保险支持。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了四个原创性法学/保险学概念框架（机密不对称风险、行星精算不稳定性、依赖披露的风险治理、地外不可抗力），拓展了空间法、保险监管和系统性风险治理的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为五眼联盟及国际社会提供了轨道保险监管改革的具体制度建议（法定披露义务、协调机制、再保险支持），有助于解决商业航天保险市场的现实困境。

title: Claiming Priority to Submarine Trademark Applications-A Curious Little Loophole
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Claiming Priority to Submarine Trademark Applications-A Curious Little Loophole

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract:
Section 44 of the Trademark Act enacts the United States’ obligations under various trademark treaties. This section is meant for the benefit of foreign applicants for United States trademarks – an applicant who is a United States resident
or citizen has no need for this section. However, it is used by U.S. companies who file trademark applications for product names in jurisdictions without public trademark registers, allowing them to keep a name hidden from public view before product launch, dubbed “submarine” trademarks. The article explains how this loophole came about.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了《商标法》第44条被美国公司滥用为“潜艇商标”的漏洞，使它们能在产品发布前隐藏商标名称，并追溯了该漏洞的形成原因。
AI.research_question: 《商标法》第44条如何被美国公司利用为“潜艇商标”漏洞？该漏洞是如何产生的？
AI.motivation: 揭示商标法律体系中一项旨在保护外国申请人的条款如何被本土企业逆向利用，形成监管漏洞。
AI.theoretical_framework: 商标法国际条约义务、注册制度比较法（公开注册 vs. 非公开注册）、法律漏洞理论。
AI.method: 法律文本分析与案例研究（对美国公司利用第44条的实践进行梳理）。
AI.findings: 美国公司利用第44条，在无公开商标注册制度的司法管辖区提交申请，从而在母国（美国）实现商标名称的隐蔽，形成“潜艇商标”现象。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了国际商标条约在国内法转化过程中可能产生的非预期后果，丰富了法律漏洞与制度滥用的理论研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为商标立法与监管机构提供了堵截漏洞的政策建议，有助于完善商标公开透明机制。

title: Somali Macroeconomics: A Comprehensive Overview
affiliations: Federal Republic of Somalia

detail.title: Somali Macroeconomics: A Comprehensive Overview

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No have influenced my study

detail.abstract: Somalia presents one of the most complex macroeconomic environments in Sub-Saharan Africa. Emerging from decades of civil conflict, state collapse, and humanitarian crises, the Somali economy has demonstrated remarkable informal resilience, driven primarily by remittances, pastoralism, and a thriving services sector operating largely outside formal institutional frameworks. This paper provides a comprehensive macroeconomic overview of Somalia, examining GDP dynamics, inflation pressures, sectoral composition, monetary conditions, fiscal constraints, and the pivotal role of diaspora remittances. Employing standard macroeconomic frameworks including Aggregate Demand-Aggregate Supply (AD-AS) analysis, the paper identifies key structural bottlenecks and offers policy considerations for sustainable economic development. The findings suggest that while Somalia's GDP growth has remained modest but positive in recent years, the absence of a formal central bank, extreme aid dependency, and climate vulnerability pose significant threats to long-term macroeconomic stability.

AI.tldr: 本文对索马里这一后冲突国家的宏观经济进行了全面分析，指出尽管缺乏正式制度框架，但该国经济在侨汇、畜牧业和服务业的驱动下展现出非正式韧性，同时面临无中央银行、高援助依赖和气候脆弱性等结构性挑战。
AI.research_question: 索马里在数十年的内战和国家崩溃后，其宏观经济运行的基本特征、结构性瓶颈以及实现可持续发展的政策路径是什么？
AI.motivation: 索马里是撒哈拉以南非洲最复杂的宏观经济环境之一，但长期以来缺乏系统的宏观经济审视。理解其非正式经济的韧性机制与结构性脆弱性，对于后冲突国家的经济重建具有重要的政策启示意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 总需求-总供给（AD-AS）分析框架，以及后冲突经济体的宏观经济稳定理论。
AI.method: 采用标准宏观经济分析框架（AD-AS），结合GDP动态、通胀压力、部门构成、货币条件、财政约束和侨汇数据，进行综合性的宏观经济概览与结构性分析。
AI.findings: （1）索马里GDP增长近年来保持温和但正向增长；（2）经济韧性主要来自侨汇、畜牧业和以服务业为主的非正式部门；（3）缺乏正式中央银行、极端援助依赖和气候脆弱性是长期宏观经济稳定的三大主要威胁。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AD-AS等标准宏观框架应用于极端脆弱的后冲突经济体，拓展了非正式经济韧性研究的理论边界，揭示了正式制度缺失环境下宏观经济运行的独特机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为索马里及类似后冲突国家的政策制定者提供了基于实证的结构性瓶颈识别与政策建议，强调了制度建设（如中央银行重建）、降低援助依赖及应对气候脆弱性的紧迫性。

title:
Physics-Informed Governance Theory

Orbital Instability, Cascading Risk, and the Emerging Insurance Crisis in Congested Near-Earth Space

detail.title:
Physics-Informed Governance Theory

Orbital Instability, Cascading Risk, and the Emerging Insurance Crisis in Congested Near-Earth Space

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Declaration of Interest The author declares no known financial conflicts of interest, commercial affiliations, or personal relationships that could reasonably be perceived to have influenced the research, analysis, or conclusions presented within this study. The views expressed are solely those of the author and do not represent the official positions of any governmental, institutional, defence, commercial, or regulatory body.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics Approval This study constitutes a doctrinal, interdisciplinary, and comparative legal-policy analysis conducted exclusively through publicly available academic, legal, governmental, regulatory, and policy materials. No human participants, clinical data, confidential information, classified materials, or private personal data were utilised. Accordingly, formal institutional ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: Funder Statement This research was independently conducted and self-funded by the author through the Space Governance Institute, a division of Prestiged Future Corp. No external governmental, institutional, corporate, or private funding was received in support of this research.

detail.abstract:
This monograph develops a physics-informed framework for the governance of congested near-Earth 
orbital space. It argues that the prevailing legal architecture — anchored in the Outer Space Treaty 1967, 
the Liability Convention 1972, the Registration Convention 1975, and a thin lattice of national licensing 
regimes — conceptualises orbital activity as a series of discrete operational acts conducted by sovereign 
or sovereign-affiliated actors in an effectively empty medium. That conceptualisation no longer reflects 
the operational reality of the orbital domain. Mega-constellations, hybrid civil–military architectures, 
autonomous manoeuvring systems, and accumulating debris populations have produced a dynamically 
interacting, instability-prone systemic environment whose risk properties are continuous, cumulative, and 
non-linear.

Drawing on the structural form (though not the formal mathematics) of astrophysical instability models 
— the Toomre criterion, Jeans instability, runaway accretion in planetesimal disks, and migration 
dynamics in protoplanetary systems — the monograph proposes a conceptual architecture in which orbital 
governance is understood as the management of threshold behaviour in a complex adaptive system. The 
framework is applied to four contemporary governance problems: the emerging crisis in orbital insurance 
markets; cascading debris and collision-chain liability under the Liability Convention regime; the collapse 
of the civil–military distinction in hybrid orbital systems with particular attention to NATO and Five Eyes 
architectures; and the rise of inference-based governance under conditions of attribution opacity and 
informational monopoly.

The monograph is anchored in United Kingdom regulatory practice under the Outer Space Act 1986 and 
the Space Industry Act 2018, with comparative analysis of United States, NATO, and Five Eyes 
frameworks. It concludes by proposing six conceptual components of a physics-informed governance 
architecture: dynamic governance thresholds, probabilistic attribution standards, systemic-risk insurance 
pools, orbital congestion indices, sovereign transparency tiers, and autonomous-system oversight 
frameworks. These are presented not as draft regulation but as a methodological re-orientation: a shift 
from conduct-based to system-state governance of the orbital domain.

AI.tldr: 本专著提出了一个基于物理学的近地轨道治理框架，指出以《外层空间条约》为核心的传统法律体系将轨道活动视为离散操作行为，已无法应对由巨型星座、军民混合架构、自主机动系统和碎片累积构成的动态复杂系统。借鉴天体物理学不稳定性模型（如Toomre准则、金斯不稳定性等），作者将轨道治理重构为复杂自适应系统中阈值行为的管理，并应用于轨道保险危机、碎片链式责任、军民界限模糊及信息垄断下的推断式治理四个问题，最终提出六项物理学启发的治理组件。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个基于物理学的治理框架，以应对近地轨道空间因巨型星座、碎片累积和复杂交互而呈现出的系统性风险与非线性的动态特征？
AI.motivation: 现行法律架构（1967年《外层空间条约》等）将轨道活动视为主权实体在空旷介质中的离散操作行为，这一概念化已严重偏离轨道领域的运行现实——巨型星座、军民混合架构、自主系统和碎片累积已形成一个动态交互、易于失稳的系统性环境，其风险具有连续性、累积性和非线性特征，现有法律框架无法有效应对。
AI.theoretical_framework: 借鉴天体物理学不稳定性模型的结构形式（非数学形式），包括Toomre准则、金斯不稳定性、星子盘中的失控吸积以及原行星系统中的迁移动力学。核心逻辑是将轨道治理重新概念化为对复杂自适应系统中阈值行为的管理。
AI.method: 理论建构与概念分析，结合英国《外层空间法1986》和《航天工业法2018》的监管实践，以及美国、北约和五眼联盟框架的比较分析。
AI.findings: 提出了六项物理学启发的治理组件：动态治理阈值、概率性归因标准、系统性风险保险池、轨道拥堵指数、主权透明度等级和自主系统监督框架。核心理念是从以行为为基础（conduct-based）的治理转向以系统状态为基础（system-state）的轨道域治理。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将天体物理学的不稳定性模型系统性地引入轨道空间治理理论，提供了一种从"离散行为监管"到"系统状态管理"的范式转换，丰富了复杂系统理论与国际空间法学的交叉研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为轨道保险市场危机、碎片链式责任、军民混合系统监管和信息不对称下的推断式治理提供了具体分析；提出的六项治理组件为政策制定者提供了可操作的改革方向；基于英国、美国、北约和五眼联盟的比较分析为不同司法管辖区的制度改进提供了参照。

title: Housing as a Bundled Political Shock: Rent, Wealth, and Voting

detail.title: Housing as a Bundled Political Shock: Rent, Wealth, and Voting
detail.abstract: While the empirical literature documents the association between housing wealth and political behaviour, the structural mechanism through which housing pressure produces mainstream exit is contested. This paper presents a structural contribution: I decompose housing pressure into three substantively distinct margins of household experience that bundle into the same lived situation, namely rent burden, exclusion from housing capital gains among non-owners, and family-financed entry into ownership. I then discipline the behavioural parameters against German wealth distributional, housing-market and electoral moments, and use counterfactual policy experiments to show that the three-margin structure changes the policy ranking. To this end, I develop a calibrated agent-based model with heterogeneity in households (region, tenure, wealth and aspiration) and in regional housing markets. Both forms of heterogeneity are crucial because the three margins are not collinear at the household level, hence an aggregate model cannot separate them. The three margins enter a reference-dependent dissatisfaction process and shape household voting probabilities, which in turn drives the political response to housing-policy interventions. I calibrate the model to 30,000 German households across 16 regions in order to estimate the housing-channel component of mainstream exit around the AfD second-vote share in the 23 February 2025 federal election. The mechanism is then externally stress-tested against UK Brexit voting at the NUTS-1 level in the 2016 referendum. Eight behavioural parameters are disciplined by Simulated Method of Moments (SMM) against twelve German distributional, housing-market and political-economy targets. When simulating five policy counterfactuals over a 25-period horizon, I find that only one of the five counterfactual scenarios reverses the political trajectory: a bundled intervention combining the housing-policy block with a capital-tax-funded redistributive transfer to the bottom half of the wealth distribution. I find that housing instruments operate as complements rather than substitutes: Mietpreisbremse, Wohngeld and supply-side reform, even at full delivery 1 intensity, leave the political channel of mainstream exit open, since the housing-only policy block reaches the rent margin alone and does not address blocked ownership or unequal wealth transmission.

AI.tldr: 本文通过一个三机制分解框架（租金负担、非拥有者被排除在房产资本收益之外、家庭资助购房），利用德国30,000户家庭数据和模拟矩估计法，揭示住房压力如何通过三条不同路径驱动主流政治退出，并发现只有将住房政策与资本税再分配相结合的综合性干预才能逆转这一政治轨迹。
AI.research_question: 住房压力通过何种结构性机制驱动主流政治退出？不同住房政策干预对逆转这一政治轨迹的效果有何差异？
AI.motivation: 已有文献仅观察到住房财富与政治行为之间的关联，但对住房压力导致主流政治退出的结构性机制缺乏清晰的分解和量化，这导致政策设计无法精准干预。
AI.theoretical_framework: 参考依赖 dissatisfaction 过程、三机制分解框架（租金负担、资本收益排斥、代际资助购房）、主流政治退出理论。
AI.method: 校准型基于智能体的模型（ABM），覆盖德国16个地区30,000户家庭；模拟矩估计法（SMM）拟合8个行为参数与12个目标矩；反事实政策实验；外部压力测试（英国脱欧投票NUTS-1数据）。
AI.findings: 三种住房压力机制在家庭层面非共线，不能由加总模型区分；仅住房政策（租金管制、住房补贴、供给改革）无法关闭主流退出渠道；只有将住房政策与资本税资助的财富再分配结合，才能逆转政治轨迹；住房政策工具之间是互补而非替代关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 将住房压力从单一概念分解为三条结构不同的机制维度，揭示了宏观加总模型无法捕捉的家庭层面异质性机制；提出了住房政策工具间互补性而非替代性的理论观点。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了精准的政策干预排序：单一的住房政策（如租金管制、住房补贴、供给侧改革）不足以解决主流政治退出问题，必须与资本税再分配措施配套实施。

title: Home Production, Skill Heterogeneity and the Labor Wedge

detail.title: Home Production, Skill Heterogeneity and the Labor Wedge
detail.abstract: The labor wedge, the inequivalence between the MRS and MPL, is a measure of market inefficiency and its cyclicality implies fluctuations between consumption, labor supply and employment. To explain it, we write a Beckerian model where non-market consumption, such as home production and leisure, is produced by allocating resources, such as money and time. We find that the labor wedge's distortionary metrics are substantially explained by home production and skill heterogeneity. Specifically, the skill-based money input and skill premium play a primary role and the skill-based time input and skill composition play a secondary role. Furthermore, welfare is procyclical during economic expansion and countercyclical during recessions. Skill heterogeneity not only enhances welfare but also contributes to its stability throughout business cycles. A procyclical fiscal policy customized to each skill level and each non-market sector could effectively eliminate the labor wedge and optimize welfare.

AI.tldr: 本文通过一个包含家庭生产与休闲的非市场消费贝克尔模型，发现技能异质性（尤其是技能溢价和货币投入）是解释劳动楔子的关键因素，并提出针对性的财政政策可消除劳动楔子并优化福利。
AI.research_question: 劳动楔子的周期性波动如何被非市场消费（家庭生产与休闲）以及技能异质性所解释？
AI.motivation: 传统劳动楔子模型无法充分解释其周期性特征，本文试图从家庭生产和技能异质性角度提供微观基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贝克尔家庭生产模型（Beckerian model），将非市场消费（家庭生产与休闲）视为由货币和时间资源生产的商品。
AI.method: 理论建模与数值模拟，分析技能异质性（技能溢价、技能构成）对劳动楔子和福利的影响。
AI.findings: （1）家庭生产和技能异质性显著解释劳动楔子的扭曲度量；（2）技能货币投入和技能溢价起主要作用，技能时间投入和技能构成起次要作用；（3）福利在经济扩张期顺周期，衰退期逆周期；（4）技能异质性增强福利并促进其稳定；（5）针对不同技能水平和非市场部门的顺周期财政政策可消除劳动楔子并优化福利。
AI.theory_contributions: 将家庭生产理论和技能异质性引入劳动楔子分析，揭示了非市场部门在解释劳动力市场低效率中的关键作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了消除劳动楔子的具体路径：通过针对不同技能水平和非市场部门的顺周期财政政策，优化福利并稳定经济周期。
