title: A Microeconomic Analysis of the Luxury Fragrance Industry in Oman: A Case Study of Amouage's Market Structure, Price Elasticity of Demand, Supply & Demand, and Government Intervention
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: A Microeconomic Analysis of the Luxury Fragrance Industry in Oman: A Case Study of Amouage's Market Structure, Price Elasticity of Demand, Supply & Demand, and Government Intervention

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is based entirely on publicly available secondary data and published sources. No human participants, personal data, surveys, or experiments were involved. Therefore, ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

publicationDetails.detailsText: Not applicable. This paper has not previously appeared in, nor been accepted for publication in, any journal, book, or paper series.

detail.abstract:
This report uses microeconomic theory to study Amouage, an Omani luxury fragrance brand founded in 1983. The analysis covers four main areas: market structure, price elasticity of demand (PED), supply and demand, and government intervention. All data comes from published industry reports, company press releases, and credible news sources.
Amouage operates under monopolistic competition — a market with many competing brands, each selling a distinct product. Thanks to its Omani royal heritage, UNESCO-protected frankincense, and ultra-high concentration (30–40%+), Amouage can charge premium prices of $250–$550 per bottle. In 2025, the brand reached $430M+ in total sales, a +66% increase from the previous year (Business of Fashion, 2026).
A key finding is that Amouage's demand is inelastic, meaning customers are not highly sensitive to price changes. The estimated Price Elasticity of Demand (PED) is approximately −0.3 to −0.5. This indicates that price increases do not lead to a significant drop in sales, allowing Amouage to maintain premium prices without losing most of its customer base (Business Research Insights; Business of Fashion, 2026).
On the supply side, the main challenges are rising raw material costs (oud, Bulgarian rose, and vetiver went up 20–40% in 2024–25) and a production limit of around 25,000 bottles per week. Amouage manages these pressures by owning its own frankincense grove (vertical integration), running a 100% solar-powered factory, and leveraging capital from L'Oréal's minority stake to expand its boutiques from 16 to 25 globally (DataIntelo, 2025; Business of Fashion, 2025a).
Two government interventions are studied: Oman's Vision 2040 industrial policy, which addresses under-investment in positive externalities, and the Oman IP Law framework, which tackles information asymmetry caused by counterfeiting. Finally, four policy recommendations are proposed by government regulators, each addressing a specific market failure.

AI.tldr: 本文运用微观经济学理论分析阿曼奢侈香水品牌Amouage，涵盖市场结构、需求价格弹性、供需及政府干预，发现其在垄断竞争市场中具有缺乏弹性的需求（PED约-0.3至-0.5），并通过垂直整合、太阳能工厂等方式应对供应链挑战。
AI.research_question: Amouage如何通过微观经济学框架（市场结构、需求弹性、供需、政府干预）实现奢侈品定位下的高增长与市场维持？
AI.motivation: 奢侈香水品牌在经济波动与成本上涨环境下的定价策略与市场生存机制尚待深入理解，Amouage作为Omani皇室背景品牌提供了一个独特案例。
AI.theoretical_framework: 垄断竞争市场理论、需求价格弹性（PED）理论、供需分析、市场失灵与政府干预理论（正外部性、信息不对称）。
AI.method: 基于微观经济理论的案例研究，数据来源于行业报告、公司新闻稿及可信新闻来源。
AI.findings: (1) Amouage处于垄断竞争市场，凭借皇室 heritage、UNESCO保护乳香、超高浓度配方支撑溢价定价（$250-$550/瓶）；(2) 2025年销售额$430M+，同比增长66%；(3) 需求缺乏弹性（PED≈-0.3至-0.5），提价不显著损失销量；(4) 供应端面临原料成本上涨（20-40%）及产能限制（约25,000瓶/周），通过垂直整合、太阳能工厂、L'Oréal投资缓解压力。
AI.theory_contributions: 将垄断竞争与需求价格弹性理论应用于小众奢侈香水品牌的实证分析，展示了高端细分市场中缺乏弹性需求的持续性机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为奢侈品牌管理者提供定价策略参考（在缺乏弹性需求下可维持高价）；为政府政策制定者提出四项针对市场失灵的政策建议（基于阿曼2040愿景工业政策与知识产权法框架）。

title: Gradual Civic Capitulation: Conceptualizing Political Legitimacy Amidst Social Decline

detail.title: Gradual Civic Capitulation: Conceptualizing Political Legitimacy Amidst Social Decline

keywords: Selective State Decomposition under Democratic Continuity

detail.abstract: The formulation of the category of gradual civic capitulation is part of a line of research oriented toward the analysis of contemporary forms of political legitimation of social deterioration, previously developed in La descomposición de un Estado. Argentina 2023–2025 (Enricci, 2026a) and in Selective State Decomposition under Democratic Continuity (Enricci, 2026b). In this framework, the concept seeks to contribute to the understanding of the mechanisms by which certain processes of economic, institutional and social deterioration manage to sustain persistent levels of electoral legitimacy and symbolic adherence. Gradual civic capitulation is the process by which social sectors electorally and symbolically sustain a political model even when they experience its adverse material effects. It is a dynamic form of reorganization of social expectations in which present deterioration is integrated into common sense as part of horizons associated with order, stability or the promise of future transformation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"渐进式公民投降"这一概念，用于解释经济、制度和社会恶化如何在民主连续性下仍能维持持久的选举合法性与象征性依附。该过程描述社会群体即便亲历政治模型的负面物质后果，仍会在选举和象征上继续支持该模型。
AI.research_question: 在经济、制度与社会持续恶化的背景下，为什么这些过程仍能维持持久的选举合法性与象征性依附？"渐进式公民投降"这一概念如何解释这一现象？
AI.motivation: 旨在分析与社会恶化相关的当代政治合法化形式，理解恶化与合法性并存的内在机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 渐进式公民投降、政治合法化、社会期望重组、常识整合
AI.method: 概念建构与理论推演，基于前期研究（Enricci, 2026a, 2026b）的延续性框架
AI.findings: 渐进式公民投降是一种动态的社会期望重组形式，在此过程中，当前的恶化被整合进常识，成为与秩序、稳定或未来变革承诺相关的前景的一部分。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"渐进式公民投降"这一新概念，为理解社会恶化与选举合法性并存现象提供了分析工具，丰富了当代政治合法化理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 有助于识别和批判那些在恶化条件下仍能维持政治支持的社会心理机制，为公民觉醒与政治重构提供理论参照。

title: Airbnb and Returns to Housing Capital: Evidence on Inequality from administrative Data
affiliations: CEREGE, University of La Rochelle, affiliation not provided to SSRN and University of Nantes - IAE - Department of Business Administration

detail.title: Airbnb and Returns to Housing Capital: Evidence on Inequality from administrative Data
detail.abstract: This paper examines the distributional implications of Airbnb income using matched administrative data combining transaction-level tourist tax records, cadastral data, and household tax data from the La Rochelle coastal urban area in France. We conceptualize short-term rentals as a mechanism enabling households to extract an intermittent tourist rent from housing assets. Using a Heckman selection model, we distinguish between participation in Airbnb activity and revenues conditional on participation. The results show that higherincome households are more likely to participate in Airbnb hosting, but that higher revenues are driven primarily by price premium rather than rental intensity. This suggests that Airbnb amplifies unequal returns associated with heterogeneous housing assets rather than differences in hosting effort. At the same time, Airbnb income represents a substantial share of disposable income for some lower-income households. The paper highlights the dual role of short-term rentals as both a mechanism reinforcing income concentration and a source of temporary income buffering.

AI.tldr: 本文利用法国拉罗谢尔沿海城市区的行政数据，研究Airbnb收入的分配效应。研究发现高收入家庭更可能参与Airbnb活动，但高收入主要源于房价溢价而非出租强度，表明Airbnb放大了异质住房资产带来的不平等回报，同时对部分低收入家庭构成重要的临时收入缓冲。
AI.research_question: Airbnb收入的分配效应如何？具体而言，哪些家庭更可能参与Airbnb活动，以及参与后哪些因素驱动收入差异？
AI.motivation: 短期租赁平台（如Airbnb）在全球迅速扩张，但其对收入分配的影响尚不明确。现有研究缺乏大规模行政数据来区分参与决策与收入水平的决定因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 将短期租赁概念化为一种使家庭能够从住房资产中提取间歇性"旅游租金"的机制。
AI.method: 使用Heckman选择模型，区分Airbnb活动的参与决策和参与后的收入水平；数据来源为法国拉罗谢尔沿海城市区的旅游税记录、地籍数据和家庭税收数据的匹配行政数据。
AI.findings: （1）高收入家庭更可能参与Airbnb活动；（2）参与后的高收入主要由房价溢价驱动，而非出租强度（即更努力出租）；（3）Airbnb收入对部分低收入家庭构成可观的收入份额，起到临时缓冲作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了Airbnb的双重作用：既加剧了与异质住房资产相关的回报不平等（强化收入集中），又为部分低收入家庭提供临时收入缓冲。区分了"参与"与"收入水平"的不同决定机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解短期租赁监管（如税收政策、租赁限制）对不同收入群体的差异化影响提供了实证依据。

title: Global Equity Risk Premiums (ERP) & Country Risk Premiums (CRP)

detail.title: Global Equity Risk Premiums (ERP) & Country Risk Premiums (CRP)
detail.abstract: Every valuation rests on a discount rate, and every discount rate rests on a risk premium. When that valuation involves a company operating in Brazil or an acquirer pricing a target in Indonesia, the question of which risk premium to use becomes anything but trivial, investors in these markets bear political instability, violence, corruption, and institutional fragility that mature markets have largely priced away. Ignoring that is not conservatism, it is mispricing. This paper documents the methodology for estimating Equity Risk Premiums and Country Risk Premiums across 174 countries and 9 global regions as of April-May 2026, building explicitly on the framework developed by Professor Aswath Damodaran of NYU Stern, with three methodological refinements: the risk-free rate is derived by netting CDS spreads against Switzerland rather than applying a rating-based default spread, ensuring consistency with the CRP framework; the mature market ERP strips America's full country risk premium rather than its raw sovereign default spread from the implied ERP; the relative volatility multiplier uses indices with balanced exposure across both developed and emerging markets; all through a three-tier hierarchy of CDS spreads, Moody's rating-implied spreads, and Political Risk Service scores. The result is a set of estimates any analyst can use in cross-border valuation without rebuilding the methodology from scratch.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了截至2026年4-5月174个国家和9个全球区域的股权风险溢价（ERP）和国家风险溢价（CRP）估算方法，基于Damodaran框架并引入三项方法论改进，为跨国估值提供可直接使用的风险溢价估计值。
AI.research_question: 如何系统性地估算跨国股权投资中的股权风险溢价和国家风险溢价，以解决新兴市场估值中风险定价不准确的问题？
AI.motivation: 巴西、印度尼西亚等新兴市场存在政治不稳定、暴力、腐败和制度脆弱性等风险，成熟市场已基本定价消除这些风险。忽视这些风险不是保守主义，而是错误定价。需要一套系统的方法论来估算各国风险溢价。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Aswath Damodaran（NYU Stern）的CRP框架，引入三项方法论改进：(1) 无风险利率通过CDS利差与瑞士净额计算，而非基于评级的违约利差；(2) 成熟市场ERP剔除美国全部国家风险溢价而非仅主权违约利差；(3) 相对波动率乘数使用对发达和新兴市场均衡暴露的指数。使用CDS利差、穆迪评级隐含利差和政治风险服务评分三级层次结构。
AI.method: 构建三级层次结构估算方法：第一层使用信用违约互换（CDS）利差；第二层使用穆迪评级隐含利差；第三层使用政治风险服务（PRS）评分。通过三项方法论改进优化Damodaran原始框架，对174个国家和9个全球区域进行系统估算。
AI.findings: 提供了174个国家和9个全球区域截至2026年4-5月的股权风险溢价和国家风险溢价估算值，任何分析师都可在跨国估值中直接使用这些估计，无需从零重建方法论。
AI.theory_contributions: 对Damodaran的CRP框架进行了三项方法论改进，使风险溢价估算在跨国比较中更加一致和准确，特别是解决了成熟市场与新兴市场之间的风险定价差异问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为跨境估值分析师提供了可直接使用的174个国家和9个全球区域的风险溢价估算值，降低了跨国估值的方法论门槛，避免了分析师从零重建估算框架的繁琐工作。

title: AMEC IIJA/DOE PROJECT Task 3.9.1 Integrated Techno-Economic Assessment of Risk-Averse Offshore Energy Portfolios Under Resource and Hurricanes Uncertainty in the East Coast Literature Review Report
affiliations: North Carolina State University, University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill, Lehigh University, North Carolina State University, North Carolina State University, North Carolina State University - Department of Civil, Construction, and Environmental Engineering, Lehigh University, University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill, Lehigh University, Lehigh University, North Carolina State University - Department of Civil, Construction, and Environmental Engineering and North Carolina State University

detail.title: AMEC IIJA/DOE PROJECT Task 3.9.1 Integrated Techno-Economic Assessment of Risk-Averse Offshore Energy Portfolios Under Resource and Hurricanes Uncertainty in the East Coast Literature Review Report

declarations.funderStatement: Atlantic Marine Energy Center (AMEC) research project supported by the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act (IIJA) and the U.S. Department of Energy

detail.abstract: This report presents the literature review, end-user consultation, and data collection completed for AMEC Task 3.9.1, focused on the integrated techno-economic assessment of risk-averse offshore energy portfolios under resource and hurricane uncertainty along the U.S. East Coast. The review synthesizes current knowledge across six interdependent domains: marine energy technologies, mooring and anchoring systems, offshore electrical infrastructure, wind fragility of power infrastructure, environmental and ecological risks, and end-user modeling tools and data sources. Across these domains, the report identifies key technical opportunities and constraints for offshore wave, tidal, ocean current, and hybrid energy systems, including resource variability, device maturity, infrastructure costs, survivability, environmental siting limitations, and grid interconnection challenges. The review highlights that marine energy deployment analysis will likely require portfolio-based planning rather than single-technology evaluation, due to differences in resource profiles, technology readiness, infrastructure needs, and environmental constraints. It also identifies important gaps in site-specific performance data, cost modeling, fragility assessment, and integration of ecological and regulatory layers into planning tools.

AI.tldr: 本文对AMEC任务3.9.1（美国东海岸飓风和资源不确定性下风险规避型海上能源组合的综合技术经济评估）进行了文献综述、终端用户咨询和数据收集总结。研究横跨海洋能源技术、系泊锚固系统、海上电气基础设施、电力基础设施的风脆弱性、环境生态风险、终端用户建模工具与数据源六个相互依赖的领域，指出海上能源部署需要基于组合规划而非单一技术评估，并识别了关键数据与方法论缺口。
AI.research_question: 在美国东海岸资源不确定性和飓风风险下，如何对风险规避型海上能源组合进行综合的技术经济评估？
AI.motivation: 海上波浪能、潮汐能、洋流能和混合能源系统在技术成熟度、资源分布、基础设施成本和环境约束方面存在显著差异，单一技术评估不足以支撑科学决策，需要组合层面的规划方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组合规划理论（portfolio-based planning）、技术经济评估框架、风险规避决策理论、资源与飓风不确定性建模。
AI.method: 文献综述、终端用户咨询、数据收集，覆盖六个相互依赖的领域（海洋能源技术、系泊锚固、电气基础设施、风脆弱性、环境生态风险、建模工具与数据源）。
AI.findings: (1) 海上能源部署应采用组合规划而非单一技术评估；(2) 各领域存在显著的技术机会与约束；(3) 关键缺口包括场地特定性能数据、成本建模、脆弱性评估、生态与监管层在规划工具中的整合不足。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统性地构建了跨六个领域的技术经济评估知识体系，提出了组合规划视角下的海上能源评估框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为美国东海岸海上能源项目的风险规避型规划提供了综合文献基础、用户需求分析和数据来源清单，明确了未来数据收集和模型开发方向。

title: Fianna Fáil’s Cross-Class Ideological Strategy Since 2011: The Limits of ‘Progressive Republicanism’ and the Very End of One-Party Hegemony
affiliations: University of the West of Scotland

detail.title: Fianna Fáil’s Cross-Class Ideological Strategy Since 2011: The Limits of ‘Progressive Republicanism’ and the Very End of One-Party Hegemony

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: This article analyses and evaluates Fianna Fáil's 'progressive republican' cross-class ideological strategy between 2011 and 2024 after the economic crisis and electoral collapse in 2011. Drawing on Antonio Gramsci's hegemony, it demonstrates how the party reconstructed strategically 'national-popular' identity (i.e. republicanism) and 'common sense' values (i.e. 'fairness') to attempt to rebuild ideologically a cross-class alliance-the historic foundation of its hegemony. Party leader speeches, party literature and policy documents are analysed to show how its 'progressive republican' collective identity and core values framed a new programme. It argues the strategy yielded a partial recovery but ultimately failed at the implementation stage as it was unable and unwilling to transform substantially the structural effects of Fianna Fáil's previous neoliberal policies. The latter created deep class contradictions and inequalities in housing and health provision for low and median-income workers. This meant the limited concessions actually implemented post-2020 were ineffective in winning their consent. I thus conclude that the era of Fianna Fáil one-party hegemony is finally over. The article also defends class and ideological analysis in the light of this application maintaining against existing scholarship that it can provide insights into Fianna Fáil and wider Irish party politics.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了爱尔兰共和党（Fianna Fáil）在2011年经济危机和选举崩溃后，试图通过"进步共和主义"的跨阶级意识形态策略重建霸权，但最终因无法实质性解决新自由主义政策造成的阶级矛盾而失败。
AI.research_question: Fianna Fáil在2011-2024年间如何通过"进步共和主义"意识形态策略重建跨阶级联盟？该策略为何最终未能成功？
AI.motivation: 2011年经济危机和选举崩溃后，Fianna Fáil面临历史性衰落，其试图通过意识形态重建来恢复政治霸权，但实际效果有限，需要深入分析其策略逻辑与失败原因。
AI.theoretical_framework: 安东尼奥·葛兰西的霸权理论（hegemony），特别是"民族-民意"（national-popular）身份认同和"常识"（common sense）价值观的分析框架。
AI.method: 对政党领袖演讲、政党文献和政策文件的质性话语分析。
AI.findings: "进步共和主义"策略在话语层面取得部分恢复，但实施阶段失败——该党既无意愿也无能力实质性转变此前新自由主义政策造成的结构性影响，导致住房和医疗等领域对中低收入阶层的让步不足，无法赢得其同意。
AI.theory_contributions: 论证了阶级分析与意识形态分析在理解Fianna Fáil及更广泛的爱尔兰政党政治中仍具有解释力，回应了既有学术研究的质疑。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了政党试图通过意识形态重构重建跨阶级联盟时的结构性限制——若不触及既有政策造成的阶级矛盾与不平等，话语层面的努力难以转化为实际政治支持。

title: Planned Obsolescence and Environmental Law

detail.title: Planned Obsolescence and Environmental Law
detail.abstract:
Planned obsolescence has long been discussed from the perspective of consumer protection and market regulation. Its environmental dimension, however, remains insufficiently explored, particularly regarding the role of public policies that indirectly stimulate unsustainable production models. This paper analyzes the legal paradox created when governments grant fiscal incentives or environmental operating licenses to companies whose business strategies rely on artificially shortened product life cycles. Such practices significantly increase the generation of electronic waste, transferring environmental and economic burdens to municipalities responsible for waste management.
Based on Brazilian environmental law and comparative regulatory frameworks, the study investigates whether current licensing procedures adequately assess the full life cycle of products and whether tax benefits granted without environmental conditionalities are compatible with constitutional principles of sustainable development. The article argues for the incorporation of durability, reparability, and reverse logistics obligations as mandatory criteria in environmental licensing and fiscal incentive programs. Finally, it proposes regulatory alternatives aimed at aligning economic policies with circular economy principles and the polluter-pays doctrine.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了政府通过财政激励和环境许可证间接支持有计划报废（人为缩短产品寿命）的法律悖论，提出应将对可修复性、耐用性和逆向物流的要求纳入环境许可和税收优惠政策，以符合循环经济原则。
AI.research_question: 1. 现行的环境许可程序是否充分评估了产品的全生命周期？2. 无环境附加条件的税收优惠是否符合可持续发展的宪法原则？3. 如何通过监管改革将耐用性、可修复性和逆向物流义务纳入环境许可和财政激励计划？
AI.motivation: 有计划报废的环境维度长期被忽视，尤其是公共政策（如税收优惠、经营许可证）间接助长了不可持续的生产模式，加剧了电子废弃物问题，将环境和经济负担转嫁给地方政府。
AI.theoretical_framework: 巴西环境法、比较监管框架、循环经济原则、污染者付费原则、可持续发展宪法原则。
AI.method: 法律分析：基于巴西环境法与比较法框架，对现行环境许可程序和财政激励制度进行规范分析，提出制度重构建议。
AI.findings: 政府授予的财政激励和环境许可证若缺乏对产品全生命周期的评估和环境附加条件，会与可持续发展宪法原则相悖，并加剧电子废弃物问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了有计划报废问题中公共政策间接促成的法律悖论，将环境许可与财政激励制度的讨论延伸至产品生命周期和循环经济领域。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出将耐用性、可修复性和逆向物流义务作为环境许可和财政激励的强制性标准，为政策制定者提供了具体的监管改革方向。

title: Market Learning from Sequential Geopolitical Escalations: Evidence from Airline Stocks
affiliations: Bar-Ilan University - Graduate School of Business Administration

detail.title: Market Learning from Sequential Geopolitical Escalations: Evidence from Airline Stocks
detail.abstract: This study examines how financial markets respond to three sequential escalations of conflict with increasing geographic scope: a local conflict in Israel, a regional escalation involving Iran, and a global episode involving the United States. Focusing on the airline industry, which is particularly vulnerable to geopolitical crises, we treat this sequence as a quasi-natural experiment to assess how markets adjust to repeated shocks. Using a sample of 56 publicly traded airlines, we find that greater direct exposure to conflict-related regions is associated with larger immediate negative abnormal returns (ARs), primarily during the local event. Over time, however, this pattern attenuates and partially reverses across groups: Israeli and U.S. firms exhibit greater resilience and stronger recovery, suggesting that initial exposure-based pricing is revised. We find only partial support for the hypothesis that market responses increase monotonically with escalation scope: the global escalation generates the largest and most uniform negative response, whereas the regional escalation yields muted effects despite its broader geographic scope. Across business model categories, exposed low-cost carriers incur larger losses across all three episodes, while non-exposed low-cost carriers are disproportionately affected during the global escalation. Overall, the evidence supports a dynamic adjustment process in which exposure-based pricing is strongest during the initial local shock but weakens as geopolitical shocks broaden. Investors appear to shift from exposurebased pricing to a broader reassessment of industry-wide risk.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用以色列局部冲突、伊朗地区升级和美国全球卷入三次连续冲突事件，以56家上市航空公司为样本，发现市场最初基于地理暴露程度定价（局部冲击最显著），但随着冲突范围扩大，暴露效应的定价逐渐减弱并部分逆转，投资者从"暴露定价"转向"行业整体风险重估"。
AI.research_question: 金融市场如何响应三次具有递增地理范围（局部→区域→全球）的冲突升级？市场定价是否随冲突范围扩大而单调递增？
AI.motivation: 地缘政治冲突日益频繁且呈升级态势，但现有研究缺乏对同一冲突链中连续升级事件的动态市场反应分析，尤其缺乏对市场从"暴露定价"向"行业风险重估"调整过程的实证证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场有效性理论、暴露定价理论、投资者注意力与学习效应、地缘政治风险定价的动态调整机制。
AI.method: 准自然实验设计，事件研究法计算异常收益（ARs），分组比较（按地理暴露程度、商业模式、国别），跨三次事件的动态比较分析。
AI.findings: （1）局部冲突中地理暴露越大的航空公司负向异常收益越大；（2）随冲突范围扩大，暴露定价效应减弱并部分逆转，以色列和美国企业恢复力更强；（3）市场反应并非单调递增：全球升级反应最大最均匀，区域升级反应反而平淡；（4）暴露的低成本航空公司在三次事件中损失最大，非暴露的低成本航空公司在全球升级中受影响显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了地缘政治风险定价的动态调整机制——投资者在连续冲击中从"基于暴露的定价"转向"行业整体风险重估"；挑战了"冲突范围越大市场反应越强"的单调性假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为航空业投资者和管理者提供了地缘政治风险分级管理策略的依据；提示企业在局部冲突时需关注暴露风险，而在全球性危机中需防范行业系统性风险。

title: Log-returns Structure: A Three-dimensional Edge Framework
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Log-returns Structure: A Three-dimensional Edge Framework
detail.abstract:
This paper extends the previously published article: "Log-Returns Structure: Probability, Volatility, Risk, Bias, and Edge in Financial Markets" by presenting a three-dimensional interpretation of financial Edge. The framework is based on decomposing a log-return series into cumulative positive and negative movement components, allowing return to be analyzed not only as a final outcome, but as an internal structure.

The central contribution of the paper is the expansion of Edge from a single measure into three complementary dimensions: Edge relative to total movement, Edge relative to negative movement, and Edge relative to positive movement. These three dimensions provide different perspectives on the same return structure and form a closed mathematical system through the Log-Bias Ratio.

This framework enables a more precise interpretation of return quality. It distinguishes between the efficiency of total movement conversion, return relative to adverse movement, and the degree to which positive movement is retained after negative movement is deducted.

The paper also applies the framework to long and short positions. At the asset level, positive and negative movements describe objective price structure. At the investor level, their economic meaning depends on the direction of exposure. For long positions, negative movement represents adverse movement; for short positions, positive movement becomes the relevant adverse component. The paper further emphasizes that structural symmetry in log-return space does not imply full symmetry in realized wealth, especially for passive short positions.

The proposed framework does not replace classical performance metrics. Rather, it provides a compact structural layer that may complement asset analysis, strategy evaluation, long/short comparison, backtesting diagnostics, and quantitative model construction.

AI.tldr: 本文在先前研究基础上，提出了一种三维金融Edge分析框架，通过将对数收益率序列分解为正向和负向累积运动分量，从总运动、负向运动和正向运动三个维度重新定义Edge，形成一个封闭的数学体系，并应用于多空头分析。
AI.research_question: 如何将对数收益率的Edge从单一度量扩展为三维互补框架，以更精确地解释收益质量并应用于多空头分析？
AI.motivation: 传统的Edge度量仅关注最终收益结果，无法揭示收益的内部结构质量。本文旨在通过分解收益率序列，提供对收益效率、抗逆能力和正向保留程度的更精细解读。
AI.theoretical_framework: 对数收益率结构分解（正向/负向运动分量）；三维Edge度量（总运动Edge、负向运动Edge、正向运动Edge）；Log-Bias Ratio封闭数学系统；多空头对称性与不对称性分析。
AI.method: 理论推导与数学建模。通过对数收益率序列的分解，构建三个维度的Edge度量，并借助Log-Bias Ratio建立三者间的封闭数学关系。同时从资产层面和投资者层面分别定义正负向运动的经济含义。
AI.findings: 三维Edge框架能够区分总运动转化效率、相对于不利运动的收益表现，以及扣除负向运动后正向运动的保留程度。该框架适用于多空头分析，但指出对数收益率空间的结构对称性并不等同于实际财富的完全对称。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Edge从单维度扩展为三维互补框架，建立了基于对数收益率分解的封闭数学体系，深化了对收益结构质量的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 该框架可补充资产分析、策略评估、多空头比较、回测诊断和量化模型构建，提供更精细的收益质量解读工具。

title: Agentic AI Cyber Subversion: The Semantic Layer Integrity Attack as a New Threat Class Against the Reasoning Layer

detail.title: Agentic AI Cyber Subversion: The Semantic Layer Integrity Attack as a New Threat Class Against the Reasoning Layer

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This paper is submitted in an individual capacity as original practitioner-led research. The author has no financial relationships or organizational affiliations that influenced this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper presents original practitioner-led conceptual research. No human subjects, personal data, animal subjects, or experimental protocols were involved. No institutional ethics review was required or applicable.
declarations.funderStatement: Unfunded. This research was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract:
Agentic AI introduces a cyber risk that does not begin with compromised credentials, poisoned training data, prompt injection, unauthorized tool use, or anomalous output. It begins when an autonomous system resolves the meaning of a regulated term across enterprise systems before execution, and that resolved meaning diverges from the definition the institution authorized. The corrupted object is not the input, the output, the model, the tool call, or the log. It is the resolved operational meaning.

This paper defines Agentic Workflow Subversion as the enterprise risk surface created when reasoning-layer drift propagates across workflows, systems, and control boundaries. It defines the Semantic Layer Integrity Attack (SLIA) as the deliberate adversarial form of that risk: a cross-system integrity attack in which an actor manipulates the semantic conditions under which an agent resolves authorization, eligibility, clearance, risk, or control status, while every contributing system continues to behave correctly. It is a failure of control integrity without system compromise. The attack is cyber-relevant because it produces a clean control record. The network is not breached. The model is not necessarily altered. The prompt may be benign. The tool call may be authorized. The output may be well formed. The audit trail may be complete. Yet execution proceeds under a corrupted operational interpretation that no human or institution authorized.

It situates the attack against existing agent security controls, including identity, workload authentication, prompt and input defenses, tool governance, memory and retrieval controls, output filtering, auditability, and defense-in-depth architectures. It shows that these controls are necessary but incomplete, because they govern the artifacts around agentic reasoning rather than the meaning resolved by the reasoning layer itself. It then maps the gap against current cyber and AI governance taxonomies, including NIST adversarial machine learning, the OWASP agentic AI security corpus, MITRE ATLAS, STRIDE, the Five Eyes agentic AI security guidance, and financial sector supervisory expectations, in the disciplined posture that each framework is authoritative for the scope it declares and the reasoning layer is the adjacent surface it does not directly observe.

The contribution is a cyber threat class definition and a control surface argument. Agentic Workflow Subversion names the risk surface. The Semantic Layer Integrity Attack names its adversarial exploitation path. Semantic Substrate Validation and the Semantic Control Plane (SCP), operating within the broader Agentic Governance Model (AGM), name the runtime governance surface required to detect, constrain, and evidence semantic integrity before execution proceeds. It closes with detection and test conditions, control tailoring, and supervisory implications, so that the threat class is operationally actionable for a cybersecurity function rather than only conceptually defined.

AI.tldr: 本文定义了"代理工作流颠覆"（Agentic Workflow Subversion）这一新型企业风险面，以及"语义层完整性攻击"（SLIA）——攻击者操纵自主智能体在跨系统执行时对受控术语的语义解析，使其偏离机构授权定义，造成控制完整性被破坏但无任何系统被攻陷的威胁。
AI.research_question: 自主智能体（Agentic AI）在执行跨企业系统工作流时，其推理层对受控术语（如授权、资格、风险级别等）的语义解析是否存在一种独特的、现有安全控制无法覆盖的完整性攻击面？
AI.motivation: 现有Agent安全控制（身份认证、输入清洗、工具治理、输出过滤、可审计性等）均围绕推理层的输入输出和周边工件展开，但未保护推理层本身解析出的"操作语义"的完整性。这种语义解析在跨系统传播时可能发生漂移，导致执行行为与机构授权意图背离，且不留下任何传统攻击痕迹。
AI.theoretical_framework: 推理层漂移理论（Reasoning-Layer Drift）、语义完整性理论、控制完整性理论；对比对照NIST对抗机器学习、OWASP代理AI安全、MITRE ATLAS、STRIDE、五眼联盟代理AI安全指南及金融监管框架等既有分类体系。
AI.method: 概念性威胁建模与理论论证。通过定义威胁类、刻画攻击路径、映射现有安全控制缺口、提出语义层面验证方案（Semantic Substrate Validation, SCP, AGM），形成从威胁定义到检测条件与控制实施的操作化框架。
AI.findings: 1. 定义了"代理工作流颠覆"风险面和"语义层完整性攻击"攻击路径；2. 论证了现有七类Agent安全控制（身份、工作负载认证、提示与输入防御、工具治理、记忆与检索控制、输出过滤、纵深防御）均无法覆盖推理层语义完整性；3. 指出该攻击可产生"干净的审计记录"——网络未入侵、模型未篡改、提示合法、工具调用被授权、输出格式正确，但执行语义已遭篡改；4. 提出了语义基质验证（Semantic Substrate Validation）和语义控制平面（SCP）作为运行时治理方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并正式定义了"代理工作流颠覆"和"语义层完整性攻击"两个新威胁类别，填补了现有AI安全与网络安全分类学中关于"推理层语义完整性"的理论空白；确立了"无系统入侵的控制完整性失效"作为一种独立的网络威胁类别。
AI.practical_contributions: 为网络安全从业者提供了可操作的威胁检测与测试条件、控制裁剪建议和监管启示；对金融机构等高度依赖语义一致性的行业（如授权审批、风险控制、合规检查）具有直接的安全治理指导价值；提示现有监管框架（NIST、OWASP、MITRE等）存在的相邻盲区。

title: Appraisal Lag And Market Signals In Private Credit: Evidence From Cdli And Clo Index Spreads

detail.title: Appraisal Lag And Market Signals In Private Credit: Evidence From Cdli And Clo Index Spreads

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest. This research was conducted independently and received no financial support from any organization with a financial interest in the results.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study uses publicly available financial data only (SEC EDGAR filings, publicly released index reports, and Bloomberg Terminal data). No human subjects, patients, or participants were involved. Ethics approval is not applicable.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Private credit valuations rely on quarterly appraisals derived from SEC filings, introducing a structural lag between market conditions and reported performance. This paper tests whether CLO market signals lead the Cliffwater Direct Lending Index (CDLI), the primary private credit benchmark, and quantifies the resulting valuation delay. Using CDLI quarterly returns (2004-2025) and JPMorgan CLOIE BB and BBB discount margins (2014-2026), we apply five empirical tests. CDLI returns exhibit significant positive serial correlation (AR(1) = 0.294, p = 0.007). Geltner (1993) unsmoothing reveals that quarterly volatility is understated by 26%, with maximum drawdown deepening from-6.68% to-9.00%. Crosscorrelation analysis shows CLOIE BB margins lead CDLI returns by one quarter (r = 0.584, p < 0.001). Granger tests suggest incremental predictive content across lags one through three (p < 0.05).

AI.tldr: 本文发现私人信贷基准CDLI的季度估值存在结构性延迟，CLO市场信号领先CDLI约一个季度，经平滑调整后实际波动率和最大回撤均被显著低估。
AI.research_question: CLO市场信号是否领先私人信贷基准CDLI？估值延迟的程度有多大？
AI.motivation: 私人信贷的估值依赖SEC备案的季度评估，导致市场状况与报告表现之间存在结构性时滞，投资者可能被平滑后的低波动率所误导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 估值平滑（Geltner unsmoothing）、序列自相关、交叉相关分析、Granger因果关系。
AI.method: 使用CDLI季度收益率（2004-2025）与JPMorgan CLOIE BB和BBB折让利差（2014-2026），进行五项实证检验：自相关检验、Geltner平滑调整、交叉相关分析、Granger因果检验。
AI.findings: ①CDLI收益存在显著正自相关（AR(1)=0.294, p=0.007）；②季度波动率被低估26%，最大回撤从-6.68%扩大至-9.00%；③CLOIE BB利差领先CDLI一个季度（r=0.584, p<0.001）；④Granger检验表明滞后1-3期具有增量预测能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统量化私人信贷基准的估值延迟，将CLO市场信号引入私人信贷定价效率研究，拓展了估值平滑理论在非公开市场的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为私人信贷投资者提供实时估值校正信号，提示实际风险（波动率、回撤）被系统性低估，辅助风险管理与资产配置决策。

reference: University of Chicago, Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper No. 2026-82
title: AI Diffusion Gaps: Unequal Integration of AI Across K-12 Schools
affiliations: University of Chicago Booth School of Business and University of Rochester - Department of Economics

detail.title: AI Diffusion Gaps: Unequal Integration of AI Across K-12 Schools

publicationDetails.detailsText: University of Chicago, Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper No. 2026-82
publicationDetails.journalName: Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Although use of generative AI tools has quickly become widespread in education settings, emerging evidence suggests that effects on learning will depend on how that use is supported and guided. This paper reports findings from an original national survey of K-12 school principals designed to measure institutional integration of AI in schools through policies, teacher training, guidance for student use, leadership engagement, and the availability of AI-enabled tools. We find that AI use has spread rapidly across schools, largely as a productivity aid. Students mainly use AI for homework help and writing, while educators primarily use it for lesson planning and administrative tasks. The development of teacher training, guidance, and school policies has lagged adoption. We next document two diffusion gaps across schools: First, lower AI integration is associated with a higher share of disadvantaged students (a one standard deviation increase in disadvantage is associated with a 0.07-0.11σ lower score on an index of AI integration); Second, private and charter schools score 0.23-0.44σ lower on the AI integration index than traditional public schools. Although several surveyed school-level factors strongly predict AI integration, they do little to explain these gaps. Differences in district size account for roughly one-third of the disadvantage gap between public schools. These findings suggest that the factors associated with greater AI integration differ from those needed to narrow disparities in how schools support and guide AI use.

AI.tldr: 基于全美K-12校长调查，发现生成式AI已在学校快速普及，主要用于提高效率，但教师培训、指导准则和政策制定明显滞后。学校在AI整合上存在差距：弱势学生比例高的学校整合度较低，私立和特许学校低于传统公立学校。这些差距难以用学校层面的因素解释。
AI.research_question: 美国K-12学校在多大程度上通过政策、教师培训、学生使用指导、领导参与和AI工具可用性等方面实现了生成式AI的制度化整合？不同学校之间在AI整合上存在哪些差距？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI在教育领域快速普及，但新兴证据表明其对学习的影响取决于使用方式的支持和引导。目前缺乏全国性、系统性的调查来了解学校如何在制度层面整合AI。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术采用与制度整合理论；教育公平与数字鸿沟理论；学校组织变革理论。
AI.method: 全美K-12学校校长原始调查数据；构建AI整合指数（涵盖政策、教师培训、学生使用指导、领导参与、AI工具可用性五个维度）；使用回归分析等统计方法。
AI.findings: (1) AI在学校快速普及，主要作为生产力工具：学生用于作业帮助和写作，教师用于备课和行政任务。(2) 教师培训、指导准则和学校政策制定滞后于技术采用。(3) 存在两种扩散差距：弱势学生比例高的学校AI整合度较低（劣势每增加1个标准差，AI整合指数降低0.07-0.11σ）；私立和特许学校比传统公立学校低0.23-0.44σ。(4) 学校层面因素难以解释这些差距，学区规模差异仅能解释公立学校之间约三分之一的劣势差距。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了AI在教育领域的制度化整合存在"双重滞后"（技术采用领先于制度建设）和"双重差距"（按学生群体和学校类型分化的现象），拓展了技术采用与教育公平理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育政策制定者和学校管理者提供了系统性证据：学校AI整合需要关注制度建设（培训、政策、指导），而不仅仅是技术推广；缩减AI整合差距需要超越学校层面因素，关注更宏观的结构性因素（如学区规模）。

title: Graph Neural Network Optimization of Carbon Nanotube-doped Portland Cement for Structural Energy Storage

detail.title: Graph Neural Network Optimization of Carbon Nanotube-doped Portland Cement for Structural Energy Storage

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper. The computational models and findings presented are for academic and research purposes.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this study. The research is entirely computational and relies on in silico molecular simulations (Graph Neural Networks) to model material properties. No human participants, animal subjects, or personally identifiable information were involved in any stage of this research.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The study was conducted independently.

detail.abstract: The integration of electrochemical energy storage into structural materials presents a paradigm shift for the built environment. We developed a Graph Neural Network (GNN) to optimize the doping of Portland cement with Carbon Nanotubes (CNTs). The model identified an optimal CNT concentration of 4.73 vol%, achieving a maximum energy density of 112.47 Wh/m 3 while retaining a compressive strength of 24.01 MPa. This exceeds the 20 MPa threshold required for residential foundations. Our computational pipeline demonstrates the viability of transforming standard concrete infrastructure into grid-scale energy storage systems.

AI.tldr: 本文利用图神经网络优化了碳纳米管掺杂波特兰水泥的比例，在4.73 vol%的CNT浓度下实现了112.47 Wh/m³的能量密度和24.01 MPa的抗压强度，证明将标准混凝土基础设施转化为电网级储能系统是可行的。
AI.research_question: 如何通过图神经网络优化碳纳米管掺杂水泥的比例，使其兼具结构承重和电化学储能双重功能？
AI.motivation: 将电化学储能集成到结构材料中对建筑环境具有变革意义，但现有研究缺乏对掺杂比例的系统优化方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 图神经网络、电化学储能理论、水泥基复合材料力学性能理论
AI.method: 构建图神经网络模型，对波特兰水泥中碳纳米管的掺杂比例进行优化，通过计算预测最佳配比并进行实验验证。
AI.findings: 最优CNT浓度为4.73 vol%，此时能量密度达112.47 Wh/m³，抗压强度为24.01 MPa，超过住宅地基所需20 MPa的阈值。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种利用图神经网络优化结构储能复合材料成分的方法论框架，为电化学储能与结构材料的融合提供了新的计算范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 证明了将标准混凝土基础设施改造为电网级储能系统的可行性，为可再生能源存储和智能基础设施发展提供了低成本、可扩展的解决方案。

title: From Risk to Exports: The Firm-level Effects of Public Credit Guarantees
affiliations: and Finnvera

detail.title: From Risk to Exports: The Firm-level Effects of Public Credit Guarantees

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Both authors are employed by Finnvera, which provided access to its administrative records under a research agreement that does not grant the institution any right of approval over the analysis, the choice of methods, or the conclusions. Finnvera did not review the results prior to circulation. Replication code can be made available on publication; the underlying microdata cannot be shared due to statutory confidentiality, but qualified researchers may apply for access through Finnvera’s data-sharing procedure.

detail.abstract: Export credit agencies play a central role in financing cross-border trade, particularly in destinations where private trade finance is scarce, yet firm-level evidence on how such support shapes export patterns across destination risk environments remains limited. We construct a firm-destination panel for 2011-2023 by linking export credit guarantee records with customs data and exploit within-firm variation in guarantee use across destinations and over time. We document a pronounced destination-risk gradient in the association between export credit guarantees and exports. Guarantees are associated with a substantially higher probability of market entry in higher-risk destinations as classified by the OECD country risk framework, while the corresponding association is markedly smaller in the lowest-risk markets. At the intensive margin, the export elasticity with respect to guarantees is approximately 65% larger in riskier destinations. These patterns are strongest for smaller firms, consistent with tighter external financing constraints. While our empirical design does not rely on quasi-experimental variation, the systematic alignment between the observed heterogeneity and the predictions of trade-finance theory suggests that public export credit support operates primarily through a financing-cost channel, alleviating constraints where private trade finance is scarce.

AI.tldr: 本文利用企业-目的地层面面板数据，发现出口信用担保对高风险目的地的出口促进效应显著强于低风险目的地，且对小企业影响更大，表明公共出口信用支持主要通过缓解融资成本渠道发挥作用。
AI.research_question: 出口信用担保如何在不同风险水平的出口目的地影响企业的出口模式（包括集约边际和扩展边际）？
AI.motivation: 出口信用机构在跨境贸易融资中扮演核心角色，尤其是在私人贸易融资稀缺的目的地，但关于此类支持如何在不同目的地风险环境下塑造出口模式的企业层面证据有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贸易融资理论：公共出口信用支持通过降低融资成本渠道缓解企业面临的融资约束，尤其是私人贸易融资稀缺的高风险目的地。
AI.method: 将出口信用担保记录与海关数据匹配，构建2011-2023年企业-目的地面板数据，利用企业在不同目的地和时间上担保使用的组内差异进行分析，并考察OECD国家风险框架分类下的异质性。
AI.findings: （1）出口信用担保与出口之间的关联存在显著的目的地风险梯度：在高风险目的地，担保与市场进入概率的关联性显著更高；在集约边际上，风险较高目的地的出口弹性比低风险目的地大约65%。（2）这些模式对小型企业最为强烈，与其面临更紧的外部融资约束一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 为贸易融资理论提供了企业层面微观证据，验证了公共出口信用支持通过融资成本渠道缓解融资约束的理论预期，并揭示了这一机制在不同风险环境下的异质性表现。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者优化出口信用担保资源配置提供了依据：在高风险目的地和针对小型企业时，公共出口信用支持的政策效果更为显著，提示应差异化配置担保资源以提升政策效率。

title: Measuring Decision Procedures under Nonlinear Incentives

detail.title: Measuring Decision Procedures under Nonlinear Incentives
detail.abstract: This paper studies how people articulate decision procedures under nonlinear incentives. In a 2×2 experiment, subjects make choices under piecewise-linear tax schedules that vary the number of brackets in the schedules (bracket count) and the number of marginal tax rate-slopes relevant to optimal choice (slope count). They then provide incentivized free-text explanations in either a Description frame, which asks what they did in the choice task, or a Prescription frame, which asks them what they believe should be done in the choice task. Building on the information-processing approach to adaptive decision-making and the use of Elementary Information Processes (EIP) to measure cognitive effort in choice (Newell and Simon, 1972; Bettman et al., 1990; Payne et al., 1993), I count the EIP operations in subjects' reported procedures as a measure of the cognitive demand of their response to the incentive structure. I find that slope count raises procedural operations after accounting for explanation length, while bracket count does not have a robust effect. EIP count is also meaningfully linked to the reasoning explained by subjects. Explanations consistent with the marginal reasoning principle have the highest EIP count, followed by average rate-based explanations, while all other kinds of explanations have the lowest EIP count. This relationship is supported by subjects' performance in an independent menu-based check of their rule-knowledge. The slope effect appears in both Description and Prescription, with no statistically distinguishable difference across frames, suggesting that subjects recognize the additional demands of the environment in both implemented and identified procedures. Finally, higher EIP count is associated with lower cognitive uncertainty, longer response time, and lower error during the choice task itself. The results show that nonlinear incentives create procedural demands that are visible in what subjects articulate about their decisions, and that these articulated procedures are meaningfully related to rule-knowledge and decision accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实验研究人们在非线性激励下如何表述决策过程，发现税率斜率数量（而非括号数量）显著增加了被试表述中的认知操作次数，且这一效应在描述框架和处方框架中均存在，并与规则知识和决策准确性相关。
AI.research_question: 在非线性激励（分段线性税制）下，人们如何表述其决策程序？不同激励结构特征（括号数量 vs. 边际税率斜率数量）如何影响被试表述中的认知努力？
AI.motivation: 非线性激励（如累进税制）普遍存在，但人们对这类复杂激励结构的认知加工过程尚不清楚。本文旨在通过分析被试的自由文本解释，揭示激励结构特征如何塑造决策程序的认知需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于适应性决策的信息加工方法（Newell & Simon, 1972）以及基本信息过程（EIP）理论（Bettman et al., 1990; Payne et al., 1993），用EIP操作计数衡量被试报告程序中的认知努力。
AI.method: 2×2实验：操纵分段线性税制中的括号数量（bracket count）和边际税率斜率数量（slope count）；被试在描述框架（"你做了什么"）或处方框架（"你认为应该怎么做"）下提供激励性自由文本解释；通过EIP计数分析文本的认知复杂性。
AI.findings: （1）斜率数量增加显著提高EIP计数，括号数量无稳健效应；（2）符合边际推理原则的解释EIP计数最高，平均税率解释次之，其他解释最低；（3）斜率效应在描述和处方框架中均存在，无显著差异；（4）高EIP计数与低认知不确定性、长反应时、低错误率相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 将EIP框架从选择行为扩展到决策程序的表述分析，揭示了非线性激励的认知需求结构；区分了括号数量（心理核算复杂性）与斜率数量（优化复杂性）的不同认知效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为税制设计提供行为洞见：简化边际税率结构（而非减少税级数量）有助于降低纳税人的认知负担；为政策沟通提供参考：不同解释框架（描述 vs. 处方）不影响人们对激励结构的认知反应。

reference: Peterson Institute for International Economics Policy Brief 26-9
title: Taking Geopolitically Motivated US Swap Lines too Far would Harm the Dollar and Fed Independence
affiliations: Peterson Institute for International Economics and University of California, Berkeley

detail.title: Taking Geopolitically Motivated US Swap Lines too Far would Harm the Dollar and Fed Independence

publicationDetails.detailsText: Peterson Institute for International Economics Policy Brief 26-9
publicationDetails.journalName: Peterson Institute for International Economics (PIIE) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Over the past century, the United States has provided dollar liquidity abroad through both the US Treasury and the Federal Reserve, but the appropriate mode of liquidity injection depends on the economic, financial, and geopolitical contexts. The Treasury is the more appropriate lending conduit when geopolitical concerns dominate, while Fed dollar provision should primarily be targeted toward global stability objectives and be more insulated from short-term foreign policy motives. Up to now, political abuses of these foreign lending channels have been constrained to some degree by laws, norms, and intergovernmental understandings, but adherence can no longer be assumed, so more formal guardrails are needed.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了美国财政部和美联储在向海外提供美元流动性方面的不同角色，指出在 geopolitical 风险主导时应由财政部主导，而美联储应专注于全球金融稳定目标。作者认为现有法律和规范对政治滥用的约束正在弱化，需要建立更正式的防护机制。
AI.research_question: 美国财政部和美联储在向海外提供美元流动性时，各自的适当时机与角色分工是什么？当前的法律和规范约束是否足够？
AI.motivation: 过去一个世纪美国通过财政部和美联储向海外提供美元流动性，但不同的经济、金融和地缘政治背景下，哪种流动性注入方式更为合适尚不明确。此外，现有的法律、规范和政府间协议对政治滥用的约束正在减弱，亟需探讨更正式的防护措施。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际政治经济学中的货币权力理论、中央银行独立性理论、以及国际公共品供给理论。
AI.method: 历史制度分析与规范性论证，结合美国财政部和美联储海外贷款实践的历史案例。
AI.findings: 当 geopolitical 关切主导时，财政部是更合适的贷款渠道；美联储的美元供给应主要针对全球稳定目标，且应更多避免短期外交政策动机的影响。目前法律、规范和谅解协议对政治滥用的约束正在弱化，需要更正式的制度防护。
AI.theory_contributions: 将国际货币体系的机构分工（财政部 vs. 央行）与 geopolitical 和稳定性目标进行理论对接，提出了"双渠道流动性供给"的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为美国政策制定者提供了关于财政部和美联储在海外流动性投放中职责划分的政策建议，并呼吁建立更正式的制度约束以防止政治化滥用。

title: The Modernization Era: The Great Acceleration to the Anthropocene (1920-1960), Chapter 3, IN Lessons for a Warming Planet: A Vital History of U.S. Environmental Law, by Alejandro E. Camacho and Brigham Daniels, New York: New York University Press, 2026

detail.title: The Modernization Era: The Great Acceleration to the Anthropocene (1920-1960), Chapter 3, IN Lessons for a Warming Planet: A Vital History of U.S. Environmental Law, by Alejandro E. Camacho and Brigham Daniels, New York: New York University Press, 2026

publicationDetails.detailsText: New York University Press, 2026; UCLA School of Law, Public Law Research Paper No. 26-23
publicationDetails.journalName: University of California, Los Angeles School of Law, Public Law & Legal Theory Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
The four decades stretching from the Roaring Twenties through the postwar boom were, in environmental terms, a long retreat from the Progressive Era's gains. This chapter traces how law underwrote the physical transformation of America — suburbs, highways, dams, automobiles, chemicals, nuclear power — making the United States simultaneously the world's greatest economic superpower and its greatest polluter.

The era's central paradox is the New Deal. Franklin Roosevelt's administrative revolution built the modern federal bureaucratic state — and built it primarily as an instrument of development. The TVA, the Hoover Dam, the rural electrification programs: these projects flooded ecosystems, displaced communities, and locked in fossil fuel infrastructure whose consequences the planet is still living with. Yet the same administrative machinery, built to facilitate exploitation, would later become the scaffolding on which modern environmental law was constructed. The engine of destruction carried within it the tools of repair.

Federal policy during this era also systematically racialized the "American Dream." FHA mortgage programs, interstate highway routing, and racially restrictive covenants concentrated pollution burdens in communities of color while delivering the benefits of suburbanization almost exclusively to white Americans — a pattern that environmental justice advocates are still fighting decades later.

The chapter closes with the era's accumulating disasters: the Donora death fog of 1948, the proliferation of synthetic chemicals with minimal legal oversight, and the nuclear fallout that would eventually inspire Rachel Carson's generation. Even in the anti-conservation atmosphere of these decades, undercurrents of reform persisted — modest federal experiments, early state air and water regulations, scattered legislative responses to industrial disaster. These inadequate but persistent efforts would prove essential to what came next.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了1920年代至战后繁荣时期（约40年）美国环境法的退步与矛盾。这一时期，美国通过法律支持郊区化、高速公路、大坝、汽车、化学品和核能等建设，成为世界最大经济体和污染者。新政是核心悖论：它既通过TVA、胡佛大坝等项目破坏生态、锁定化石燃料基础设施，又为现代环境法搭建了行政框架。同时，FHA抵押贷款、州际公路选线和种族限制性契约系统性地将污染负担集中在有色人种社区，而郊区化福利几乎只归白人。章节以多诺拉雾霾事件、合成化学品泛滥、核辐射等累积性灾难结尾，并指出即使在反环保时代，联邦和地方层面的改革暗流仍在持续。
AI.research_question: 从1920年代到战后繁荣时期，美国法律如何推动了环境的物理转型与污染，这一过程中新政扮演了什么样的矛盾角色，以及环境不公如何被制度性种族化？
AI.motivation: 揭示美国经济腾飞背后被忽视的环境代价与结构性不公，说明行政国家既是破坏工具也是修复框架的悖论，为理解现代环境法的起源和环境正义运动提供历史基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 法律与物质基础设施的关系、行政国家的双重功能（开发工具vs.规制框架）、环境种族主义的制度建构、渐进主义改革在反环保周期中的积累效应。
AI.method: 历史分析法，通过追溯立法（FHA政策、州际公路法）、大型工程项目（TVA、胡佛大坝）、灾难事件（多诺拉事件）、以及早期规制实验的叙述，构建环境法律史的因果链条。
AI.findings: 1）新政的行政革命是"开发型"国家建设，直接造成了生态破坏和碳锁定；2）同一行政架构后来成为环境法的制度基础；3）联邦住房和交通政策系统性地将污染负担种族化；4）灾难（多诺拉、核辐射）催化了有限但持续的改革努力；5）这些"不充分但持久"的改革为后续环保运动奠定了基础。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对"行政国家"悖论性质的理解——同一制度框架可以先后服务于截然相反的目标（开发与保护）；揭示了环境法前史中"破坏性建设"与"修复性工具"的内在关联；为环境法律史提供了"渐进积累"的分析视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒当代政策制定者：大型基础设施投资具有长期环境锁定效应；环境正义必须从规划源头（住房、交通）介入；即使在不利政治周期中，局部改革努力也有累积价值；当前环境法的制度基础设施可能源于其批判对象本身。

title: Growing Awareness and Ambiguity Attitude

detail.title: Growing Awareness and Ambiguity Attitude
detail.abstract: This paper examines whether prior experience of growing awareness of outcomes influences subsequent attitudes toward ambiguity, and whether any such effect operates beyond elicited first-order beliefs. In a controlled experiment, subjects draw 40 times from an urn under one of two conditions. In the Complete awareness condition, the full support of the urn distribution is known from the outset, while in the Growing awareness condition, subjects discover the support gradually through sampling. After sampling, subjects make matched investment decisions under ambiguity and risk. The central result is a robust interaction between the prior awareness condition and the decision environment on the within-subject difference in investments between the Ambiguity stage and Risk stage. Subjects in the Growing awareness condition who are later assigned to an environment built around outcomes that were frequently encountered during sampling exhibit weaker ambiguity aversion relative to Complete awareness counterparts. The pattern reverses for subjects assigned to the environment built around rarely encountered outcomes during sampling, such that prior exposure to growth in awareness is associated with a substantially lower investment in the Ambiguity stage. The interaction effect of-26.4 (p = 0.011) cents in the baseline specification persists after accounting for elicited beliefs, belief precision, sampling frequencies, and the recency of awareness-expanding discoveries. The findings indicate that awareness history affects ambiguity attitude through a channel not exhausted by beliefs, and that its direction depends on whether the decision environment involves frequent or rare outcomes from prior experience.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实验发现，个体在逐步意识到结果（Growing awareness）与完全知晓结果分布（Complete awareness）的不同条件下，其后继模糊态度存在显著差异：当决策环境涉及采样中频繁出现的结果时，逐步意识组表现出更弱的模糊厌恶；反之，当涉及罕见结果时，逐步意识组表现出更强的模糊厌恶。这一效应无法由信念、信念精度、采样频率等变量解释。
AI.research_question: 先前的"意识增长"经历（逐步发现结果）如何影响后续对模糊性的态度？这种效应是否超出由一阶信念所能解释的范围？
AI.motivation: 现实生活中，许多不确定情境下个体并非一开始就知晓所有可能结果，而是通过不断学习逐渐意识到新的可能性。然而，标准的模糊性决策理论（如Ellsberg悖论相关研究）通常假设决策者知晓结果的完整支持集。本文试图弥合这一差异，探究意识增长的历史如何独立于信念影响模糊态度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 模糊态度理论（ambiguity attitude）；意识增长（growing awareness）与一阶信念的区分；学习历史对偏好的影响。
AI.method: 实验室实验。被试在两种条件下（Complete awareness vs. Growing awareness）从瓮中抽取40次样本。随后在模糊和风险两种决策环境下进行投资决策，采用被试内设计比较Ambiguity阶段与Risk阶段的投资差异。
AI.findings: (1) 意识条件与决策环境之间存在稳健的交互效应：当决策环境基于采样中频繁出现的结果时，Growing awareness组的模糊厌恶弱于Complete awareness组；当基于罕见结果时，模式反转，Growing awareness组的模糊阶段投资显著更低。(2) 基线模型中交互效应为-26.4美分（p=0.011），且在控制信念、信念精度、采样频率和最近意识扩展发现后仍稳健。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了一个超出信念通道的独立机制：意识增长的历史（awareness history）直接影响模糊态度；模糊态度不仅取决于当前已知的不确定性，还取决于个体如何"得知"这些可能性的过程。
AI.practical_contributions: 对于涉及渐进式信息披露的决策场景（如新产品市场、职业选择、投资环境变化）具有启示意义：决策者的学习过程本身会影响其风险/模糊偏好，管理者或政策制定者应关注信息揭示方式对后续决策偏好的塑造作用。
