detail.abstract: Beginning in the 2000s, as Central and Eastern European countries began to join the EU in earnest, new manufacturing production bases within the EU were established in Central and Eastern Europe. This marked the beginning of a full-scale expansion of Korean companies targeting the EU market. This expansion was concentrated in the V4 (Poland, Hungary, the Czech Republic, and Slovakia) countries between 2006 and 2007. From the late 2010s until recently, Korean companies’ expansion into Central and Eastern Europe shifted to investments in batteries, electric vehicles, renewable energy, and R&D, shifting investment patterns toward eco-friendly and cutting-edge industries and key supply chains. Recently, LG Energy Solution and its partners completed their secondary battery expansion in Poland, while SK Innovation, Samsung SDI, and their partners completed their secondary battery expansion in Hungary. These efforts not only address the EU’s comprehensive environmental regulations and supply chain restructuring but also establish a bridgehead for entry into the European market. Meanwhile, as part of China’s global supply chain restructuring strategy, large-scale greenfield investments are continuing, focusing on eco- friendly electronic components and finished automobiles. Hungary is establishing itself as a key base for China’s European expansion strategy. (The rest omitted.)

AI.tldr: 本文分析了2000年代以来韩国和中国企业在中东欧（尤其是V4国家）的投资扩张历程，从早期制造业基地建设到近年向电池、电动车、可再生能源等绿色高科技领域的转型，以及中国大规模绿地投资在匈牙利等国的布局，揭示了这些投资如何应对欧盟环境法规、供应链重组并建立进入欧洲市场的桥头堡。
AI.research_question: 韩国和中国企业在中东欧的投资模式如何演变？这些投资如何服务于欧盟市场准入、环境合规及全球供应链重组战略？
AI.motivation: 中东欧国家加入欧盟后成为新的制造基地，韩国企业借此拓展欧盟市场；后期欧盟环保法规趋严及供应链重组需求，推动投资转向绿色科技和关键供应链领域。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际投资理论、全球供应链重组理论、区域经济一体化理论
AI.method: 基于企业投资案例的定性分析，梳理韩国（LG、SK、三星SDI等）和中国企业在V4国家的投资时间线及行业分布。
AI.findings: 1）韩国投资从2006-2007年集中于V4制造业，到2010年代末转向电池、电动车、可再生能源及R&D；2）LG、SK、三星SDI在波兰和匈牙利完成二次电池扩张；3）中国以绿地投资方式进入中东欧，聚焦环保电子元件和整车制造，匈牙利成为中国进军欧洲的关键基地。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了亚洲新兴经济体在中东欧的投资演变动因，丰富了关于全球供应链区域化与绿色转型的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为跨国企业布局欧盟市场提供了中东欧投资的策略参考，也为政策制定者理解亚洲资本在欧盟绿色转型中的作用提供了依据。

title: Information, Security Selection, Portfolio Construction, and Active Equity Management
affiliations: , Invesco, Invesco, Invesco, Invesco, Invesco and University of Miami

detail.title: Information, Security Selection, Portfolio Construction, and Active Equity Management

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None.

detail.abstract: This paper revisits the roles of information, security selection, and portfolio construction in active equity management within a Markowitz mean–variance framework. Using data from 2004–2024 across U.S. and global equity markets, the study evaluates regression-based composite models that integrate valuation metrics, earnings forecasts, revisions, breadth, and momentum. Robust estimation methods, including weighted latent root regression (WLRR) and Least Angle Regression (LAR), show that earnings-related variables, particularly composite forecast measures, consistently generate statistically significant return signals. Longstanding enhanced multifactor models deliver higher information coefficients and forecast efficacy than traditional valuation-only approaches. When implemented within mean–variance optimization, these models produce economically meaningful excess returns in MSCI ACWI and Emerging Markets portfolios, even after accounting for transaction costs and data-mining adjustments. Results further indicate that portfolio construction materially amplifies security selection skill, particularly with higher tracking error and active weights. The paper also explores the possibility of improving forecasting results using alternative highdimensional and machine learning methods and finds that robust regression approaches (WLRR and LAR) deliver the highest out-of-sample information coefficients. These findings, along with related published research, support the notion that disciplined, interpretable methods remain highly competitive tools for equity forecasting during much of the last 30 years. Finally, the analysis shows that expanding the investment universe to include a more comprehensive set of global stocks with earnings forecasts improves Sharpe and information ratios, underscoring the benefits of broad, information-rich opportunity sets and robust statistical modeling in active management.

AI.tldr: 本文在Markowitz均值-方差框架下重新审视了信息、证券选择和组合构建在主动权益管理中的作用，基于2004-2024年美国和全球股票市场数据，发现盈利相关变量（特别是综合预测指标）能持续产生统计显著的回报信号，稳健回归方法（WLRR和LAR）具有最高的样本外信息系数，且组合构建能显著放大证券选择能力。研究还表明，拓展至包含盈利预测的全球股票投资组合能改善夏普比率和信息比率。
AI.research_question: 在主动权益管理中，信息、证券选择和组合构建三者各自扮演什么角色？如何利用估值指标、盈利预测、修正、广度和动量等变量构建有效的复合预测模型？
AI.motivation: 尽管主动管理领域已有大量研究，但在Markowitz框架下系统评估信息、证券选择与组合构建三者交互作用的研究仍相对有限。同时，随着机器学习等新方法涌现，需要重新审视传统可解释方法的表现。
AI.theoretical_framework: Markowitz均值-方差框架；信息系数（IC）；增强多因子模型；加权潜在根回归（WLRR）；最小角回归（LAR）
AI.method: 基于2004-2024年美国及全球股票市场数据，构建回归复合模型，整合估值指标、盈利预测、修正、广度和动量等变量。采用加权潜在根回归（WLRR）和最小角回归（LAR）等稳健估计方法，在均值-方差优化框架下评估模型表现，并考虑交易成本和数据挖掘调整。
AI.findings: （1）盈利相关变量，特别是综合预测指标，持续产生统计显著的回报信号；（2）增强多因子模型在信息系数和预测效能上优于传统纯估值方法；（3）在MSCI ACWI和新兴市场组合中，模型能产生经济意义上显著的超额收益；（4）组合构建显著放大证券选择能力，尤其是在高跟踪误差和主动权重情况下；（5）WLRR和LAR的样本外信息系数最高；（6）拓展至包含盈利预测的全球股票集能改善夏普比率和信息比率。
AI.theory_contributions: 在Markowitz均值-方差框架下系统验证了信息、证券选择与组合构建三者的协同作用，证明了可解释的稳健回归方法（WLRR和LAR）在近30年中始终具有竞争力，为主动管理理论提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为主动权益管理者提供了切实可行的建模思路：使用包含盈利预测的综合多因子模型、采用WLRR和LAR等稳健回归方法、拓展到更广泛的全球股票投资宇宙，均能显著提升投资组合表现。研究结果对冲基金、资产管理公司等机构有重要参考价值。

title: Spillover Effects of Timelier Loan Loss Recognition by Banks on Borrowers’ Cross-Border Borrowing
affiliations: Hong Kong Polytechnic University - School of Accounting and Finance, Xiamen University, The University of Hong Kong - Faculty of Business and Economics and Southern University of Science and Technology

detail.title: Spillover Effects of Timelier Loan Loss Recognition by Banks on Borrowers’ Cross-Border Borrowing
detail.abstract: The transition from the incurred credit loss model to the expected credit loss model in bank accounting for loan losses requires domestic banks to monitor borrowers’ credit quality more closely and recognize expected loan losses more promptly. Using a difference-in-differences analysis of syndicated loans from 62 countries, our study finds that after the transition, domestic borrowers increase their cross-border borrowing. Additional evidence indicates that this effect is driven by reduced credit supply and more restrictive covenants imposed by domestic banks. The effect is stronger when the transition is likely to increase banks’ loan loss provisions, as well as among borrowers with greater cross-border borrowing experience, closer linguistic ties with foreign lenders, or limited access to domestic bond markets. Our study is the first to show that cross-country differences in bank accounting can affect firms’ cross-border borrowing.

AI.tldr: 采用预期信用损失模型后，国内银行减少贷款供应、增加契约限制，导致企业转向跨境借款。
AI.research_question: 银行会计从已发生损失模型转向预期信用损失模型如何影响企业的跨境借款行为？
AI.motivation: 探究不同国家之间银行会计差异是否以及如何影响企业的跨境借贷决策，填补银行会计准则对国际资本流动影响的研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于银行信贷供给理论、契约理论、以及跨境资本流动理论，分析预期损失模型对银行信贷行为和借款人融资选择的影响。
AI.method: 采用双重差分法（difference-in-differences），分析62个国家银团贷款数据。
AI.findings: 采用预期信用损失模型后，国内企业跨境借款增加。驱动机制是国内银行信贷供给减少、契约限制增加。该效应在银行坏账准备增加预期较强、企业跨境借款经验丰富、与外国银行语言纽带强、或国内债券市场准入受限的情况下更强。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次揭示不同国家间银行会计差异会影响企业的跨境借款行为，拓展了银行会计与公司融资互动关系的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构评估银行会计准则变更的跨境溢出效应提供依据，提示企业在国内信贷受限时可利用跨境借款作为替代融资渠道。

title: The Geometry of Functional Mechanism Design
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Geometry of Functional Mechanism Design

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known of financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study is a purely theoretical and mathematical analysis that does not involve any patients/participants.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Mechanism design pins down only a low-dimensional projection of a function-valued contract; institutional refinements select within the residual. We establish this in a screening problem where the principal collects a contractual share of an agent’s realized cash flow and the private type is pricing ability. A reduction proposition collapses any admissible schedule to a two-dimensional sufficient statistic. An optimal-mechanism theorem delivers a closed-form trade-off: the winning agent is induced to price as a monopolist bearing his virtual cost, implementable by a menu of fixed fees and linear shares; revenue equivalence fails, and the ubiquitous flat royalty is strictly dominated. A canonical-representation theorem shows that any well-behaved refinement selects a unique contract decomposing into a mechanism-determined affine baseline plus a refinement-specific kernel correction. A separability theorem classifies refinements: robustness can be delegated—the misspecification-averse principal selects the affine baseline—whereas fairness must be co-designed with the mechanism.

AI.tldr: 本文证明机制设计只确定了函数型合约的低维投影，制度细化则在残差中进行选择。在筛选问题中，委托人收取代理人实现现金流的合约份额，私人类型为定价能力。一个降维命题将任何可行合约压缩为二维充分统计量；最优机制定理给出了封闭形式的权衡；规范表示定理证明任何良好定义的细化都能选择唯一合约；分离定理对细化进行了分类。
AI.research_question: 在代理人的私人类型为定价能力的筛选问题中，机制设计如何确定合约结构，以及制度细化如何在残差空间中进行选择？
AI.motivation: 传统机制设计理论在函数型合约空间中往往只能确定低维度的投影特征，而制度的细化（如公平性、稳健性）在剩余维度中发挥作用。本文旨在建立机制设计与制度细化之间的严格对应关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 机制设计理论、筛选理论、降维方法、规范表示理论、分离定理
AI.method: 理论建模：降维命题将函数型合约压缩为二维充分统计量；最优机制定理推导封闭形式的权衡关系；规范表示定理证明细化选择唯一合约；分离定理对细化类型进行分类。
AI.findings: (1) 任何可行合约可降维为二维充分统计量；(2) 最优机制使获胜代理人像承担虚拟成本的垄断者一样定价，可通过固定费用与线性份额的菜单实现，收入等价失效，固定版税被严格占优；(3) 任何良好定义的细化选择唯一合约，分解为机制决定的仿射基线和细化特定的核修正；(4) 稳健性可委托（委托人选择仿射基线），公平性需与机制共同设计。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次严格证明机制设计只确定合约的低维投影，制度细化在残差中发挥作用；建立了降维命题、最优机制定理、规范表示定理和分离定理，拓展了机制设计与制度细化交叉领域的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为合约设计提供了理论指导：固定费率版税被严格占优，应选择固定费用加线性份额的菜单；针对不同的制度细化目标（稳健性 vs. 公平性），应采取不同的设计策略。

title: Regime-Conditional Factor Premia and Institutional Flow Dynamics in Indian Equities

detail.title: Regime-Conditional Factor Premia and Institutional Flow Dynamics in Indian Equities
detail.abstract: We document regime-conditional factor premia in Indian equity markets and examine whether daily foreign institutional investor (FII) flows explain the underlying dynamics. Using the IIM Ahmedabad survivorship-bias-adjusted factor library (Agarwalla, Jacob, and Varma, 2013) spanning 2019–2025, we identify Bull, Sideways, and Bear market states via a Hidden Markov Model and characterise factor performance within each state. The momentum premium (WML) concentrates in Sideways regimes (Sharpe ratio 1.667, t = 3.24), while the market premium concentrates in Bull regimes (Sharpe ratio 1.485, t = 2.28). Value (HML) is directionally positive in Bear regimes (Sharpe ratio 2.26), consistent with defensive rotation into low-valuation stocks, though statistical inference is limited by the sparse Bear sample (n = 121 days). We next test whether daily NSDL FII net flows Granger-cause individual factor premia across 15 regime-factor pairs (five daily factors × three regimes), applying Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate correction. No cell survives — FII aggregate flows do not predict factor premia in any regime. A buy-sell decomposition reveals that gross FII volume (both purchases and sales) predicts aggregate market returns specifically in Bear regimes (F ≈ 5, p ≈ 0.009), consistent with FII acting as the marginal price setter when domestic liquidity thins; because Bear observations are concentrated in the COVID episode, this result cannot be established independently of the crisis window. Realized pairwise correlation (DCC) rises significantly in Bear (mean 0.30 vs. 0.25 in Bull; t = 22.9), confirming diversification failure coincides with regime transitions rather than leading them. A regime-aware factor allocation strategy achieves Sharpe 0.794 versus 0.733 for buy-and-hold over the 2021–2026 walk-forward period, although a static mean-variance allocation outperforms both over this sample — a result we report transparently and discuss in Section 7.

AI.tldr: 本文研究印度股市中因子的体制条件性溢价，发现动量溢价集中在盘整市，价值溢价在熊市方向为正；FII净流量不能Granger-cause任何因子溢价，但FII买卖总额在熊市可预测市场回报；DCC相关性在熊市显著上升；体制感知因子配置策略优于买入持有，但静态均值-方差策略在本样本中表现更好。
AI.research_question: 印度股市中因子溢价是否具有体制依赖性？FII资金流能否解释因子溢价在不同市场体制下的动态变化？
AI.motivation: 现有文献多关注成熟市场的因子溢价，但对新兴市场（如印度）中因子溢价是否随市场体制变化以及外资流动在其中扮演的角色尚缺乏系统性证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 体制转换理论（Hidden Markov Model）、因子定价理论、Granger因果检验、DCC动态条件相关模型。
AI.method: 使用IIM Ahmedabad因子库（2019–2025），基于HMM识别牛市、盘整市、熊市三种体制；计算各体制下因子Sharpe比率；运用Granger因果检验（BH校正）研究FII净流量与因子溢价的预测关系；DCC模型分析相关性变化；构建体制感知因子配置策略并回测（2021–2026）。
AI.findings: （1）动量溢价（WML）集中在盘整市（Sharpe 1.667），市场溢价集中在牛市（Sharpe 1.485），价值溢价（HML）在熊市方向为正（Sharpe 2.26）但样本有限；（2）FII净流量不Granger-cause任何因子溢价；（3）FII买卖总额在熊市可预测市场回报（F≈5, p≈0.009），但COVID窗口集中；（4）DCC相关性在熊市显著上升（均值0.30 vs 牛市0.25）；（5）体制感知策略Sharpe 0.794，优于买入持有0.733，但静态均值-方差策略更优。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统揭示印度股市因子溢价具有显著体制-条件性特征，拓展了因子定价理论在新兴市场体制转换情境下的适用性；发现FII净流量不能解释因子溢价，挑战了外资驱动因子溢价的简单叙事。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度市场投资者提供体制感知的因子配置框架；指出熊市中FII交易量可作为市场回报的预测信号；警示熊市相关性上升带来的分散化失效风险。

title: The Impact of Risk Management Activities on Bank Valuation
affiliations: , Villanova University - Villanova School of Business and Villanova University - Department of Finance

detail.title: The Impact of Risk Management Activities on Bank Valuation
detail.abstract: This paper examines how banks’ hedging activities influence market valuation. Using U.S. commercial bank data from 2001Q1–2024Q3, we develop a two-stage estimation process that isolates bank-specific effects on the market-to-book (MB) ratio after controlling for macroeconomic and size-related factors. We find that derivatives-based interest rate hedging is significantly and positively associated with MB, particularly during monetary tightening and for banks with high uninsured deposits, large unrealized securities losses, more liquidity creation, or greater asset-related rate sensitivity. Credit risk hedging shows no significant impact. Overall, we observe that the level of interest rate hedging activity has more than doubled during the most recent portion of our sample (2019-2024) as a greater percentage of banks began using derivatives to manage their interest rate risk. Our findings highlight market conditions and bank hedging decisions under which interest rate risk management creates shareholder value.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2001-2024年美国商业银行数据，发现利率对冲活动显著提升银行市场估值（市账比），尤其是在货币紧缩时期以及拥有高未保险存款、大量未实现证券损失、更多流动性创造或更大资产利率敏感性的银行中。信用风险对冲无显著影响。2019-2024年期间利率对冲活动翻倍以上。
AI.research_question: 银行的套期保值活动如何影响其市场估值？
AI.motivation: 银行通过衍生品进行风险管理是否创造股东价值，这一问题在文献中存在争议。本文旨在实证检验不同对冲行为（利率对冲与信用风险对冲）在不同市场环境下对银行估值的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 风险管理创造价值理论（降低财务困境成本、减少税收/监管摩擦等）；银行利率风险敞口与市场估值的关系。
AI.method: 两阶段估计法：第一阶段控制宏观和规模因素，第二阶段提取银行特定效应对市账比（MB）的影响。使用2001Q1–2024Q3美国商业银行数据。
AI.findings: 1. 利率对冲与MB显著正相关；2. 货币紧缩时期效应更强；3. 高未保险存款、大额未实现证券损失、高流动性创造、高资产利率敏感性的银行中效应更显著；4. 信用风险对冲无显著影响；5. 2019-2024年间利率对冲活动翻倍。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了利率对冲通过降低银行脆弱性（如未保险存款流失、未实现损失等）创造价值的机制，区分了利率风险与信用风险对冲的不同价值效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为银行管理层和监管者提供了在特定市场条件下利用利率衍生品提升股东价值的决策依据；提示监管层关注对冲行为的结构性变化。

title: Green is the new black
affiliations: Bank of Italy and Bank of Italy

detail.title: Green is the new black
detail.abstract: Donald Trump's re-election and the renewed withdrawal of the United States from the Paris Agreement triggered a marked deterioration in the US green bond market, reflected in both a lower probability of issuing green bonds and a contraction in issuance volumes. Moreover, the greenium -- the typically negative yield spread between green and traditional bonds with similar characteristics -- turned from negative to positive. This notable price change, coupled with reduced issuance, signals weakened investor demand for green assets, likely driven by increased uncertainty about the credibility of climate policy commitments and a less optimistic outlook for environmentally-conscious firms

AI.tldr: 特朗普连任及美国退出《巴黎协定》导致美国绿色债券市场显著恶化：发行概率降低、发行规模收缩，且绿色债券的收益率溢价（绿色溢价）由负转正，反映出投资者对绿色资产需求减弱。
AI.research_question: 特朗普再次当选及美国退出《巴黎协定》如何影响美国绿色债券市场的发行行为和定价（绿色溢价）？
AI.motivation: 探究政治事件（如总统选举结果和气候政策转向）对绿色金融市场（尤其是绿色债券）的冲击，以理解政策不确定性和监管承诺可信度如何影响投资者对ESG资产的需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信号理论与投资者情绪框架，气候政策承诺的可信度下降会削弱投资者对绿色资产的价值预期，导致需求萎缩和风险溢价调整。
AI.method: 实证分析，比较特朗普再次当选前后美国绿色债券的发行概率、发行规模及绿色溢价（绿色债券与传统债券的收益率差）的变化。
AI.findings: 1）绿色债券发行概率降低，发行规模收缩；2）绿色溢价由负转正（即绿色债券收益率高于可比传统债券）；3）这些变化表明投资者对绿色资产需求减弱，源于对气候政策承诺可信度的担忧。
AI.theory_contributions: 将政治事件与绿色金融市场定价联系起来，验证了政策不确定性对绿色资产需求的影响机制，拓展了绿色金融与政治风险交叉领域的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示政策制定者和市场参与者：气候政策的不连续性和政治事件可能对绿色金融市场产生实质性负面冲击，需关注政策承诺的稳定性和可信度以维护市场信心。

title: The Geography of Incomplete Recovery: Spatial Persistence and Compound Vulnerability in United States Housing Wealth, 2007–2021

detail.title: The Geography of Incomplete Recovery: Spatial Persistence and Compound Vulnerability in United States Housing Wealth, 2007–2021

declarations.declarationOfInterest: There is no competing interests.
declarations.funderStatement: I received no specific funding for this research.

detail.abstract: Did U.S. local housing markets that suffered the deepest Great Recession losses recover during the 2020–2021 pandemic boom, or does recovery failure persist? Using IPUMS American Community Survey microdata, the FEMA National Risk Index, and Census TIGER/Line geometry, I build a real housing-wealth recovery index (2012–2021) for 2,351 PUMAs across the contiguous United States and show that recovery is strongly and durably unequal across space. It is highly clustered (Moran’s I = 0.70, p < 0.001), with 360 statistically significant Low-Low cores in the Great Lakes industrial corridor, Appalachia, and the Mississippi Delta. A k-means typology isolates a 968-PUMA “Persistently Depressed” cluster that combines the weakest recovery with the highest social vulnerability (mean SOVI = 59.6) and the lowest community resilience, a compound-disadvantage footprint that offers a regionally coherent targeting criterion for Community Reinvestment Act assessment areas. I then ask whether deeper recession losses causally shaped recovery, and find the question cannot be cleanly identified: the apparent catch-up in a naive ordinary-least-squares regression is largely a mechanical artifact of mean reversion and measurement error, and a county-level instrumental-variables design cannot resolve it, because no available instrument for recession severity is both strong and valid. The causal effect is therefore not identified in this setting, a cautionary result for the mechanical use of shift-share instruments when housing is the outcome. The paper’s robust, policy-relevant contribution is its documentation of persistent spatial inequality and compound disadvantage.

AI.tldr: 本文利用美国社区调查、FEMA国家风险指数等数据，构建了2012-2021年房地产财富复苏指数，发现美国地方住房市场在大衰退后的复苏存在强烈且持久的空间不平等。360个显著的低-低集聚核心区分布在五大湖工业走廊、阿巴拉契亚和密西西比三角洲。聚类分析识别出968个PUMA的"持续低迷"集群，其复苏最弱、社会脆弱性最高、社区韧性最低。研究同时发现，深度衰退损失是否因果性地塑造了复苏这一问题无法被干净识别，因果关系未能确立。
AI.research_question: 在大衰退中遭受最严重损失的地方住房市场，在2020-2021年疫情繁荣期是否实现了复苏，还是复苏失败持续存在？
AI.motivation: 检验大衰退后住房市场复苏的空间不平等是否持续，特别是最受冲击地区是否在后续繁荣期实现了追赶。
AI.theoretical_framework: 空间不平等、社区再投资、因果识别的计量经济学（均值回归、测量误差、工具变量有效性）
AI.method: 利用IPUMS美国社区调查微观数据、FEMA国家风险指数和Census TIGER/Line几何数据，构建2,351个PUMA的房地产财富复苏指数（2012-2021）。使用空间自相关分析（Moran's I）、k-means聚类分析、普通最小二乘回归和县级工具变量设计。
AI.findings: （1）复苏高度空间聚集（Moran's I = 0.70），360个显著的低-低集聚核心分布在五大湖工业走廊、阿巴拉契亚和密西西比三角洲；（2）"持续低迷"集群（968个PUMA）具有最弱复苏、最高社会脆弱性（均值59.6）和最低社区韧性；（3）深度衰退损失对复苏的因果效应无法被干净识别，OLS中的追赶效应主要由均值回归和测量误差造成，工具变量设计因缺乏既强又有效的工具而无法解决。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了住房市场复苏的持久空间不平等现象，提出了"复合劣势"概念；对使用shift-share工具变量分析住房市场结果提出了方法论警示。
AI.practical_contributions: 为社区再投资法案（CRA）评估区域提供了基于复合劣势的精准定位标准，有助于政策资源向最持续低迷的地区倾斜。

title: Commitment Coordination in Small Business Networks: Historical Evidence, Simulation Model, and Pilot Design

detail.title: Commitment Coordination in Small Business Networks: Historical Evidence, Simulation Model, and Pilot Design

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the initiator of the SinerGenius pilot concept discussed in this paper. No external funding was received for this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper does not report results from human subjects research. It presents a conceptual model, historical reconstruction, and preliminary simulations. No ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
This exploratory working paper examines whether small business networks can reduce transaction costs and coordination failures through a transparent system of recorded commitments, deadlines, guarantees, and organized demand.

The paper develops a preliminary model of commitment coordination based on a reconstructed historical case from Almaty in 1998 and presents illustrative simulation results comparing fragmented exchange with auditable commitment coordination. The simulation results are model-internal and should not be interpreted as empirical validation.

The proposed pilot involves 8–12 entrepreneurs and is designed to test whether recorded obligations, visible deadlines, dispute logs, guarantor relationships, and anti-favoritism safeguards can improve coordination reliability in real small-business cooperation.

The paper outlines the model, pilot calibration plan, legal boundaries, data collection protocol, risks, success and failure metrics, and limitations.

AI.tldr: 本文探索性地研究了小企业网络能否通过记录承诺、截止日期、担保和组织化需求的透明系统，降低交易成本和协调失败。基于1998年阿拉木图的历史案例构建了一个初步的承诺协调模型，并通过模拟结果说明碎片化交换与可审计承诺协调的差异。提出一项涉及8-12名企业家的试点方案，以检验该机制在实际小企业合作中的协调可靠性。
AI.research_question: 小企业网络能否通过透明的承诺记录、截止日期、担保和需求组织系统来减少交易成本和协调失败？
AI.motivation: 小企业合作中普遍存在协调失败和交易成本高的问题，而现有研究对透明承诺系统能否缓解这些问题尚缺乏深入探索。
AI.theoretical_framework: 承诺协调理论（基于1998年阿拉木图历史案例重建）、交易成本理论
AI.method: 历史案例重建 + 模拟仿真（模型内部比较，非实证验证）+ 试点方案设计（8-12名企业家）
AI.findings: 模拟结果表明，可审计承诺协调相比碎片化交换在协调可靠性上具有优势；但这些结果是模型内部的，不能视为实证验证。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个基于历史案例的承诺协调初步模型，为小企业网络中的透明协调机制提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 设计了一套包含记录义务、可见截止日期、争议记录、担保关系和反偏袒保障的具体试点方案，为小企业合作提供了可操作的协调工具。

title: The rStrings Model: Risk as a Continuous Vibrating Field: A Unifying Framework with an Extension to Unobservable Risk Dimensions

detail.title: The rStrings Model: Risk as a Continuous Vibrating Field: A Unifying Framework with an Extension to Unobservable Risk Dimensions

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest, financial or otherwise. This research received no external funding and was conducted independently. No relationships with individuals or organizations that could be perceived as influencing the results exist.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper presents a theoretical and mathematical framework. No human participants, patient data, or personal data were involved in this research. Ethics approval is not applicable.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Classical actuarial science models risk as a discrete event, one that either occurs or does not occur at an instant t with an assignable probability. The rStrings model, which takes from string theory its mathematical foundations: the wave equation, the decomposition into normal modes, and compactified dimensions, proposes treating risk as a continuous vibrating field extended over the coverage horizon. The model considers that the field's tension follows a diffusion process, and the claim is reinterpreted as a resonance event, the crossing of a critical threshold. The framework provides three capabilities absent from classical valuation: reserves conditioned on the observed risk trajectory, a quantifiable prevention mechanism through the reversion coefficient, and a modal decomposition of multiple coverages with a correlation hierarchy postulated from the model's geometry and empirically testable. We show that mortality tables, the Cox model, Markov chains, and stochastic intensity models are limiting cases of the framework, and we establish explicit falsifiability criteria, including a prediction with no counterpart in scalar processes. Four reproducible numerical examples illustrate standard and substandard pricing, a long-term endowment, and the modal dynamics. The present work establishes the foundations of the framework; its empirical validation is the subject of a companion paper in preparation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于弦论数学基础（波动方程、简正模、紧致维度）的rStrings模型，将风险重新概念化为一个连续振动的场，而非经典精算学中的离散事件。索赔被解释为共振事件（临界阈值穿越），该框架提供了三种经典估值所不具备的能力：基于风险轨迹的条件准备金、通过回归系数量化的预防机制、以及多险种的模态分解与相关性层级。作者证明死亡率表、Cox模型、马尔可夫链和随机强度模型都是该框架的极限情况，并建立了明确的可证伪性标准。
AI.research_question: 如何利用弦理论的数学基础（波动方程、简正模分解、紧致维度）构建一个将风险视为连续振动场的精算估值框架，以克服经典精算学中离散风险模型的局限性？
AI.motivation: 经典精算学将风险建模为离散事件，忽略了风险在时间维度上的连续演化特征。作者试图引入物理学中弦论的数学工具，为精算估值提供一种全新的连续场论视角，从而捕捉经典模型无法处理的动态风险特征。
AI.theoretical_framework: 弦理论的数学基础：波动方程、简正模分解、紧致维度；扩散过程（场张力）；共振理论（临界阈值穿越）
AI.method: 数学建模与理论推导，辅以四个可复现的数值示例（标准定价、次标准定价、长期 endowment 保险、模态动态分析）
AI.findings: rStrings模型提供了三种经典估值不具备的能力：基于风险轨迹的条件准备金、通过回归系数量化的预防机制、多险种模态分解与相关性层级。死亡率表、Cox模型、马尔可夫链、随机强度模型均为该框架的极限情况。模型具有明确的可证伪性标准，包括标量过程中不存在的新预测。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次将弦理论的数学结构（波动方程、简正模、紧致维度）系统引入精算科学，建立了风险连续场论的新范式；2. 将经典精算模型（死亡率表、Cox模型、马尔可夫链、随机强度模型）统一为该框架的极限情况，提供了理论的整合与统一。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提出了基于风险轨迹的条件准备金方法，可实现更精细的动态风险定价；2. 通过回归系数提供了可量化的预防机制；3. 提供了多险种相关性的模态分解方法，具有可检验性；4. 建立了明确的可证伪性标准，增强了模型的科学严谨性。

title: Intelligent Environments for Urban Air Pollution Prediction in Smart Cities Leveraging Atmospheric and Traffic Data: A Multi-Deep Learning Approach
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Universidad de Cádiz, Universidad de Cádiz, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Universidad de Cádiz and University of Alicante

detail.title: Intelligent Environments for Urban Air Pollution Prediction in Smart Cities Leveraging Atmospheric and Traffic Data: A Multi-Deep Learning Approach
detail.abstract: Modern cities increasingly rely on heterogeneous data sources and intelligent systems to improve urban management and quality of life. Among the many dimensions of urban intelligence, air quality monitoring and prediction stand out as a critical service given the well-documented impact of atmospheric pollutants on public health. This paper presents a framework that repurposes existing traffic camera infrastructures, combined with meteorological data, to forecast pollutant concentrations without requiring extensive historical air quality records. A comparative evaluation of six deep learning architectures, namely Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP), Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), Convolutional LSTM (CNNLSTM), LSTM with Attention, CNNLSTM with Attention, and Transformer, is conducted across two major Spanish cities, Madrid and Bilbao. Each architecture is evaluated over 10 independent runs with different random seeds, and statistical significance is assessed through Friedman tests followed by pairwise Wilcoxon signedrank tests with Holm-Bonferroni correction. The CNNLSTM and LSTM with Attention architectures are statistically the best-performing models overall, with no significant difference between them (mean RMSE of 5.754 and 5.672, respectively; p = 0.846). However, no single architecture dominates all scenarios: the Transformer achieves the best results for SO2, PM2.5, and PM10 in Bilbao, whereas the LSTM and LSTM with Attention form the statistically best group for O3. These findings highlight that pollutant-specific model selection, rather than a one-size-fits-all approach, is essential for operational short-term urban air quality forecasting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用现有交通摄像头基础设施结合气象数据，在不需要历史空气质量记录的情况下预测污染物浓度。通过比较六种深度学习架构在马德里和毕尔巴鄂两座西班牙城市的表现，发现CNNLSTM和带注意力的LSTM整体表现最佳，但不同污染物和城市存在显著的模型性能差异，强调了污染物特异性模型选择的重要性。
AI.research_question: 如何利用现有的交通摄像头基础设施和气象数据，在没有大量历史空气质量记录的条件下，预测城市空气污染物浓度？哪种深度学习架构最适合此任务？
AI.motivation: 空气质量监测对公共健康至关重要，但许多城市缺乏足够的历史空气质量监测站数据。交通摄像头在城市中已广泛部署，可以作为一种替代性的数据源来估算和预测污染物浓度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 深度学习（MLP、LSTM、CNN-LSTM、带注意力的LSTM、带注意力的CNN-LSTM、Transformer）；统计检验（Friedman检验、Wilcoxon符号秩检验、Holm-Bonferroni校正）
AI.method: 利用交通摄像头图像数据和气象数据作为输入，比较六种深度学习架构的预测性能。在马德里和毕尔巴鄂两座城市进行实验，每种架构重复10次独立运行，使用Friedman检验和Wilcoxon符号秩检验进行统计显著性评估。
AI.findings: CNNLSTM和带注意力的LSTM整体表现最佳（平均RMSE分别为5.754和5.672，p=0.846），但无显著差异。Transformer在毕尔巴鄂的SO2、PM2.5和PM10预测中表现最优；LSTM和带注意力的LSTM在O3预测中构成最优统计组。没有单一架构在所有污染物和城市场景中占据主导地位。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了利用交通摄像头作为空气质量预测替代数据源的可行性；揭示了污染物特异性模型选择优于"一刀切"方法；通过严格的统计检验提供了深度学习架构性能比较的稳健证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了一种低成本、可扩展的城市空气质量监测方案，利用现有交通摄像头基础设施，降低了空气质量预测的部署门槛；为城市管理者提供了针对不同污染物选择最优预测模型的具体指导。

title: An Analysis of Trends in the Adoption of Online Education Among Graduate Students

detail.title: An Analysis of Trends in the Adoption of Online Education Among Graduate Students
detail.abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic corresponded with substantial changes in graduate-level online education in the United States. The purpose of this quantitative, non-experimental, longitudinal descriptive study was to analyze trends in exclusively online graduate enrollment before, during, and after COVID-19, and to examine whether the distribution of research doctorate completions across broad fields changed across the same periods. This study used two federal, census-level data sources: the Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System (IPEDS) Fall Enrollment component and the Survey of Earned Doctorates (SED). Research Question 1 asked: How did the COVID-19 pandemic influence enrollment trends in online graduate education at U.S. higher education institutions? Research Question 2 asked: To what extent did the shift to online learning during the COVID-19 pandemic impact the academic performance of graduate students across different fields of study? For RQ1, an IPEDS analytic file of 15,761 institution-year observations was analyzed using a one-way ANOVA comparing exclusively online graduate enrollment (EFDEEXC) across pre-pandemic, pandemic-peak, and post-pandemic periods, supplemented by a two-way ANOVA examining the joint effects of time period and institutional control. Results indicated a statistically significant difference across periods, F(2, 15,758) = 26.62, p < .001, with a small effect (ηp² = .0034). Post-hoc comparisons showed enrollment increased significantly during the pandemic peak and remained significantly above the pre-pandemic baseline in the post-pandemic period. For Research Question 2, SED doctorate counts (2018–2022) aggregated into broad disciplinary categories were analyzed using a chi-square test of independence. The association between time period and field distribution was statistically significant, χ²(20) = 1134.25, p < .001, with a small effect (Cramer’s V = .030). Standardized residuals indicated over-representation of Engineering and Mathematics & Computer Sciences and under-representation of Humanities & Arts during and after the pandemic period. Overall, findings indicate that online graduate enrollment shifted upward after COVID-19, with post-pandemic levels remaining above the pre-pandemic baseline, while doctoral completions remained largely stable in composition with modest, field-specific variation. Implications include the need for sustained investment in online program quality, adult-learner support structures, and discipline-sensitive doctoral completion continuity planning.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用联邦层面的两类普查数据（IPEDS和SED），分析了COVID-19疫情期间及前后美国纯在线研究生入学率的变化趋势，以及博士毕业在学科分布上的变化。结果发现：在线研究生入学率在疫情期间显著上升且持续高于疫情前水平；博士毕业的学科分布虽有统计显著变化但幅度很小，工程和数学/计算机科学领域占比上升，人文艺术领域下降。
AI.research_question: 研究问题1：COVID-19疫情如何影响美国高等教育机构在线研究生教育的入学趋势？研究问题2：疫情期间向在线学习的转变在多大程度上影响了不同学科领域研究生的学术表现（以博士毕业完成为衡量）？
AI.motivation: COVID-19疫情促使美国研究生在线教育发生了巨大变化，但缺乏利用全国性、长期数据对疫情前后在线研究生入学趋势及博士毕业学科分布变化的系统性定量分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本研究为定量、非实验、纵向描述性研究，未明确依托特定理论框架，而是基于教育趋势比较与统计分析逻辑。
AI.method: 数据来源：IPEDS秋季入学数据（15,761个机构-年观测值）和SED博士调查数据（2018-2022年）。RQ1：采用单因素方差分析（one-way ANOVA）比较疫情前、疫情高峰期、疫情后的纯在线研究生入学率，辅以双因素方差分析（two-way ANOVA）考察时间段与院校控制类型的交互效应。RQ2：采用卡方独立性检验（chi-square test of independence）分析时间段与学科分布的关系。
AI.findings: RQ1：在线研究生入学率在三个时间段存在统计显著差异（F(2,15,758)=26.62, p<.001, ηp²=.0034），事后比较显示疫情期间显著上升，且疫情后仍显著高于疫情前基线。RQ2：时间段与学科分布的关联显著（χ²(20)=1134.25, p<.001, Cramer's V=.030），工程和数学/计算机科学在疫情期间及之后占比偏高，人文艺术占比偏低。整体博士毕业数量在学科构成上基本稳定，仅有小幅度的学科特异性变化。
AI.theory_contributions: 该研究为理解突发公共卫生事件对高等教育的长期结构性影响提供了实证证据，丰富了关于在线教育持续性效应和危机驱动的教育变革理论讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究建议教育机构应持续投资在线课程质量、加强成人学习者支持体系，并针对不同学科制定差异化的博士培养连续性计划。

title: Hootsuite as a Strategic Social Media Management Platform: A Comprehensive Review
affiliations: Concordia University and Concordia University

detail.title: Hootsuite as a Strategic Social Media Management Platform: A Comprehensive Review

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests, personal relationships, or affiliations that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is based exclusively on a review of publicly available literature, organizational information, and secondary sources. No human participants, personal data, surveys, interviews, or experiments were involved. Therefore, ethics committee approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The study was conducted independently by the authors.

detail.abstract: Social media has emerged as one of the most influential communication and marketing channels for organizations worldwide. The increasing complexity of managing multiple social media platforms has encouraged organizations to adopt social media management systems. Hootsuite is among the most widely used social media management platforms, offering content scheduling, analytics, social listening, customer engagement and collaboration capabilities. This study examines Hootsuite as a strategic social media management platform by reviewing its features, applications, pricing structure, organizational uses, benefits and limitations. Additionally, the paper evaluates real-world organizational implementations and discusses the platform's roles in improving digital marketing performance and social media governance. The findings indicate that Hootsuite significantly enhances operational efficiency, campaign management and analytical decision-making while presenting certain challenges related to cost and platform dependency. The study contributes to the growing literature on social media management systems and digital marketing technologies.

AI.tldr: 本文全面评述了Hootsuite作为战略社交媒体管理平台的功能、应用、定价、组织使用、优势与局限，发现其能显著提升运营效率、活动管理和分析决策能力，但也存在成本和平台依赖性问题。
AI.research_question: Hootsuite作为社交媒体管理平台在组织中的战略价值、应用效果及其优劣势是什么？
AI.motivation: 社交媒体已成为组织重要的沟通与营销渠道，但多平台管理的复杂性日益增加，亟需系统性研究主流社交媒体管理平台（如Hootsuite）的实际效用与局限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社交媒体管理理论、数字营销技术采纳理论、平台治理理论
AI.method: 文献综述与案例分析法，通过对Hootsuite的功能特性、定价结构、组织应用案例进行系统性回顾与评估。
AI.findings: Hootsuite显著提升了组织的运营效率、活动管理和分析决策能力；同时也存在成本较高和平台依赖性等挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了社交媒体管理系统和数字营销技术的理论文献，为平台治理与组织技术采纳提供了实证参考。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织在社交媒体管理平台选型、成本效益评估和数字化转型策略方面提供了实践指导。

title: Ergonomic Evaluation of Knee Exoskeleton Assistance in Construction: A Multimodal Study
affiliations: Rutgers, The State University of New Jersey - Rutgers University, Rutgers, The State University of New Jersey - Rutgers University, Rutgers, The State University of New Jersey - Rutgers University, Rutgers University - School of Management and Labor Relations and Rutgers, The State University of New Jersey - Rutgers University

detail.title: Ergonomic Evaluation of Knee Exoskeleton Assistance in Construction: A Multimodal Study
detail.abstract: Construction work involves physically strenuous tasks that heighten the risk of work-related musculoskeletal disorders and productivity loss. Wearable exoskeletons has shown a promising technology to help prevent work-related musculoskeletal disorders and decrease physical demands of human workers. Most existing studies evaluate wearable exoskeletons in simplified settings or isolated tasks and do not fully reflect the diverse and dynamic task demands of construction-related activities. To address this gap, this study presents an integrated framework that combines wearable knee exoskeleton assistance, immersive virtual-and augmentedreality (VR/AR) tasks, and synchronized multi-sensor data to quantify safety and performance in construction-like work space. Twenty-one adults completed multi-task protocols on a modular stair-ramp-deck platform with and without exoskeleton assistance while motion capture, force plates, electromyography, inertial sensors, and metabolic data recorded biomechanics and effort. The analyses and results indicate that exoskeleton assistance reduces lower-limb muscular demand and improves postural stability during kneeling and VR/AR tasks. Human subject survey results show perceived stability gains but note comfort and weight concerns. The evaluation framework provides a reproducible, task-relevant method for evaluating ergonomic and productivity outcomes with wearable sensing and exoskeletons in construction. The complete multimodal dataset and protocols are openly released to facilitate benchmarking and the development of future adaptive, task-aware wearable exoskeletons for workplace applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个结合膝盖外骨骼、VR/AR任务和多传感器数据的集成框架，用于量化建筑类工作场景中的安全性和表现。21名受试者在有无外骨骼辅助下完成多任务协议，结果表明外骨骼辅助可降低下肢肌肉需求并改善跪姿和VR/AR任务中的姿势稳定性，但存在舒适度和重量方面的顾虑。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个集成化的评估框架，在接近真实建筑工作场景中量化可穿戴膝盖外骨骼对安全性和工作表现的影响？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多在简化环境或孤立任务中评估可穿戴外骨骼，未能充分反映建筑活动多样且动态的任务需求，存在生态效度不足的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可穿戴外骨骼的人机协同理论、生物力学与肌电信号分析、沉浸式VR/AR任务模拟、多模态传感器融合评估方法。
AI.method: 21名受试者在模块化楼梯-坡道-平台装置上完成多任务协议（有/无外骨骼辅助），同时采集运动捕捉、测力板、肌电图、惯性传感器和代谢数据，并辅以主观问卷调查。
AI.findings: 外骨骼辅助降低了下肢肌肉需求，改善了跪姿和VR/AR任务中的姿势稳定性；受试者感知到稳定性提升，但对外骨骼的舒适度和重量存在顾虑。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个可复现、任务相关的评估框架，为建筑场景中可穿戴外骨骼的人因工程学评估提供了系统化方法论。
AI.practical_contributions: 公开了完整的多模态数据集和实验协议，为未来自适应、任务感知型可穿戴外骨骼的开发和基准测试提供了基础。

title: What Was Driving Part-Time Employment From 2010 Through 2019

detail.title: What Was Driving Part-Time Employment From 2010 Through 2019
detail.abstract:
During the recovery from the Great Recession and prior to the Covid Recession (2010 through 2019) the trends in Part-Time because of Slack Work or Business Conditions (PTSWBC) -- a major component of Involuntary Part-Time (IPT)-- and Voluntary Part-Time (VPT) moved in opposite directions. The sum of these two series, however, remained relatively stationary during the recovery.

Unlike previous recovery periods, this paper finds that PTSWBC and VPT were cointegrated: The two series shared a common trend. The common trend can be explained by movements in PTSWBC. Long-run movements in VPT were driven by changes in PTSWBC which had to do with employer demand for part-time work.

If the findings based on time series methods are correct, this suggest full-time positions that were converted to PTSWBC did not revert back to full-time once the recovery from the Great Recession took hold. Possible reasons could be slow moving market factors and the ACA.

Workers whose positions during the Great Recession changed from full-time to PTSWBC but did switch back would eventually vacate their part-time position. The vacated position, in turn, would be filled by a worker classified as VPT.

AI.tldr: 本文发现，在2010-2019年经济复苏期间，非自愿兼职（因工作不景气）与自愿兼职之间存在协整关系，非自愿兼职的变化驱动了自愿兼职的长期变动，且大衰退期间全职转非自愿兼职的岗位并未恢复为全职，而是被自愿兼职者填补。
AI.research_question: 在经济复苏期间（2010-2019），非自愿兼职（因工作不景气）与自愿兼职之间为何呈现相反趋势，而其总和却保持相对稳定？两者之间是否存在长期的均衡关系？
AI.motivation: 以往经济复苏期间非自愿兼职与自愿兼职的关系模式被打破，本文试图解释这一新现象背后的经济机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 时间序列协整理论；劳动力市场分割理论；雇主对兼职劳动力需求变化的传导机制。
AI.method: 时间序列分析方法，包括协整检验。
AI.findings: PTSWBC与VPT存在协整关系，共享一个共同趋势；该共同趋势可由PTSWBC的变动解释；VPT的长期变动受PTSWBC驱动；大衰退期间全职转为PTSWBC的岗位未恢复为全职，最终由VPT工人填补。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了非自愿兼职与自愿兼职之间新的长期均衡关系，挑战了传统复苏模式假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解后大衰退时期劳动力市场结构性变化提供实证依据；提示政策制定者关注兼职岗位的持久性及其对劳动力市场的影响。

title: Distinctive combinations of tropical climates and soils in rainfed and irrigated agricultural areas of the tropics
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and Embrapa Digital Agriculture

detail.title: Distinctive combinations of tropical climates and soils in rainfed and irrigated agricultural areas of the tropics
detail.abstract: The tropics can be geographically defined as that part of the earth, representing the region between the Tropic of Cancer and the Tropic of Capricorn. However, the definition of the tropical region varies among scientific disciplines. The boundaries of the tropics can be defined based on surface temperature and precipitation patterns and the boundaries of the tropics can extend further from the equator than the traditional latitudinal definition. In this paper, available databases were integrated and analyzed for identifying the distinctive combinations (or occurrence within the same geographic location) of tropical climates and soils in agricultural areas of the tropical geographic region and their relations with rainfed and irrigated crops. Analyzing datasets together made it possible to highlight distinctive combinations and display their distribution in the tropical region of the world. Considering the extent in agricultural areas in the tropical region, it was concluded that Tropical Savanna Climate (Aw) is the main climate; furthermore, rainfed crops and especially irrigated crops in the tropics are mostly under this type of climate. Acrisols, Ferralsols, and Luvisols under Aw climate are the distinctive combinations for rainfed crops, and combinations of Vertisols and Luvisols with the same climate type are distinguishable for irrigated crops.

AI.tldr: 本研究整合多源数据库，分析了热带地理区域内农业用地的气候与土壤组合特征，发现热带稀树草原气候（Aw）是主要气候类型，与Acrisols、Ferralsols、Luvisols等土壤组合对雨养作物最具代表性，而与Vertisols、Luvisols组合则与灌溉作物关联显著。
AI.research_question: 热带地理区域内，农业用地的气候与土壤组合特征是什么？这些组合与雨养作物和灌溉作物之间存在怎样的关系？
AI.motivation: 不同学科对热带边界的定义存在差异（如气候学定义可能超越传统纬度定义），而热带地区农业生产的土壤-气候组合尚未被系统整合分析，因此需要通过多数据库联合分析来揭示其分布规律。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于气候分类（Köppen气候分类体系中的热带气候类型）与土壤分类（如Acrisols、Ferralsols、Luvisols、Vertisols等）的联合地理分布理论，分析气候-土壤组合与作物类型（雨养vs灌溉）的关联性。
AI.method: 整合多源数据库（气候、土壤、土地利用等数据），通过空间叠加分析识别热带农业用地中气候与土壤的共存组合，并结合作物类型（雨养/灌溉）进行关联性分析。
AI.findings: （1）热带稀树草原气候（Aw）是热带农业用地中占比最高的气候类型；（2）雨养作物和灌溉作物均主要分布在Aw气候下；（3）雨养作物的代表性气候-土壤组合为Aw气候+Acrisols/Ferralsols/Luvisols；（4）灌溉作物的代表性组合为Aw气候+Vertisols/Luvisols。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于实际气候-土壤组合而非单纯纬度定义的热带农业分区方法，丰富了热带农业地理学的理论框架，明确了气候与土壤的交互作用对作物类型分布的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为热带地区农业规划提供了数据驱动的决策依据，帮助识别适合雨养或灌溉农业的优势气候-土壤组合区域，优化土地资源利用和灌溉策略。

title: Why India's Air-Quality Governance Is Becoming a Template for the Global South

detail.title: Why India's Air-Quality Governance Is Becoming a Template for the Global South

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no personal or financial relationships that could have influenced the research presented in this manuscript.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant or financial support from any funding agency, commercial entity, or not‑for‑profit organisation.

detail.abstract: The issue of air pollution poses one of the foremost complex governance challenges for fast-growing urban areas in the global south. This paper contends that India has positioned itself as a leading innovator in terms of air quality governance, providing a scalable and contextually relevant model for other nations in similar positions to implement. Using the lens of scholarship from environmental governance, public health and environmental justice, we analyse the new data driven-monitoring systems being developed in India, as well as the development of a new multi-level government structure to oversee the country's air quality, including through the establishment of judiciary oversight/requirements, support for transitioning the population to clean cooking solutions, transportation initiatives and consideration for co-benefits from climate action. Specifically, we highlight how many of the initiatives developed by the Government of India (i.e., the National Clean Air Programme (NCAP), Bharat Stage VI fuel standards and the Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana, or PMUY), have helped India create stronger institutional capacity and thus improve environmental protection at the population level. The analysis of India's governance innovations demonstrates that they can provide not only a uniquely national model for implementation but also transferable lessons to other developing countries located in the global south particularly those dealing with significant resource limitations, fragmentation of institutional governance structures or severe socioeconomic inequities.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了印度在空气污染治理方面的创新举措，认为印度已成为全球南方国家中空气治理的创新引领者，其数据驱动监测系统、多层级治理结构及多项政策（如NCAP、Bharat Stage VI、PMUY）不仅增强了制度能力，也为其他面临资源限制和治理碎片化的发展中国家提供了可借鉴的模式。
AI.research_question: 印度如何通过治理创新应对快速城市化地区的空气污染挑战？其治理模式对全球南方其他发展中国家有何借鉴意义？
AI.motivation: 空气污染是全球南方快速城市化地区面临的复杂治理挑战，而印度展现出独特的治理创新潜力，值得系统分析其模式的普适性和可扩展性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境治理理论、公共健康理论、环境正义理论
AI.method: 基于环境治理、公共健康和环境正义领域的学术视角，对印度新型数据驱动监测系统、多层级治理结构以及具体政策（NCAP、Bharat Stage VI、PMUY等）进行定性分析。
AI.findings: 印度通过NCAP、Bharat Stage VI燃料标准和PMUY清洁烹饪计划等创新举措，构建了更强有力的制度能力，提升了人口层面的环境保护水平。这些治理创新不仅形成了独特的国家模式，也为其他资源有限、治理碎片化、社会经济不平等严重的全球南方国家提供了可转移的经验。
AI.theory_contributions: 将环境治理、公共健康与环境正义三个领域交叉融合，为分析发展中国家空气污染治理提供了综合性的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 系统梳理了印度空气治理的创新实践，验证了数据驱动监测、多层级治理结构及具体政策组合的有效性，为其他面临类似挑战的全球南方国家提供了可操作的政策借鉴。

title: Adaptive Learning and Non-linear Pass-through in Small Open Economies: A Robust Machine Learning Framework for Inflation Forecasting

detail.title: Adaptive Learning and Non-linear Pass-through in Small Open Economies: A Robust Machine Learning Framework for Inflation Forecasting
detail.abstract: This paper addresses the limitations of traditional linear forecasting frameworks during periods of unprecedented supply-side anomalies. We introduce a robust macroeconomic forecasting architecture utilizing a Nested Time-Series Cross-Validation scheme to model HICP inflation in Greece (2015-2026) using exogenous global commodity indices. To eliminate the induced serial correlation inherent in overlapping filters (the Slutzky-Yule effect) and circumvent the extrapolation boundaries of tree-based ensembles, all features are transformed into first log-differences (Month-on-Month). We evaluate a regularized Machine Learning ensemble-the Random Forest Regressor-against a penalized linear baseline (Ridge Regression), optimizing all hyperparameters dynamically to eliminate tuning bias. The empirical results yield a Diebold-Mariano test statistic of 2.1909 (p-value = 0.0285). Consequently, we reject the null hypothesis of equal unconditional predictive accuracy at the 5% significance level, demonstrating the predictive superiority of the non-linear ensemble. The algorithm's ability to autonomously adjust its hierarchical complexity during the 2022 energy shock proves that adaptive tree-based architectures offer a mathematically superior approximation of inflation dynamics in volatile environments compared to globally optimized linear models. Finally, applying the optimal configuration to real-time data, the framework projects a stabilizing Month-on-Month HICP variation of-0.033% for June 2026.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于嵌套时间序列交叉验证的稳健宏观预测框架，使用外生全球商品指数建模希腊HICP通胀（2015-2026）。通过一阶对数差分消除重叠滤波导致的序列相关，采用随机森林回归器与岭回归进行对比。Diebold-Mariano检验统计量2.1909（p=0.0285），在5%显著性水平下拒绝等预测精度原假设，证明非线性集成模型在供应端异常时期的预测优越性。最优配置预测2026年6月希腊HICP环比变化为-0.033%。
AI.research_question: 在供应端异常（如2022年能源冲击）时期，非线性集成机器学习模型（随机森林）是否比传统线性预测框架（岭回归）更能准确预测希腊HICP通胀？
AI.motivation: 传统线性预测框架在供应端异常时期存在局限性，无法有效捕捉通胀的非线性动态特征。需要一种能自主调整层级复杂性的自适应预测架构来应对波动环境。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. Slutzky-Yule效应（重叠滤波导致的虚假序列相关）；2. 随机森林集成学习理论；3. 岭回归惩罚线性模型；4. Diebold-Mariano预测精度检验。
AI.method: 使用嵌套时间序列交叉验证（Nested Time-Series Cross-Validation）；特征转换为一阶对数差分（环比）；超参数动态优化消除调优偏差；随机森林回归器 vs 岭回归基线；Diebold-Mariano检验评估预测精度差异。
AI.findings: 1. Diebold-Mariano检验统计量2.1909（p=0.0285），在5%水平拒绝等预测精度原假设，随机森林显著优于岭回归；2. 随机森林在2022年能源冲击期间能自主调整层级复杂性，证明树基集成模型在波动环境下对通胀动力学的近似更优；3. 预测2026年6月希腊HICP环比变化为-0.033%。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Slutzky-Yule效应的处理（一阶对数差分）与嵌套交叉验证结合，为时间序列预测中的序列相关消除提供了方法论贡献；证明了树基集成模型在供应端异常时期对通胀动力学的数学近似优于全局优化的线性模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为希腊及类似经济体的通胀预测提供了可操作的稳健框架；展示了机器学习模型在应对能源冲击等极端事件时的自适应优势；给出了2026年6月希腊HICP环比预测值，对政策制定具有参考价值。

detail.title: Language Socialization During COVID-19: Evolving Attitudes of EFL Learners

publicationDetails.detailsText: Sabouri, M. , Ghaniabadi, S. , Adel, S. M. R. and Davoudi, M. (2025). Language Socialization During COVID-19: Evolving Attitudes of EFL Learners. Teaching English as a Second Language Quarterly (Formerly Journal of Teaching Language Skills), 44(4), 29-54. https://doi.org/10.22099/tesl.2025.52521.3385

detail.abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic prompted significant transformations in education systems globally. Consequently, this qualitative ethnographic study aimed to analyze the evolution of attitudes among English as a Foreign Language (EFL) learners through the lens of language socialization (LS). Additionally, the study explored the evolution of the COVID-19 pandemic on the LS of Iranian EFL learners within cyberspace through prolonged engagement and triangulated data collection, including classroom observations, semi-structured interviews, researcher field notes, audio recordings, and student journals. This approach allowed for a holistic understanding of the Iranian culture from participants' perspectives. A triangulation of data was collected, comprising class observations, semi-structured interviews, researcher notes, audio recordings, and student journals. The Data analysis was conducted using MAXQDA Analytic Pro 2020. Based on the seven principles of LS, the results identified eight categories: cultural familiarity, cultural differences, the influence of foreign culture, changes in identity and behavior, online class recording, online learning, self-efficacy, and participation in virtual groups. Ultimately, this study concluded that language and culture are intrinsically intertwined and that learners' engagement with language and culture adversely impacts their socialization within the English language and culture. Furthermore, online classes were found to enhance learners' self-efficacy while reducing anxiety levels. The findings equip EFL educators with strategies for fostering adaptive language socialization during crises, while offering learners tools to navigate disruptions through reflection and virtual communities. Additionally, they guide researchers in studying attitude evolution ethnographically and urge material developers to integrate psychosocial elements into language resources for volatile environments.

AI.tldr: 这项民族志研究探讨了新冠疫情如何通过语言社会化理论影响伊朗英语学习者的态度演变，发现语言与文化密不可分，线上学习提升了自我效能感并降低了焦虑。
AI.research_question: 新冠疫情如何影响伊朗英语学习者的语言社会化过程及其态度演变？
AI.motivation: 新冠疫情彻底改变了全球教育系统，亟需理解危机情境下语言学习者的社会化过程如何演变，特别是线上环境对语言文化学习的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 语言社会化理论（Language Socialization），基于七个原则分析学习者在语言与文化互动中的身份、行为和态度变化。
AI.method: 定性民族志研究，采用长期参与和三角互证数据收集：课堂观察、半结构化访谈、研究者田野笔记、录音和学生日志，使用MAXQDA Analytic Pro 2020进行数据分析。
AI.findings: 识别出八个类别：文化熟悉度、文化差异、外国文化影响、身份与行为变化、在线课堂录制、在线学习、自我效能感、虚拟群体参与。语言与文化密不可分；语言文化参与度对学习者的社会化产生负面影响；线上课程提升自我效能感并降低焦虑。
AI.theory_contributions: 在危机情境下验证并拓展了语言社会化理论，揭示了线上环境对语言-文化社会化过程的独特影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为英语教师提供危机中促进适应性语言社会化的策略；为学习者提供通过反思和虚拟社区应对学习中断的工具；指导教材开发者将心理社会元素融入语言资源设计。

title: The Capital Structure Decision for Growth-Stage Startups: A Theoretical Framework for Understanding Stage-Contingent Capital Decisions

detail.title: The Capital Structure Decision for Growth-Stage Startups: A Theoretical Framework for Understanding Stage-Contingent Capital Decisions

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author has no financial relationships with any organizations that may have influenced this research. The author's experience in corporate finance advisory has informed the practitioner cases presented in this paper, which are anonymized and do not identify specific companies or investors. No funding was received for this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper presents theoretical research and publicly-disclosed case analysis. No human subjects, patient data, or confidential client information is disclosed in identifiable form. All case examples reference publicly-disclosed corporate filings, press releases, and news reports. No ethics approval was required for this research.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no funding from any source. The paper was developed independently as part of the author's research program on entrepreneurial finance and capital strategy.

detail.abstract: Corporate finance theory provides two dominant frameworks for capital structure decisions: the Modigliani-Miller irrelevance proposition and the pecking order theory. Neither applies to growth-stage startups. Modigliani-Miller assumes frictionless markets and perfect information-conditions that do not exist for private, information-opaque startups. Pecking order theory predicts that firms prefer internal financing, then debt, then equity-yet venture-backed startups routinely raise equity first and debt later, precisely the opposite sequence. The result: founders navigate one of their most consequential strategic decisionswhich capital source to pursue, when, and in what amount-without a theoretically grounded or empirically validated decision framework. This paper addresses that gap. Drawing on 2024-2025 market data showing venture debt at $53.3 billion annually (up 94% from 2023), revenue-based financing emerging as a $2+ billion market, and median equity dilution at 18-20% per round, we introduce the Capital-Control-Timeline (CCT) Framework-a three-dimensional decision architecture that maps capital source choices to their trade-offs across capital efficiency (runway per dollar), control dilution (equity and governance), and timeline pressure (burn rate and milestone distance). We document four stage-specific capital strategies: Seed stage (equity-only), Series A (equity with optional RBF for working capital), Series B-C (equity with venture debt to extend runway), and Growth stage (blended equity-debt-secondary structures). We characterize conditions under which venture debt becomes theoretically optimal (post-equity raise, $2M+ ARR, clear path to next milestone), when RBF becomes theoretically viable (SaaS/e-commerce with recurring revenue, need for working capital without board interference), and when equity is theoretically necessary (pre-revenue, pivot risk, or asymmetric upside requiring patient capital). The framework is consistent with observed capital decisions across publicly-disclosed corporate cases and calibrated to 2024-2025 market conditions. For practitioners, this paper provides a structured framework for evaluating capital trade-offs that business school corporate finance courses do not teach.

AI.tldr: 本文针对增长型初创企业缺乏理论指导的资本结构决策问题，提出了"资本-控制-时间线（CCT）三维框架"，将资本来源选择映射到资本效率、控制稀释和时间线压力三个维度的权衡中，并归纳了四个阶段的特定资本策略（种子轮仅股权、A轮股权加可选RBF、B-C轮股权加风险债务、成长期混合结构），为创始人在不同阶段选择最优资本来源提供了理论依据和实证校准。
AI.research_question: 增长型初创企业在不同发展阶段应如何选择资本来源（股权、风险债务、收入型融资），以在资本效率、控制稀释和时间线压力之间做出最优权衡？
AI.motivation: 现有公司金融理论（MM定理和啄序理论）均不适用于增长型初创企业：MM定理依赖无摩擦市场和完美信息假设，啄序理论预测的内源融资→债务→股权顺序与风投支持初创企业实际采用的股权优先→债务在后的顺序完全相反，导致创始人面临资本结构这一重大战略决策时缺乏理论指导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资本-控制-时间线（CCT）三维框架：将资本来源选择映射到三个维度的权衡——资本效率（每美元创造的跑道）、控制稀释（股权和治理权损失）和时间线压力（燃烧率和里程碑距离）。
AI.method: 基于2024-2025年市场数据（风险债务533亿美元，收入型融资20+亿美元市场，每轮股权稀释中位数18-20%）进行理论构建，并通过公开披露的企业案例进行一致性验证和校准。
AI.findings: 1. 识别了四个阶段特定资本策略：种子轮（仅股权）、A轮（股权+可选RBF用于营运资金）、B-C轮（股权+风险债务延长跑道）、成长期（股权-债务-二级市场混合结构）。2. 风险债务最优条件：股权融资后、ARR 200万美元+、有明确路径到达下一里程碑。3. RBF可行条件：SaaS/电商类有经常性收入、需要营运资金但不希望董事会干预。4. 股权必要条件：无收入、存在转型风险或非对称上行空间需耐心资本。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次为增长型初创企业构建了系统的资本结构决策理论框架（CCT框架），填补了MM定理和啄序理论在创业金融领域的空白；按发展阶段细化了资本选择的边界条件和最优区间，将资本结构理论从静态最优扩展为动态阶段匹配模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为创始人提供了可直接操作的资本结构决策框架和阶段匹配指南；明确了每种资本来源（股权、风险债务、收入型融资）在何种条件下在理论上最优；揭示了商学院公司金融课程未教授的关键资本权衡维度，帮助创始人避免因理论缺失而做出次优决策。

title: When Theory Constrains Reality: Detecting and Preventing the Residual Fallacy

detail.title: When Theory Constrains Reality: Detecting and Preventing the Residual Fallacy

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflicts
declarations.funderStatement: Self-funded

detail.abstract: When the true data-generating process is Y = f(X, Z) and the working model is Y = g(X) + ε, the causal contribution of the omitted Z loads onto the residual ε, and the residual is then interpreted in the only vocabulary the model possesses. This paper names the practice of converting such residuals into measured entities-and of building policy promises on their removal-the residual fallacy, formalizes it, and develops operational criteria for detecting and preventing it. The lead case is the Canadian internal-trade-barrier literature, 2016-2026, which supplies an unusually complete audit trail: the "barrier" is the residual of a regression on an inference; the canonical source records, in its own footnotes, negative barriers, missing data priced as a barrier, and non-tradability booked as policy; the projected gain is arithmetic in an assumed elasticity, positive by construction in the model class employed; and across published vintages the entity's measured size halved (from a 21 percent to a roughly 9 percent tariff equivalent) while the gain promised from its removal nearly doubled (from roughly 4 to roughly 7 percent of GDP), with no statute repealed and no tariff discovered in the interim. The mirror-image fallacy-discarding a measured relationship for want of a mechanism-is documented through the loss of the scurvy cure and the rejection of Semmelweis. Five operational tests are proposed, together with the single question underlying all of them: is the model's premise-set certified complete, or merely assumed so?

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了“残差谬误”——将回归残差物化为可测量的实体并以此为基础构建政策承诺——并以加拿大内部贸易壁垒文献（2016-2026）为主要案例进行形式化分析，提出了五项操作性检验标准。
AI.research_question: 当真实数据生成过程包含遗漏变量Z时，模型将因果贡献错误地归入残差，并进而将残差物化为可测量的实体——这一实践存在什么问题？如何形式化地定义、检测和预防这一谬误？
AI.motivation: 实践中普遍存在一种做法：将模型残差（由遗漏变量导致）解释为某种可测量的实体（如“贸易壁垒”），并基于消除该实体来承诺政策收益。这种“残差谬误”尚未被系统地形式化和批判，可能导致严重的政策误判。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于遗漏变量偏误的计量经济学理论，结合科学哲学中的实体化谬误（reification）和因果推理框架，提出“残差谬误”的概念化与形式化定义。
AI.method: 以加拿大内部贸易壁垒文献（2016-2026）为案例进行深度审计，追踪其“壁垒”概念的构造过程、测量变化与政策承诺演变；同时通过历史案例（坏血病疗法被忽视、Semmelweis被拒）展示镜像谬误。
AI.findings: 加拿大内部贸易壁垒文献中：壁垒是回归残差；“壁垒”的测量规模从21%的关税等价降至约9%；同时承诺的消除收益却从GDP的约4%升至约7%。同一实体测量减半而政策承诺翻倍，期间无任何法规被废除或关税被发现。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出并形式化“残差谬误”概念，阐明了将模型残差实体化并基于其消除构建政策承诺的逻辑陷阱；提出镜像谬误（因缺乏机制而丢弃测量关系）作为对称性补充。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出五项操作性检验标准，核心问题为“模型的前提集是否被认证为完备的，还是仅仅被假定为完备的？”为政策制定者和研究者提供了识别和预防残差谬误的实用工具。

title: The Rules Are the Game: Quantifying How Monetary Stimulus and Lending Drive Wealth Concentration & Housing Crises - Based on the Natural Experiment of Five Countries’ Synchronized Pandemic Response

detail.title: The Rules Are the Game: Quantifying How Monetary Stimulus and Lending Drive Wealth Concentration & Housing Crises - Based on the Natural Experiment of Five Countries’ Synchronized Pandemic Response

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflicts to declare
declarations.funderStatement: Self-funded

detail.abstract: The distributional incidence of monetary policy is usually treated as an empirical question, answered after the fact from administrative microdata. This paper shows it is an arithmetic question, answerable in advance. Banks operate the standard amortization formula in inverted form-payment capacity in, maximum loan out-and the resulting function P_max(r) is convex and steepest near zero. Composed with the creditworthiness spread schedule, which prices each borrower's buffer and is itself codified in Basel supervisory doctrine, and with the power-law distribution of wealth, the incidence of any uniform rate cut is structurally regressive by closedform calculation, before any asset price moves. A feedback corollary follows: rate cuts enlarge buffers, buffers compress spreads, and the next cut amplifies from a steeper distribution, making the wealth distribution partly the instrument's own output. The March 2020 cuts in five owncurrency countries supply a natural experiment: with borders closed and incomes collapsing, every competing explanation of house prices predicted the wrong sign. Applied to Canada, the arithmetic yields gains on the order of $188 million per household at the apex of the distribution against roughly $37,000 across the bottom 80 percent, an aggregate stimulus approximately 7.2 times the fiscal response-computable in advance from public data and the banks' own formula.

AI.tldr: 本文证明货币政策的分配效应并非经验问题，而是算术问题。通过银行使用的反向摊销公式、巴塞尔监管框架下的信用利差表以及财富的幂律分布，可以提前计算出任何统一降息在结构上都是累退的（即富者获益远大于穷者）。2020年3月五国降息的自然实验验证了这一结论，以加拿大为例，分布顶端每户获益约1.88亿美元，而底层80%仅获约3.7万美元。
AI.research_question: 货币政策的分配效应（distributional incidence）能否在事前通过公式计算，而非仅靠事后微观数据进行经验估计？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为货币政策的分配效应是一个需要事后从行政微观数据中回答的经验问题，本文试图证明它实际上是一个可以提前回答的算术问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 银行反向摊销公式（inverted amortization formula）：以还款能力为输入、最大贷款额为输出，函数P_max(r)是凸函数且在零利率附近最陡峭；2) 信用利差表（creditworthiness spread schedule）：基于巴塞尔监管框架，对每个借款人的缓冲空间定价；3) 财富的幂律分布（power-law distribution of wealth）。
AI.method: 理论推导：通过闭式公式计算利率统一下调的分配效应；自然实验：利用2020年3月五个主权货币国家的降息作为自然实验（边境关闭、收入崩溃，排除了其他竞争性解释）；案例应用：以加拿大为案例进行量化测算。
AI.findings: 1) 任何统一降息在结构上都是累退的（regressive），即富者获益远大于穷者，可在资产价格变动前通过闭式公式提前计算；2) 存在反馈效应：降息扩大缓冲空间，缓冲空间压缩利差，下一次降息从更陡峭的分布中进一步放大；3) 加拿大案例：分布顶端每户获益约1.88亿美元，底层80%仅约3.7万美元，总刺激规模约为财政应对措施的7.2倍。
AI.theory_contributions: 将货币政策的分配效应从需要事后经验分析的"实证问题"重新定义为可以事前数学推导的"算术问题"，揭示出货币政策的分配效应具有结构性的、可预测的累退性特征，并提出"财富分布是货币政策工具自身的产出"这一反馈机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了一种可提前计算的工具，利用公开数据和银行公式即可预测货币政策的分配效应，从而在决策时更充分地考虑分配后果；量化了货币政策与财政政策在分配效应上的巨大差异（货币政策刺激约为财政应对的7.2倍）。

title: Expert Colleague or Dancing Bear? The Mixed Responses to AI in Digital Humanities Research
affiliations: Indiana University Bloomington, Indiana University Bloomington and University of Sheffield

detail.title: Expert Colleague or Dancing Bear? The Mixed Responses to AI in Digital Humanities Research

publicationDetails.journalName: Information Matters

detail.abstract: A recent study explored how scholars in the digital humanities research domain are navigating this new and complex landscape. Digital humanities is an interdisciplinary research field where scholars employ digital tools and computational methods to investigate cultural and humanities questions. Drawing on an international survey of 76 respondents and 15 in-depth interviews, the study found that scholars are not simply embracing or rejecting these tools. Instead, they are adopting AI systems cautiously, using them to speed up routine tasks, explore ideas, and build new skills, while navigating problems of accuracy, authorship, and what these systems might mean for the future of scholarship. The big question is no longer just whether AI is impressive, but whether it is becoming a genuine research partner, a useful tool, or, for some, still more of a “dancing bear” than a trusted collaborator. By tracing these mixed reactions and everyday practices, the study offers a grounded look at how AI is beginning to reshape academic life.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过国际调查和深度访谈，揭示了数字人文学者并非简单地拥抱或拒绝AI，而是谨慎地采用AI系统，将其用于加快例行任务、探索思路和培养新技能，同时应对准确性、作者身份等问题，呈现了AI如何开始重塑学术生活的现实图景。
AI.research_question: 数字人文学者如何在复杂的新兴研究环境中导航和采用AI系统？
AI.motivation: 数字人文是一个跨学科研究领域，学者使用数字工具和计算方法研究文化和人文问题。随着AI技术的快速发展，学者们如何应对这一新工具成为重要议题，而现有研究缺乏对这一过程的深入理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术采纳理论、人机协作理论、学术实践理论
AI.method: 混合研究方法：国际问卷调查（76名受访者）和深度访谈（15人）
AI.findings: 学者并非简单拥抱或拒绝AI，而是谨慎采用；AI被用于加快例行任务、探索思路和培养新技能；学者需应对准确性、作者身份以及AI对学术未来的影响等问题；学者对AI的态度存在分歧——有人视其为研究伙伴，有人视其为工具，还有人认为它更像"跳舞的熊"（看似有趣但不可靠）。
AI.theory_contributions: 为技术采纳和人机协作理论提供了跨学科语境下的实证证据；提出了"谨慎采用"这一介于拥抱与拒绝之间的中间地带概念；揭示了学者对AI态度的光谱分布。
AI.practical_contributions: 为数字人文领域的学者、学术机构和管理者提供了AI应用的现实图景；帮助理解AI在学术实践中面临的具体挑战（准确性、作者身份等）；为制定AI辅助学术研究的政策提供了实证基础。

title: The Impact Frontier
affiliations: Total Portfolio Project

detail.title: The Impact Frontier
detail.abstract: How much can a marginal portfolio tilt by an investor change firms’ capital and the external outcomes those firms produce? This paper develops a general-equilibrium model in which investor capital supply and firm capital demand jointly determine the real effects of sustained portfolio tilts. The model nests the CAPM, incorporates investor heterogeneity through a non-market-risk term, and aligns firm capital demand with q-theory. The resulting Impact Frontier is the Pareto frontier between certainty-equivalent financial returns and portfolio impact returns. The direct contribution multiplier is the share of an investor’s supply shift that becomes firm capital in the one-asset case; for multiple assets, a contribution multiplier matrix maps portfolio tilts into capital changes across firms. Calibrated to U.S. public equities with five-year return and capital-growth windows, the estimated multipliers vary substantially across firms. Tilts that ignore contribution-multiplier heterogeneity can fall far below the Impact Frontier or move in the wrong direction. Direct-multiplier tilts capture most of the frontier for the full cross-section, while the full matrix matters more within narrower investment universes.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个一般均衡模型，研究投资者投资组合倾斜如何影响企业资本和外部产出。模型将CAPM、投资者异质性（通过非市场风险项）与q理论结合，推导出影响前沿（Impact Frontier），并估计出贡献乘数矩阵。校准至美国公开股权数据发现，乘数在跨企业中差异显著，忽略这种异质性的倾斜策略可能远低于影响前沿甚至方向错误。
AI.research_question: 投资者的边际投资组合倾斜能在多大程度上改变企业的资本及这些企业产生的外部结果？
AI.motivation: 传统金融理论主要关注投资组合倾斜对财务回报的影响，但对倾斜如何通过资本供给变化产生实际经济影响（企业资本变动和外部产出变化）缺乏一般均衡分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 一般均衡模型；CAPM（资本资产定价模型）；q理论（企业资本需求）；影响前沿（Impact Frontier，财务回报与影响回报之间的帕累托边界）；贡献乘数矩阵。
AI.method: 理论建模（一般均衡模型融合CAPM、投资者异质性和q理论），并校准至美国公开股权数据进行实证估计（使用五年回报和资本增长窗口）。
AI.findings: （1）直接贡献乘数是单一资产情况下投资者供给变动变为企业资本的份额；多资产情况下贡献乘数矩阵将投资组合倾斜映射为企业资本变动。（2）校准结果显示乘数在跨企业间差异显著。（3）忽略乘数异质性的倾斜可能远低于影响前沿甚至方向错误。（4）直接乘数倾斜可捕捉全截面的大部分前沿，但在更窄的投资范围内完整矩阵更重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将投资者资本供给与公司资本需求均衡结合，推导出影响前沿这一理论边界，并引入贡献乘数矩阵概念，为ESG/影响力投资提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为影响力投资者提供了如何有效配置资本以实现实际影响的指导：应关注不同企业间贡献乘数的异质性，否则倾斜策略可能效率低下甚至适得其反。

title: From Content Generation to Content Validation: Why Human Judgment Still Matters in the AI Era
affiliations: National Research Council of Italy

detail.title: From Content Generation to Content Validation: Why Human Judgment Still Matters in the AI Era

publicationDetails.journalName: Information Matters

detail.abstract: In the past year, the focus of AI in education has shifted from generating content to evaluating its quality. While large language models can now produce vast amounts of material in seconds, ensuring that this content is accurate, reliable, and pedagogically sound remains a challenge. Emerging research shows that using AI as an evaluator is still unreliable, making human judgment more essential than ever. In this new paradigm, the real bottleneck is no longer creation but validation.

AI.tldr: AI在教育领域的应用焦点已从内容生成转向内容质量评估。尽管大语言模型能快速生成大量材料，但确保其准确性、可靠性和教学合理性仍是挑战。研究表明AI作为评估者仍不可靠，人类判断力比以往更加重要。在新范式中，真正的瓶颈不再是内容创造，而是内容验证。
AI.research_question: 在教育领域中，AI生成内容的质量评估面临哪些挑战？人类判断在AI内容验证中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 过去一年，AI在教育领域的焦点从内容生成转向质量评估。虽然大语言模型能快速生成大量材料，但如何确保这些内容的准确性、可靠性和教学合理性仍是一个亟待解决的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: AI内容评估可靠性理论、人机协作验证框架
AI.method: 文献综述与新兴研究分析
AI.findings: AI作为评估者仍然不可靠；人类判断在教育内容验证中变得比以往更加重要；教育AI应用的核心瓶颈已从内容创造转向内容验证。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了AI教育应用的新范式转变：从生成到评估；明确了人类判断在AI内容验证中的不可替代性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育工作者和AI开发者提供了方向性指导，强调在AI工具广泛应用的时代，应加大对内容验证机制和人类评估能力的投入。

title: Same Class, New Approach: Reimagining Information Students' Use of Gen AI in Formative Writing Assessments
affiliations: and University of Maryland

detail.title: Same Class, New Approach: Reimagining Information Students' Use of Gen AI in Formative Writing Assessments

publicationDetails.journalName: Information Matters

detail.abstract: We began teaching an online class about records scandals in 2023, at the very beginning of what would become the gen AI takeover. In 2024, we found that 67 of our 100 students used gen AI on the first essay assignment despite our express prohibition of its use—in any capacity. So, we had to pivot our teaching approach. By 2025, we actually asked students to use gen AI in their work in order to learn from it. Here, we lay out the changes we made and how we’re using gen AI in our writing instruction to build critical thinking skills and AI literacy.

AI.tldr: 一篇关于如何在写作教学中从禁止转向引导学生使用生成式AI（gen AI）以培养批判性思维和AI素养的教学反思文章。
AI.research_question: 在写作教学中，如何从禁止使用生成式AI转向引导学生合理使用AI，以培养其批判性思维和AI素养？
AI.motivation: 2023年开设在线课程时处于生成式AI爆发的初期，2024年发现67%的学生在明确禁止的情况下仍使用AI完成作业，迫使教学团队重新思考教学策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 主要基于批判性思维理论、AI素养框架以及写作教学中的技术整合理论。
AI.method: 教学实践反思与案例分析，描述了从禁止到引导的教学策略转变过程，以及在写作教学中融入生成式AI的具体做法。
AI.findings: 通过主动引导学生使用生成式AI进行写作学习，可以有效培养其批判性思维能力与AI素养。
AI.theory_contributions: 为AI时代的写作教学理论提供了新的视角，即从技术禁止转向技术整合的教学范式转变。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育工作者提供了在写作课程中如何实际引导学生使用生成式AI的具体教学策略和实践案例。

title: Beyond the Boolean: Is Natural Language Search Opening or Closing the Discovery Gap for University E-library Users?
affiliations: University of Wisconsin - Milwaukee

detail.title: Beyond the Boolean: Is Natural Language Search Opening or Closing the Discovery Gap for University E-library Users?

publicationDetails.journalName: Information Matters

detail.abstract: For decades, the “search box” at the heart of the university library has been a gatekeeper. To unlock the vast treasures of academic databases, users had to speak a specific, rigid language, Boolean. For expert researchers, terms like AND, OR, and NOT are second nature. But for many students without appropriate information searching skills and training, the traditional search interface has often acted more as a barrier than a bridge.

AI.tldr: 传统大学图书馆的布尔逻辑搜索界面对于缺乏信息检索技能的学生构成障碍，而非桥梁。
AI.research_question: 传统大学图书馆基于布尔逻辑的搜索界面如何影响不同用户群体的信息获取效率？
AI.motivation: 传统图书馆搜索界面依赖布尔逻辑（AND、OR、NOT），对专家研究者自然，但对缺乏信息检索技能的学生构成障碍，需要探索更包容的搜索方式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息检索理论、用户界面设计中的可用性理论、信息素养理论
AI.method: 概念分析/论述性研究，基于对现有搜索界面使用问题的观察和批判性分析。
AI.findings: 布尔逻辑搜索界面虽然对专业研究者有效，但对缺乏信息检索技能的学生群体而言，它更多是获取学术资源的障碍而非桥梁。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了传统搜索界面设计中的"专家偏见"问题，即系统设计默认用户具备专业知识，忽略了不同用户群体的信息素养差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 为图书馆搜索界面改进提供了方向，提示需要开发更直观、更包容、减少对专业布尔语法依赖的搜索工具。

title: When Power Confronts Excellence: What Auriemma, Staley, and the 2026 Final Four Reveal About Representation and Leadership in LIS
affiliations: University of South Carolina

detail.title: When Power Confronts Excellence: What Auriemma, Staley, and the 2026 Final Four Reveal About Representation and Leadership in LIS

publicationDetails.journalName: Information Matters

detail.abstract: Auriemma and Staley belong in a conversation about representation and leadership in LIS because the same racialized and interpretive pattern of disruption appears here too. LIS describes itself as progressive, inclusive, and equity minded, but Cooke and Kitzie (2021) argue that marginalized scholars and practitioners still function as outsiders within, included inside institutions that were not built with them in mind. Cooke and Green (2023) make a related point in their call for inclusive leadership, arguing that LIS leadership models have too often reflected structures that privilege white men and exclude others from full authority.

AI.tldr: 该文探讨了LIS领域（图书馆与信息科学）中关于表征与领导力的种族化问题，指出尽管LIS自称进步、包容，但边缘化学者和从业者仍被视为"内部的外人"，领导模式也长期偏向白人男性。
AI.research_question: LIS领域中的种族化表征与领导力模式如何再现排斥结构？
AI.motivation: 揭示LIS领域自诩进步包容的表象下，边缘群体（如有色人种学者）在实际领导力和代表性方面仍面临系统性排斥。
AI.theoretical_framework: "内部的外人"（outsiders within）理论；批判种族理论；包容性领导力理论。
AI.method: 理论分析与批判性论述，援引Cooke & Kitzie (2021)和Cooke & Green (2023)等已有研究进行论证。
AI.findings: LIS虽声称进步包容，但其领导力结构仍以白人男性为中心，边缘群体被纳入却未被赋予真正权威，形成"内部的外人"困境。
AI.theory_contributions: 将"内部的外人"概念应用于LIS领域，丰富了对该领域种族化权力结构的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒LIS领域需要反思其领导力模型，推动真正包容性的制度改革，而非仅停留在口号层面。

title: When You Message a Librarian at 11 PM: How Virtual Help Became Real Learning
affiliations: Airlangga University

detail.title: When You Message a Librarian at 11 PM: How Virtual Help Became Real Learning

publicationDetails.journalName: Information Matters

detail.abstract: Many people view librarians as the people who help you find a book, answer a quick question, or point you to the right database. But in today’s academic environment, where students learn online, write theses with digital tools, and face intense pressure to publish, librarians often do something much bigger: they teach.

AI.tldr: 本文指出图书馆员在现代学术环境中的角色已从传统的图书管理员扩展为教育者，承担着数字时代教学的重要职责。
AI.research_question: 在现代学术环境中，图书馆员的角色发生了怎样的转变？他们如何在数字学习、论文写作和出版压力下承担教学职能？
AI.motivation: 人们对图书馆员的传统认知（帮助找书、答疑、指引数据库）已无法全面反映其在当代学术环境中的实际贡献，因此需要重新审视和定位图书馆员的角色。
AI.theoretical_framework: 角色理论、教育职能转型理论、数字学术环境理论
AI.method: 基于学术环境观察与文献分析的概念性论述
AI.findings: 在数字化学习、论文写作和出版压力增大的背景下，图书馆员实际上承担了大量教学职能，其角色已从传统服务提供者转变为教育者。
AI.theory_contributions: 更新了图书馆员角色理论，将教学职能纳入图书馆员的核心角色范畴。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒学术界和图书馆行业重新认识图书馆员的教学价值，推动图书馆员角色的重新定位与职业发展。
